chapters.title: Chapter 5580: A Message From Father!
paragraphs: <Jarl Skallagrim>
In the boundless darkness between Dimensions, the Steed stopped.

It had not wavered in all the crossings behind them, the last of his eight, running on the hope he had whipped into it, following a scent that no distance had managed to thin. It simply stopped, mid-stride, in the middle of nothing, and stood trembling in its chains!
"Why have we stopped,"Jarl Skallagrim said. It was not a question as really, questions implied patience and he had fucking none.
The Steed’s voice came up to him small and confused, a mountain speaking like a child.
"She is gone."
"Gone."

"I can no longer sense Hvitrmarr. Her trail did not thin, Jarl. It did not turn. It..."The great head swung slowly in the dark, searching. "It ceased. As if she stopped existing anywhere my senses can reach. There is nowhere the scent goes. There is only where it was."
Skallagrim sat very still upon his throne-saddle, rot ticking quietly along his fissures, and consulted his lucidity at this time.

Scents did not cease. Beings fled, veiled, died, and every one of those left a shape in the weavings. A ceasing left nothing, and nothing was not a thing that existence produced on its own. Something had been done to her. Something outside his considerable education, and he was fucking educated!
But...
They were close. He knew they were close. In this fold of the dark there were fewer than seven Dimensions within reach as they had been inches away!

The few nearby they were heading towards were...THE Cajaman. THE Tisana. THE Ymnaros. A few others, lesser and stranger. She should be inside one of them. The thing that had ceased her scent was inside one of them!
He would pass by each of them in turn to ensure he found them.
His whip-arm moved, and the lash of woven curse-light cracked across the Steed’s flank!
CRACK!

"Go towards THE Cajaman Dimension, for now," Jarl Skallagrim said. "We will find them. Even if we have to search one Dimension at a time. You have carried me this far on hope, little steed. Carry me the rest of the way on certainty..."
The Steed gathered itself, and ran.
And as they went, deep in the crossing-dark, Jarl Skallagrim twitched.

It began as a wrongness at his brow, a heat with a shape to it, and then an obsidian mark surfaced on the skin of his forehead, black lines assembling into an old, old seal, and the weight that came through it bent him forward over his saddle-throne and tore a bellow out of him that rolled away unanswered into the dark!
"NNGH... AAAAGH!"
The Steed faltered beneath him, feeling it, whatever it was, bleeding down through the chains.
Then the weight passed. Skallagrim hung there a moment, breathing through the last of it.
And he raised his head, and laughed in astonishment.
"HAHAHA! Oh. Oh, now this. Now THIS!"
The Steed below him trembled in fear, but it still asked!
"Jarl... what has happened to you?"

Skallagrim wiped at his mouth. When he spoke, his voice had that texture the eight had learned to dread more than his whip, the mad cadence with the terrible lucid stillness underneath, a man singing over the top of his own dying weavings.

"Little steed, you don’t know this, but us Descendants are unique beings," he said. "You were bred. We were spoken. A Descendant is a sentence with a bloodline, and every sentence has a speaker, and our speakers are Those Who Remain. Our Fathers."
He tapped the fading obsidian mark on his brow. "And we can receive messages, directly, from our Fathers. It is our oldest inheritance. Older than our strength. Older than our curse."
He settled back on the throne, warming to the telling the way he warmed to nothing else.

"Do you know what those messages are like? I have collected the accounts my whole life, the way beggars collect glimpses through feast-hall windows. For the favored lines, the messages come often. Commands, mostly. A Father points, and the line moves."

" Some receive blessings through the mark, gifts of authority poured straight into the blood. Some receive dreams, whole nights spent walking the memories of their ancestor, and they wake weeping at the size of what they come from. Some lines receive only a single word once a generation, and they build entire civilizations around each word. And some," his grin widened, crooked, "some receive silence. Lifelong, perfect, complete silence. Because a Father speaks when a Father has use for you, and not one heartbeat before."
He spread his arms to the dark.

"I have never received a message. Not once. All my life. THE Sleepless Fiend, my very own ancestor, the speaker of my line, and in all my centuries of dying, through every experiment, every steed, every year I carved off my own span hunting a way out of the sentence he wrote me into, I never heard so much as a syllable. I used to pray for the mark to burn, little steed, when I was young and still stupid enough to pray. Silence. Always silence. I stopped fighting my madness partly to spite that silence. Let him inherit a lunatic, I thought. Ha!"
His laughter faded to something quieter and far worse.
"And yet, just now, I heard this voice for the first time."
He touched his brow again, almost gently.

"And do you know the most ridiculous part? It was not even addressing me. Not me, Skallagrim, his son’s son’s son, dying in his name. It went out to all of us at once, a broadcast to the whole bloodline, the way a lord posts a bounty in a market square. It simply said: the White Steed has been cured. Find information. Uncover how she was cured, and the one who cured her. Deliver this, and your life will be extended. You shall have....salvation."
The Steed’s body trembled!
Skallagrim leaned back and laughed at the roof of the dark, and there was no joy anywhere in the sound, only astonishment sharpened into something with edges.

"Haha! How ridiculous is that? A thousand years I begged existence for exactly two things. Salvation, or a single word from my Father. And I received neither, and I made my peace, I chose to watch, I chose the madness, I let go of salvation with both hands. And it was AFTER I let go of it that my Father finally wants to send me a message, to grant me one! Not for my sake. Never for my sake. Because his little cured steed interests something in his long, long game, and now the dying sons are useful, now the silence breaks! HAHA!"
His fists closed on the chains until his knuckles split, rot weeping from the fissures, and his voice dropped through the laughter into the truest register he owned.
"I hate them. I hate Those Who Remain so much. So much!"A breath came. The grin returned, dreadful and bright and filled with magisterial madness. "Haha..."

chapters.title: Chapter 5581: THE Remnant Seer!
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
Ryaenara’s Dimension had changed with her.

Noah stood on its high plateau and looked at the changes openly, because they were everywhere. The floating paintings still drifted all around them, hundreds of them, Ulf’s life’s work hanging in the air at every height, some finished and some abandoned mid-stroke.

But the sky above them and the ground below had been painted over by something no brush had touched. Red gold light lay across all of it, the color of her new robes and her new blood, her transformation written onto the whole Dimension that answered to her existence!

Even the sickly figure of Ulf was looking around in excitement. He sat propped among his paintings, wasted thin by THE Withering of the Remembered Root, and his dim eyes moved across the changed sky with the wonder of a man who had watched it happen.
And yet, even now, he was raising one sickly finger.
He pointed toward a nearby floating painting.

It showed his sister. Ryaenara, in her newly transformed state, obsidian-haired and robed in red gold, kneeling on dark sands toward an illusory figure. The figure itself was barely rendered, a shape more than a body, and it was surrounded by a massive blood gold crown.
"I didn’t know if it would be a true future, or a false one," Ulf said. His voice came out thin and worn. "But the weight on my sister seems to be removed."
His dim eyes traveled up to Noah. "Have you come to try and do the same to me?"
Noah looked at the painting for a long moment.
Ulf had painted his sister kneeling toward him even before her transformation. How far back had this canvas been waiting?
He was more and more interested in what this being’s transformation could provide.
He moved forward, and a drop of radiant blood rose into the air before him, crimson gold around its stellar blue heart.
"I want to see if you can be cured by my blood alone. There was a Panacea I was initially going to try, but this may just be better."
Ulf looked at the drop, sickly and small beneath the floating archive of his own visions, and he nodded with dim eyes.

Less than a day ago, curing this being had been an impossibility not worth speaking of. The curse laid upon him traced to one of Those Who Remain, and Noah had told Ryaenara that he could not cure her brother. That doing so would require replacing his entire existence!
And the capability he had designed since was almost exactly that. THE Provenance Blood Mark grasped the very Lifeline of an existence and took it out of every framework, forcefully, into his.
Almost exactly. He was still unsure whether it would work!
The drop of blood went forward, and entered the forehead of Ulf.

The process that began was grand and slow and strangely sacred, crimson gold light sinking through the sick man’s skin in spreading veins, tracing him from crown to chest like dawn moving down a mountain, and behind Noah the figure of Ryaenara watched with apprehensive eyes filled with anxiousness, her hands pressed together!
Noah stayed focused.

The sickly figure of Ulf began to tremble. Lightly, then violently, his thin frame shaking as if seized, his jaw locking, and Noah went forward and put his hand on the head of this being, and gave the whole of his attention to what his blood was finding inside.

"Focus on my voice, and nothing else," Noah said. "Focus on the drop of blood permeating across your existence. You have been given a horrible fate this whole time, just because you can see the future. I need your entire existence to fight alongside me in rejecting this fate. You have autonomy. You have your own choices. Accept this change, and alter your entire weavings of existence."
HUUM!
His voice boomed out and reverberated across the entire Dimension, red gold sky and painted ground trembling with it!

And even as he was finishing, he felt it. A roaring rejection inside the body of Ulf, surging up against his blood, thrashing, almost as if a sliver of something within him was offended by what Noah was doing!
BOOM!
The forehead of Ulf instantly split apart!

His entire skull began to tear along its seams, blood sheeting down his wasted face as he screamed in absolutely horrendous pain, his body arching against Noah’s grip, and Noah felt his Provenance Essence buzz through the whole of him!

He came forward and held the man down even tighter, and he bellowed himself, and multiple more drops of his blood shot out and entered the body of this being one after another, the brilliance of the singularity within his existence shining Quintessentially through every drop!
BOOM!
Noah’s own forehead began to bleed, a line of red opening at his brow as though his skull would crack in answer, pressure for pressure!
He stood grandly and tyrannically through it, and his voice came down like a verdict.
"Merely a leftover curse! The being it was bound to is no longer here, as I have grasped their Lifeline and changed them to something else entirely!"
BOOM!

The words landed, and the thing thrashing inside Ulf thrashed once more, and it was the last thrash of a dying grip, the death throes of a sentence whose subject had been rewritten out from under it. The figure of Ulf trembled violently as he gushed out rivers of blood, everything the Withering had ever put into him leaving at once, Ryaenara crying silently behind them with both hands over her mouth.
And in the next instant, his skin began to close up.

His torn skull sealed. His body began to rise off the ground, wasted limbs filling, and waves of crimson gold light radiated outward from him in rings, rivers of brilliance seething through the air of the Dimension and pouring off him like water off a surfacing thing!
Noah finally let go, and stepped back, and watched.
And around them, the Dimension itself began to protest.

The surrounding weavings of Ryaenara’s Dimension trembled and cracked, thin fractures spidering through the red gold sky, the painted ground groaning, as if existence itself was angry at what was being taken from it!

Ryaenara fell to her knees and spat out blood, her crimson eyes blazing as she poured everything she had into stabilizing the existence around her, because this was her Dimension, her weight to hold, and nothing like this was even supposed to be possible inside it!
Existence was displeased.

A curse written by one of Those Who Remain had reached for its victim and found nothing to hold, because its victim was becoming a brand new existence, outside every ledger where the debt had been recorded!
Then, slowly, everything cooled.

The fractures in the sky sealed. The rivers of brilliance settled and sank inward. And the figure of Ulf was revealed, standing in the air where a dying man had been, radiating an utterly pristine aura.

He was pale, but it was no longer the pallor of sickness. It was the flawless pale of old royalty, skin without a single mark of the Withering anywhere on it. His dark hair fell clean and heavy past a face that had recovered the bones of a much younger man. Andhis eyes had no pupils at all.
They were bathed entirely in swirling crimson gold light, turning slowly, depths without floors, the eyes of something that looked at time the way others looked at weather.
|The marked existence of ULF presents a unique quality.|
|Within his existence resides a singular art, his alone, carried through his bloodline of one. It has been identified: THE REMNANT SEER.|
|Its nature is not yet translated.|
|Due to the uniqueness of this art, the marked existence has achieved the second tier of rarity.|
|ULF has become a Noblesse Blood Apostle of the second tier: BLOOD MONARCH.|
|STATUS PANEL: ULF- NOBLESSE BLOOD APOSTLE, BLOOD MONARCH|
|VERITAS: 2|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: 12|
|PONDUS: 4|
|The First Attribute, excluding you from thr equation, has exceeded 10, and it is the POTENTIA of one of your people.|
The moment his transformation finished, the being descended!
Ulf came down through the red gold air and knelt before Noah, his pristine aura folding around him like a court mantle, his pupil-less eyes raised, and when he spoke, his voice had changed entirely!
It came out measured and turning, every line falling into rhythm, the cadence of a man who no longer spoke words so much as recited what he found already written.
"Oh my Master, crowned in gold, a future glorious, and yet untold! Unthinkable roads lie on your way, but you must guard yourself this day! Oh!"
Ulf seemed...a bit crazed at this moment! Like someone who would look at you crazily while telling you the end of the world was coming!
His pupil-less crimson gold eyes did not helo in making him look like a crazed Seer as he continued.
"Twice you have crossed the elder chain, two workings of Those Who Remain: a Steed was cured against their sign, and now their curse, undone by thine!
Interest builds behind the veil, and some of Those Who Remain now trail. Protect yourself, Master, from what watches and pauses! Move at once. ENACT YOUR CAUSES!"
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5582: Home! I
paragraphs: After his ridiculous eruption and his words that rhymed, Noah looked at Ulf while squinting.

Of course, the seer noticed the look. Ulf blinked, and then scratched his throat with a bit of embarrassment, the royal bearing slipping just enough to show the man underneath it. Perhaps the recitation had come out of him the way a shiver comes out of a body, arriving on its own schedule and asking no one’s permission. He did not seem able to fully control it!
In truth, Noah found himself marveling at the ability of this being more than the delivery. Interest from Those Who Remain, because he had undone two of their actions. That alone was a thought!

The attention of such beings, arriving now, when he had only just begun enacting his own true power, with a single point of PROVENANCE to his name and most of his system still unbuilt. But how much did he actually need to worry? What extent did Ulf’s ability reach? What exactly had he seen, and how much of it could be trusted?
So Noah walked close to the seer. Ulf swallowed hard and took a small step back!
"What limits does your capability have?"Noah asked with interest.
Ulf scratched his head at the question. And when the answer came, it was once again in a rhythmic cadance...almost as if he had a stutter he could not deviate from after his transformation!

"My limits, Master, none have I found, for I was never pushed past ground. A sick man paints what fever shows, and half his life to fever goes. I was sick before, and I am sick no more, and I have not tested what lies in store. But ask your questions, one by one, and I may answer what can be done..."
Would he truly be rhyming every time he talked?
But...

It was a fair answer, all things considered. A man who had spent his whole existence dying had never been given the room to find his ceiling. Compared to testing the limits of an art, asking questions cost nothing, and so Noah chose the question that mattered most.
"You mentioned the attention of Those Who Remain. Can you tell me more about this?"

At that, Ulf’s pupil-less eyes began to release beams of crimson gold brilliance, two soft rivers of light pouring into the air, and around him the floating paintings drifted slowly closer, as if his own old works wished to listen. His voice deepened.

"Those Who Remain are power beyond all measure and name, and no category holds them. They do not move as lifeforms move, in want or fear or plan. Across all history’s turning, they have not moved at all. They send instead their extensions, to answer every call: their progenies, their Descendants, the sentences they spoke, who act across the ages. Never once, in any age, in any war or need, has one among Those Who Remain moved personally. And so their interest, Master, will come the only way it can: their Descendants and their progenies, and even Primeval Ones, will begin to circle, slowly, around your weavings."
The beams from his eyes brightened, and his cadence slowed, giving each line its weight.

"The future I envision now is bright, and yet it bends, unpredictable in all its roads, uncounted in its ends. Yet of the few points narrowing the countless ways I see, the brightest of them all are Causes... and yet not Causes. For what the Master comes to forge is not a Cause at all, but something else entirely, that answers his own call. And I see us, oh Master. Ryaenara. I. The dragon in her crimson, the one-eyed giant. The Undefined Lifeform, the Living Observable Existence too... I see all of us as your extensions, put to use by you, to move where you would not be seen, to mask your weavings’ hue. I am here to serve, my Master. And so are many, many others."
WAA!
Each word he said felt sacred and grand!
The light faded from his eyes, and the paintings drifted back to their stations.
In other words, this highest-rarity Noblesse Blood Apostle among his people was truly unique!

He had always planned to enact his own version of Causes, generated entirely from himself. The only thing that had changed was the schedule. A rhyming man and the circling attention of the oldest things in existence had moved the project to the front of the queue.

After all, the foundations were already laid. He had begun enacting Arts- the Blood Drop that made no distinction between body and framework, the Rune that unfolded his blood into titanic clones across a Dimension, and the Blood Mark that pulled Lifelines out of every framework and had built the very Apostles standing around him.
Beneath all three, he had defined his own Infinite Sanguine Mana, the resource that made the rest possible. Compared to where he had stood a little while ago, he had already come far.

But the other thing he placed the most importance on was understanding his four new attributes. How to pass that ridiculous number of 10, the wall his VERITAS pressed against with every true act. His potential had gone beyond it by infinity, of course, though that felt less like an answer and more like a differently shaped question.
And the Seer in front of him was the first existence apart from himself to pass the value of 10 in any attribute at all, that quiet 12 sitting in his potential like a door nobody had opened.

There should be a grand change when one passed the value of 10. It was too hard a wall for that not to mean something, when even he could not push through it. But was potential different from the others? The other three values correlated to something currently held: power, trueness, Provenance.

And since nobody held Provenance unless they were First Lifeforms, VERITAS and PONDUS were the two values that gave a direct display of the power anyone currently expressed, while POTENTIA pointed only at roads not yet walked!
Perhaps the wall at 10 guarded the actual, and left the possible unguarded. Perhaps potential was allowed to be absurd precisely because it had not happened yet.

There was a lot to understand. And while he was thinking, he found he had begun stroking the necklace on his chest without quite deciding to, thumb moving slowly over bones older than every question he was asking.
At this time, the figure of Ryaenara came over.
She knelt beside her brother and took his head in both hands, and Ulf smiled at her. The siblings held each other, and their foreheads touched, obsidian hair against dark.
The sister spoke softly.

"I was ready to find IT,"she said. "I even bound myself to THE Sealed One, who was chasing after IT, for you. I did not think that I had already found IT... and that it was the Master himself, right here."
Noah came out of his reverie at such words.
Him? IT?

Of course, different things could hold different meanings for many. In this case, plainly enough, she meant that he was the solution she had been hunting this entire time, the cure her whole long deception had been bent toward, found at last standing in her own Dimension. But no. He was not as grand as whatever THE Sealed One was chasing!
Whatever IT was that an antiquity had spent ages hunting, it was not a man who had held his first drop of Provenance for less than a day.
And as he was thinking of this, his eyes began to shine.
Because he began to think about a certain Steed.

Her Causes were transforming. He could sense her as an Apostle, out across THE Ymnaros, and the sense was precise. Everything regarding any framework she had belonged to had been stripped away when she was bound to him. The only thing that was not stripped away was what she already held. Her Causes.
Which were actually her organs.

And he had replaced those very same organs himself, back when he cured her. From cursed ones, to brand new ones that carried his previous Causes within them. He had seated his own work into her flesh, and now that flesh was becoming something that was hers alone, under his authority, outside every framework.

So if he was looking to generate his own version of Causes, not the same idea carried out by THE Sleepless Fiend and the others, not seats installed from outside, then he simply needed to utilize...his organs. Or anything within his existence. Something he had already generated. Something filled with Provenance Essence, grown from it, steeped in it!
The solution was once more within his own existence, just like his blood that he had made into his Infinite resource!

chapters.title: Chapter 5583: Home! II
paragraphs: As he came to his epiphany, Noah’s existence buzzed, and then he felt a tug.

It was not a vague feeling. Something closely connected to him had answered this exact moment, this potential emergence of the equivalent of his Causes, and the answer was coming from inside THE Infiniverse!

Of course, that made a certain sense. Since his grand change, he had cast out nearly everything he held into her, and he had not once entered. His Provenance Essence and his new standing seemed to be causing something there, in the place where all his old treasures slept!
So he turned to the seer first.

"See the limits of your power," Noah said. "Push at them. And prepare for me any further knowledge you can reach regarding the Descendants, THE Sealed One, and Those Who Remain. I will want all of it when I return."
Ulf bowed his head, and beside him Ryaenara straightened as if the instruction included her, which, in truth, it did.
Then Noah tugged back on the unbreakable connection to THE Infiniverse, and disappeared.
He appeared inside an endless sea of blue.

Strings and waves stretched away in every direction without a horizon, currents of deep cerulean light crossing and recrossing through one another, and the immensity of the place pressed in gently from all sides.
This was a core domain of THE Infiniverse, one of her innermost chambers, and only one person was currently in it.
THE Infiniverse herself, in her humanoid form, sat among bubbles.

There were many of them, drifting slowly around her in the blue, and each one held something he had cast out. The Primordial Source turned quietly in one, dense as a swallowed star. His Infinity coiled in another, blue and endless, pressing lightly against its skin. The eighteen Causes drifted in a loose constellation, his nine and Hvitrmarr’s nine, still keeping each other’s company. The Intent, the Pantheon, THE First and Second Infinite Scale, Mana itself. And nearest to her, small and red and beating slowly, THE Amaranthine Heart.
Noah sighed as he looked at it all. An ocean, bottled and shelved, and a caretaker sitting in the middle of it.
Then he turned his gaze to THE Infiniverse herself.

She seemed just as grand as before, if not grander, since his rise had always reflected on her. And yet even she seemed a bit desolate, sitting there in her own depths, staring at the things he had cast out.

She rose when she felt his eyes. She came over to him through the blue, unhurried, and when she reached him she did not bow or report. Instead, she traced one finger along the necklace of bones on his chest, following its curve.

"I inherently know that you would never cast me out, or leave me, or abandon me," she said."I inherently know this. My thought process, my very existence, is a logical one, and this is cemented within my existence. And yet, when you were casting everything out, even your Infinite Mana... a sense of fear rose within me that does not need to be there, and should not even be possible." Her eyes came up to his.
"So even though I logically understand, and know... can you just reassure me?"
Noah’s gaze softened.
Reassurance. Affirmation!
Every single human being needed this, even when they knew. Perhaps especially when they knew, since knowing a thing and feeling it were two different things.
He went to THE Infiniverse and put his hand on the side of her head. She leaned into it and closed her eyes, and the contentment that crossed her face was quiet and grand!
"Even you are displaying more and more human qualities,"Noah said, and he was smiling as he said it.

"In relationships, and I have a few, even though they know they have my love, even though they each know the lengths I would go for them, I am constantly still asked. Just how much do you love me? How much do you care? After all this power and immensity you continue to gain, after all the change you go through over time, do you still care the same as before? Do you still look at us the same as before?"

" I have received all these questions and more, and every single one of them is just looking for affirmation. It is a very human quality. And I am happy to see you displaying it. Because if something like you can also be this human, then it means my path is truly going to be a glorious one, and that boundless many things can, and will, be human."
His hand stayed where it was. "No. I would never cast you out. You are my home, and I am yours."
HUUM!
Their existences buzzed together as he said it, the blue sea around them brightening by a shade, and THE Infiniverse kept her eyes closed, simply feeling her Master’s hand.
After a while, Noah spoke again, quieter now.
"You are the only person so intricately connected to me that you feel every immensity of mine this closely. Can you feel the Provenance Essence?"

"It is not something so simple that it can just be generated because someone casts everything else out. I must have met certain conditions that made it a possibility. After all, I am human, and I was born human. I was not, and am not, among THE First Lifeforms. So I also want to know. Why was I able to generate Provenance Essence? What exact condition did I meet, in addition to casting out everything I held, to make this possible? And since it is something I generated, I cannot transfer it to another. I feel a distinct rejection of what Provenance Essence stands for if I try to extend it toward others. So the question naturally becomes... how can you generate it yourself?"
THE Infiniverse opened her eyes grandly at this.

"Your rise and immensity continue to reflect on THE Infiniverse," she said. "And while I may not be able to generate Provenance Essence... due to the change in your transformation, and your connection to THE Infiniverse..."
She waved her hand.
The endless blue sea of waves and strings parted all around them, currents drawing aside like curtains in a great hall, and what they revealed was a doorway!
Through it poured a scene of utter immensity, and Noah felt his own existence pulling him toward it, a pull that felt familiar and foreign at the same time!
It was a forming domain, surrounded by blue gold brilliance.

"Since I am considered your home," THE Infiniverse said, "your weavings and your Provenance Essence seem to be generating a domain exclusive to you. One that you can truly call home. Even I currently do not know much about it, as I have only felt it forming within me. But it should be something beneficial, and critical, that a First Lifeform should call... home."

chapters.title: Chapter 5584: Home! III
paragraphs: The home of a First Lifeform.
His home.
He began walking toward it, and THE Infiniverse purposely stayed back, her hands folded, as if to let him truly experience this himself!
Noah stepped through the doorway.
And he came out standing...in the first age of existence.

The Realm opened around him in every direction, and the first thing he understood about it was that it could not decide on a size, or rather, that it had decided on two. It read as a homestead. It measured as a Dimension!
His eyes told him he could walk its breadth in a day, and his existence told him the horizon was as far away as the edge of everything, and both reports were true at once!

Blue gold grass rolled away from his feet in long unhurried hills. A river of quiet light moved through the valleys without sound, in no hurry to be anywhere, and where it pooled, the pools held stars.
Standing stones rose from the hilltops in rings, each stone taller than a titan and worn smooth as though generations of hands had rested on them, though no hand ever had.

In the middle distance stood a long hall built of pale stone and heavy dark timber, simple as a shepherd’s house and large enough that a Steed could have walked its aisle with her wings spread, and from its center rose a hearth-smoke that smelled of every fire he had ever came across.
Orchards climbed the far slopes, their fruit unfamiliar and burning with Infinite Sanguine Mana!
And above all of it hung a sky of deep evening blue, holding a single unmoving star, blinding within, silent without, which he did not need to be told was the mirror of the thing in his own chest.

It was simple, having been built before complication was invented. And it was vast the way only his new existence could properly feel. The first humans of the first age, if they had held grand power and a quiet evening, would have lived exactly here.
He walked in slowly, and observed everything, and the Realm observed him back with the settled attention of a house recognizing its owner.
And as he did...
|A Domain linked to your Provenance has formed within THE Infiniverse.|
|It is currently deemed: THE PROVENANCE REALM OF THE FIRST LIFEFORM.|
|It is yours. It generates from your weavings, and it grows from what you are. Its functions have settled as follows.|
|Within the Realm, the concentration of your Provenance Essence increases at a greatly hastened pace. Time within the Realm answers to you, and flows favorably against the outside.|
|Within the Realm, there is no strain in being yourself. It is the one place where the wall your VERITAS presses against may be worked at rest.|
|Within the Realm, your Sanguine Mana is enriched: blood generated here carries a deeper measure of your light.|
|Within the Realm, the design and understanding of your Provenance Arts comes more easily. What takes you hours outside may take you moments here.|
|Anything brought into the Realm, so long as its Lifeline is not entirely shattered, can be healed here.|
|Admittance is yours to grant. Those sharing close ties with you, your close family and your Apostles, may be admitted. All others are refused by the Realm itself regardless of their rank or power.|
|Realm rank: HEARTH. It is the first of known three: HEARTH, HALL, HORIZON. The Realm will rise and become grander as your Provenance Essence increases.|

|A boon of the Realm binds to you as its master. This is your native ground. All Sanguine Mana you have ever shed, wherever it rests across existence, may be called home to its soil, and what returns carries back with it the taste of everything it touched. Blood claimed from your enemies may be given to the Realm, and the Realm will drink it: each draught nourishes the ground, deepens your light, and leaves the drained forever known to your senses. And no wound, weariness, or want survives a night spent under this sky. He who rests in his own ground rises whole.|

|At the rank of HEARTH: should you walk the full breadth of your home, from its first hill to its last, you may attain Inner Peace, and an unknown number of Provenance Essence can be generated within you.|
Inner Peace.

Of course, the prompt had made it sound like a destination, something waiting at the far end of the Realm the way a reward waits at the end of a task. But Noah had lived long enough, and fought through enough, to suspect that peace was not a place a man arrived at!
So he decided he would not hunt it. He would simply walk his home, from its first hill to its last, and see what the walking taught him.
He started where he stood, in the long blue gold grass, and he went slowly.
The first hills rolled under his bare feet without urgency, and he let them set the pace. When had he last moved slowly?
He always moved heavily and with utgency that it seemed he should always be stressed.
There was always one threat after another as peace for him...was a rarity!
Here, for the first time, his feet and his mind were in the same place, and the grass bent and rose behind him as if approving.
At the first ring of standing stones, he stopped and rested his hand on the worn shoulder of the tallest one, and he thought about the past.

The stone was warm. He thought about the Lower Observable Existence that had been taken from him, and the mother who had originated a Cause for his sake, and the graves and the ashes and the long weavings of everything done to him and everything he had done back.
Was peace the settling of all past weavings? He turned the idea over and set it down. No. The records of past weavings would never settle.
He walked on.

At the river of quiet light, he crouched and put his fingers in the current, and he thought about the present. The river moved without sound and without hurry, and in its pools the stars turned slowly, patient as coins at the bottom of a well.

Compared to every water he had ever crossed, this one asked nothing of him.Was peace this, then, the absence of demand? The stillness of a thing with nowhere to be? He watched the light part around his fingers and rejoin on the other side, and set that idea down too.

Stillness was pleasant, but he had met still beings before, sealed ones and seated ones and watchers, and he would not have traded his existence for any of theirs.A man built the way he was built could not make a home out of stillness. He would pace its floors within a day!
He walked on, through the orchards on the far slopes, and he picked one of the unfamiliar fruits and ate it, and it tasted like something he had been missing without knowing its name.

He thought about the people he fed. Seo-yeon. Henry. His mother. The millions in a golden citadel who had looked up at his crown of blood. Was peace their safety? But their safety was his purpose, and purpose was work, and work was not peace, or at least, that was how he had always sorted the two.
It was at the doors of the long hall, with the hearth-smoke drifting over him carrying every fire he had ever sat beside, that the sorting itself came apart in his hands.
Because why had he always placed peace and purpose in separate rooms? Who had taught him that peace was what remained when the work stopped, that a man rested from his purpose?

He stood in the doorway of his own hall and looked back over the whole of his walk, the stones and the river and the orchards and the hills, and the answer assembled itself with the quiet click of a lock that had been waiting!
Peace was not the absence of purpose. Peace was the absence of argument.
HUUM!
At that moment, his existence began to buzz resplendently!

sentences.text: The home of a First Lifeform.
His home.
He began walking toward it, and THE Infiniverse purposely stayed back, her hands folded, as if to let him truly experience this himself!
Noah stepped through the doorway.
And he came out standing...in the first age of existence.
The Realm opened around him in every direction, and the first thing he understood about it was that it could not decide on a size, or rather, that it had decided on two.
It read as a homestead.
It measured as a Dimension!
His eyes told him he could walk its breadth in a day, and his existence told him the horizon was as far away as the edge of everything, and both reports were true at once!
Blue gold grass rolled away from his feet in long unhurried hills.
A river of quiet light moved through the valleys without sound, in no hurry to be anywhere, and where it pooled, the pools held stars.
Standing stones rose from the hilltops in rings, each stone taller than a titan and worn smooth as though generations of hands had rested on them, though no hand ever had.

In the middle distance stood a long hall built of pale stone and heavy dark timber, simple as a shepherd’s house and large enough that a Steed could have walked its aisle with her wings spread, and from its center rose a hearth-smoke that smelled of every fire he had ever came across.
Orchards climbed the far slopes, their fruit unfamiliar and burning with Infinite Sanguine Mana!
And above all of it hung a sky of deep evening blue, holding a single unmoving star, blinding within, silent without, which he did not need to be told was the mirror of the thing in his own chest.
It was simple, having been built before complication was invented.
And it was vast the way only his new existence could properly feel.
The first humans of the first age, if they had held grand power and a quiet evening, would have lived exactly here.
He walked in slowly, and observed everything, and the Realm observed him back with the settled attention of a house recognizing its owner.
And as he did...

chapters.title: Chapter 5585: Home! IV
paragraphs: All his existence, some part of him had been arguing with some other part!

The conqueror argued with the protector. The greed argued with the giving. The man who wanted to gather every human under his fold argued with the man who wondered if he had the right, and the one who could not die argued with the one who was born to.

He had carried those arguments so long that he had mistaken them for his own heartbeat. But here, walking his own ground, under his own star, with nothing borrowed anywhere in him to take anyone else’s side, the arguments had gone quiet one by one.
Quiet. Every part of him, for the first time, agreeing on what he was for.
That was Inner Peace. Not stillness. Coherence.A man entirely aimed!
And in the moment he understood it, the epiphany went through him like dawn going through a valley, and something within him answered.
Deep in the hollow of his existence, beside the first singularity, a second light bloomed.

Nothing about it was violent. It simply began, the way his first had begun, a dazzling point of incandescent blue kindling out of nothing but himself, and then there were two of them, turning slowly around one another in his depths, and their two hums found each other and folded into a single deeper chord that ran through his bones.
A second Provenance Essence!

And the Realm changed in response. He felt it before he saw it: the ground under his feet grew a shade more certain of itself, the grass deepened from blue gold toward something richer, the river brightened along its whole silent length!

The standing stones settled, as though they had been holding a breath since the Realm formed and could finally release it. And above the long hall, in the deep evening sky, a second star kindled beside the first, small and new and blinding within, and the two of them hung together over his home the way his two lights now hung together in his chest.
Noah stood in his doorway for a long moment, at peace, actually at peace, and let himself have it!
Then, being who he was, the first thing he did with his peace was work.

He reached up and removed the necklace from his chest. THE Aurate Collar of the First Purity came away from his skin for the first time since he had put it on before an army, still humming faintly with the refinement his essence had been working into it, and he set it down on the broad stone threshold of his hall, carefully, the way one sets down a sleeping thing.
Then he traced one finger down the center of his chest.

His skin opened along the line. There was no pain in it, and no blood that he did not permit, and no violence at all. Skin, then tissue, then muscle parted smoothly at his instruction, folding aside like the doors of a place he owned, because he did own it, and his chest cavity lay open to the evening light of his Realm.
What glistened inside was worth the looking.

His bones shone stellar, blue gold light living in them the way light lives in deep ice, and among them his organs sat luminous and grand, each one remade by his transformation, each one his beyond any argument, and each one steeped through with the doubled hum of his two lights!
The heart most of all. It beat slow and strong in its place, and every beat sent a faint blue ring through the cavity, and he looked at it the way a founder looks at ground.
He started with his heart.
"From my heart, Quintessence shall bloom once more," Noah said quietly.

"But it will not be a Cause. It will be my... Telos. My Osmontian Provenance Telos. THE Osmontian Provenance Telos of... Quintessence. This will be one of the pillars of my existence. And in time, THE Infinite Cause itself will be replaced, for... THE Infinite Osmontian Telos!"
Telos.

A Cause is where a thing comes from. It is an origin, seated at the beginning of an existence by hands that arrived before it, and everything built on a Cause spends its whole span answering backward, toward the root, toward the seat, toward the question of what made it!
All the frameworks of existence run on that grammar, and all the old powers, THE Sleepless Fiend among them, are gardeners of other beings’ roots.

A Telos is the opposite direction. It is not where a thing comes from, but what a thing is for. Not the root but the aim. An end, chosen and generated by an existence for itself, planted ahead rather than behind, so that every part of that existence stops answering backward to a maker and starts moving forward toward a purpose.
A Cause is given, and can therefore be gripped, cursed, harvested, and owned by whoever did the giving. A Telos is declared, and can only ever be owned by the one who declares it.

The first beings needed no Causes installed at their beginnings, because they were their own beginnings. What they carried instead, if they carried anything, was direction. And a man who had just learned that his peace and his purpose were the same thing was, perhaps, the first existence in ages properly built to carry direction again!
The heart came first, since beginnings mattered!

Noah stood in the doorway of his long hall with his chest open to the evening light, and he began. A thread of Sanguine Mana rose out of the open cavity, drawn from the blood already moving through him, crimson gold and unhurried. Around it, he gathered slivers of his Provenance Essence, thin shavings of incandescent blue peeled carefully from his two turning lights, and this part he did slowly, because the essence resisted being divided the way a name resists being spoken in halves!
He wound the thread and the slivers together, and he laid them against his beating heart, and he spoke the aim into it.
Quintessence.
Not as a word borrowed from a Tongue, though his Tongue carried it. And not as the Cause it used to be, seated once in his old existence. As a direction!

The heart of him would be for the essential, the thing from which every other thing took its measure, and every beat from this one forward would answer that purpose rather than any origin. His blood carried the instruction, his essence carried the authority, and his heart, being his beyond any argument, accepted both.
The change moved across the organ grandly.

The heart’s deep red gained a lacquer of blue gold, light sinking into the muscle rather than sitting on it, and across its surface, rings began to turn. Ring within ring, nested and slow, the same pattern his old fused eyes had once carried, now living on the surface of the organ itself. With every beat, the rings brightened and a low, clean tone went out through his cavity, less a sound than a statement, and the two stars over his hall pulsed faintly in time with it. It no longer looked like an organ that pumped blood. It looked like a small throne that happened to beat!
|THE first Telos has been generated.|
|THE OSMONTIAN PROVENANCE TELOS OF QUINTESSENCE has been generated within your heart. It was declared and your existence has accepted the aim.|
|Your PONDUS has increased. PONDUS: 10.|
|You were Quintessentially true to your existence. Your VERITAS elevated tremendously, but has not been able to climb past the value of 10.|
Ten, and ten!
Two of his four measures now stood at that stubborn number, and the wall had not moved for either of them!
Of course, he knew exactly which aims came next. He had carried nine Prime Causes once, before the casting out!

Existence. Paradox. Chaos. Mana. Adversity. Tyranny. Harvest. Apocalypse. And Quintessence, already reborn and beating. Those nine had been his work carved in the shape of somebody else’s idea, and he did not intend to copy them back. He intended to answer them, each old origin reborn as an aim, pointed forward instead of planted behind.
The liver came second.

There was a debt in that choice! Once, in the war inside Hvitrmarr, he had died, and it was his liver, THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root, that had rebuilt him from a single pulse in an ocean of nothing, self first and flesh after. The organ that had once held the whole of his being in reserve now received the aim of being itself. Existence!

Seated where his existence had once been kept safe, so that from this day the deepest purpose of his flesh was simply, stubbornly, to be, and to go on being, past any argument the outside cared to make. The organ took the thread and the slivers and turned a deep steady gold!

His spine took Paradox, and he found he liked the symmetry: a spine whose aim was to carry opposing weights without breaking, conquest and protection, greed and giving, the mortal and the endless, all stacked on one column that would hold them because holding contradictions upright was now what it was for!

His marrow took Chaos, raw potential seated in the place where his blood was born, so that everything generated from his depths would rise out of the unformed the way the first things rose, answering no pattern but the one he gave it!

His lungs took Adversity, the breath before every charge, so that hardship itself became a thing he inhaled and was fed by, which, in fairness, had been true of him since an F Rank Hunter first refused to die regardless.

His stomach took Apocalypse, transformative endings seated inside the furnace of him, destruction held as a tool by discipline. His tongue took Mana, the old external ocean reborn as an aim of pure expression, so that speaking, casting, declaring, the whole grammar of power he had once borrowed, now lived in flesh as something he generated!

His hands took Harvest, the gathering aim, everything flowing to him and everything given flowing back grander, seated in the two instruments that had done all his life’s taking and all its giving alike.
And his eyes, last of the nine, took Tyranny.

He considered that one longest before seating it. Tyranny was a word other beings used about him with fear, and he used about himself without apology. Once it seated, to be looked at by him would carry weight, the gaze of a will that bent for nothing, before which existence itself tended to straighten and behave.
His obsidian singularity pupils drank the thread and the slivers, gained the faintest turning ring of gold at their event horizons, and the matter was settled!
HUUM!

Nine organs. Nine aims. Nine Teloi standing where nine Causes had once grown, the same nine names reborn in a new grammar, except that nothing had been planted in him by anyone, and everything pointed forward instead of back.
And when the ninth settled, his entire existence began to vibrate.

It started in the marrow and rose. Every seated Telos brightened at once, heart and liver and spine and marrow and lungs and stomach and tongue and hands and eyes, nine lights waking in one body and discovering one another, and the undulation that moved through him was less like power and more like agreement, immensity rolling through his frame in long slow waves as the whole architecture of him rang on a single note for the first time!
The grass of his Realm lay down in rings around the hall. The river of light stood still in its bed to listen. The standing stones leaned inward by a width no instrument would ever catch!
Nine aims, one direction. A man with a semblance of Inner Peace entirely aimed, now all the way down to his organs.
And in the hollow of his existence, beside the two turning lights, a third bloomed!

It came the way the second had come, without violence, kindling out of nothing but himself, and the moment it opened, the chord of his hum deepened again, three lights turning about one another now in a slow braided orbit, and above the long hall a third star kindled in the evening sky, and his Realm grew a shade more certain of itself from its first hill to its last!
A total of three Provenance Essence!
Noah closed his chest with a trace of his finger, skin and muscle folding shut over nine quiet thrones, and he stood in his doorway breathing his own hearth-smoke, and he waited as immensity bloomed!
|An advancement past 10 has begun to occur for VERITAS and PONDUS.|

Tyranny was a word other beings used about him with fear, and he used about himself without apology.
Once it seated, to be looked at by him would carry weight, the gaze of a will that bent for nothing, before which existence itself tended to straighten and behave.
His obsidian singularity pupils drank the thread and the slivers, gained the faintest turning ring of gold at their event horizons, and the matter was settled!
HUUM!
Nine organs.
Nine aims.

Nine Teloi standing where nine Causes had once grown, the same nine names reborn in a new grammar, except that nothing had been planted in him by anyone, and everything pointed forward instead of back.
And when the ninth settled, his entire existence began to vibrate.
It started in the marrow and rose.

Every seated Telos brightened at once, heart and liver and spine and marrow and lungs and stomach and tongue and hands and eyes, nine lights waking in one body and discovering one another, and the undulation that moved through him was less like power and more like agreement, immensity rolling through his frame in long slow waves as the whole architecture of him rang on a single note for the first time!
The grass of his Realm lay down in rings around the hall.
The river of light stood still in its bed to listen.
The standing stones leaned inward by a width no instrument would ever catch!
Nine aims, one direction.
A man with a semblance of Inner Peace entirely aimed, now all the way down to his organs.
And in the hollow of his existence, beside the two turning lights, a third bloomed!

It came the way the second had come, without violence, kindling out of nothing but himself, and the moment it opened, the chord of his hum deepened again, three lights turning about one another now in a slow braided orbit, and above the long hall a third star kindled in the evening sky, and his Realm grew a shade more certain of itself from its first hill to its last!
A total of three Provenance Essence!
Noah closed his chest with a trace of his finger, skin and muscle folding shut over nine quiet thrones, and he stood in his doorway breathing his own hearth-smoke, and he waited as immensity bloomed!
|An advancement past 10 has begun to occur for VERITAS and PONDUS.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5586: Unperceivable! I
paragraphs: Noah rose from the threshold of his hall, and looked out over his Realm, and felt the wall come down!
It came down one grain at a time and then all at once, and the two attributes that had pressed against it for so long, his VERITAS and his PONDUS, moved past 10 together, side by side!
He stood very still while it happened as he had to sense everything.
The first change was growth. Actual growth, as parts of his body...grew!
His existence was generating Appendages.

Of course, Appendages were his thing for a little while now. When he cast everything out beneath the falling sky, he had assumed that whole Chapter of his anatomy had gone into the bubbles with the rest. But that assumption, it turned out, had been selling them short.
Because the backbones of the Appendages had never been external at all.

The Pinion Vigil had watched because he was a being who watched. The Estuary Eye had drunk the weavings of past and future because he was a being who refused to be surprised by time. The Hepatarch of the Undying Root had rebuilt him from a single pulse because he was, at his floor, a thing that did not agree to end!

The boons had only ever been scaffolding around instincts that were his from the start, and his existence had quietly preserved those backbones through the casting out, waiting for when they could rebuild them out of proper material.
That time was now, and the material was him!
He felt THE Estuary Eye emerge first, reopening somewhere in the depths of his existence, and it was now an eye of incandescent blue, its currents running with his own light!
THE Pinion Vigil unfurled second! And THE Hepatarch came third, settling back into its deep seat beside the Telos of Existence like an old guard dog lying down next to a young one!
And then, with the three old instincts generated, his existence built something new.
It began across his shoulders and his back, though calling it a location was already a simplification.

He felt a vast structure condense out of his crossed PONDUS, invisible and immense, a yoke of blue gold force settling across shoulders that were suddenly broad enough for it, and when it finished settling, Noah rolled his shoulders once, slowly, and the ground of his Realm flexed beneath him in sympathy.
|Your VERITAS has crossed. VERITAS: 11.|
|Your PONDUS has crossed. PONDUS: 11.|
|Your existence has begun generating PROVENANCE APPENDAGES: anatomy grown from nothing but yourself, in the manner of THE First Lifeforms.|

|Three Appendages of your old existence carried backbones that stemmed truly from you. They have been preserved, and are reborn: THE ESTUARY EYE, THE PINION VIGIL OF THE UNBROKEN GAZE, and THE HEPATARCH OF THE UNDYING ROOT. They are currently transforming as their elevated capabilities are not yet known.|
|A new Provenance Appendage has been generated from the crossing of your PONDUS.|
|THE YOKE OF THE STANDING SKY.|

|It is the appendage of bearing. What cannot be lifted, you may take up: a wound, a curse, a dying Cause, a burning region, A Dimension, an Observable Existence, the weight pressing on another’s existence. What you take up, you carry, and while you carry it, it presses on no one else. What you carry, you may set down where you choose, and what you set down, you may take up again. The limit of what the Yoke may bear is the limit of your PONDUS.|
It was...somewhat a unique one as its usage was not entirely clear!
He had once knelt under a descending sky with his palms against its underside, and pushed it back up. This appendage seemed capable of allowing him to bear such a heaby weight like that freely!
Could he lift an entire Observable Existence or Dimension freely with this? And just lift, or do much more?
But the prompts were not finished, and neither was the crossing, because beneath the new anatomy, he felt a different kind of power rising!
It felt like something...inviolable.
|The crossing of an attribute past 10 grants a PRECEPT.|

|A Precept is an undeniable rule that an existence writes about itself. It is not a technique, and it is not an aim. It is a standing rule, always in force, which the surrounding weave of existence must simply work around. Precepts are not chosen. They are earned: your existence drafts them from how you have actually lived. They arrive as COMMON, RARE, or UNIQUE.|
|Two attributes have crossed simultaneously. In place of two lesser Precepts, your existence has written one law of the highest order.|
|THE PRECEPT OF SOLIPSISM. UNIQUE.|

|You are imperceivable to any lifeform whose VERITAS and PONDUS do not both stand at 10 or above. And what cannot perceive you, cannot harm you: from all such existences, you are immune to harm in every form it takes. In turn, what was imperceivable to you begins now to be perceived.|
What?
Noah stood with that for a long moment!
SOLIPSISM!
He felt it settle over him as an invisible glow of power, sourceless and total, wrapping his existence!
But more than that, and stranger than that, was the last clause on this newly budding Precept.What was imperceivable to you begins now to be perceived.
Because everything around him was growing unfathomably brighter.

It came in gradually as his vision expanded. The blue gold hills stayed the blue gold hills. The river of light stayed the river. But through them, over them, woven among them at every height, he began to see something new: shimmering stellar white rivers of light, flowing all around.
They were everywhere!

They ran through the air of his Realm in slow braided currents, some as fine as thread and some as broad as roads, crossing the hills, pouring soundlessly over the standing stones, threading between the orchards, a whole second geography of white brilliance laid over the first, and it had all been here the entire time.
He had walked the full breadth of his home, first hill to last, at peace, observing everything. And he had seen none of it!
He reached out toward the nearest current, slowly.
And he touched it.
|You have perceived THE ARGENT LOOM.|

|It is an authority present throughout nature, flowing across Dimensions, Observable Existences, and the spaces between: the loomlight from which the higher weave is threaded.It is perceivable only to lifeforms of extremely high Dimensionality. To all others, it does not exist.|

|Those who perceive it use it. Some forge with it: constructs, domains, armaments, and treasures threaded from raw loomlight. Others, who are not Provenance Lifeforms, draw it into their existences and refine themselves upon it, ascending their Dimensionality through what they take in.|
|You are perceiving it for the first time. You are not the first to perceive it, far from it.|
HUUM!
The current ran over his fingers, cool and dense and old!
Something he didn’t even know about flowed here! In his Realm, born moments ago from his own weavings, and the Argent Loom already ran its white roads as though it!

Which meant it likely flowed across THE Infiniverse, through her seas and her thousand realms, past the bubbles of everything he had cast out. It flowed, presumably, through THE Ymnaros, over tbr Observable Existences within it. and over the Golden Expanse and its citadel of millions, past his floating clones....
It had been there through the whole of his existence, and he simply had not known it was there!
He drew his hand back slowly, and looked out across his Realm at the white rivers threading through everything.
With this new sight, what else was flowing, right now, through the places he thought he knew?
And if one authority this vast had been running invisibly through his whole life, right before him, close enough to touch...
What things existed out there, right before him, that he still could not see?

chapters.title: Chapter 5587: Unperceivable! II
paragraphs: Noah stepped back out through the glowing door of his Realm, and THE Infiniverse was waiting for him.
She floated beside the doorway in her endless blue sea, hands folded, eyes on the light. And she did not turn to him!
Because she could not see him.

He stood before her in the blue, close enough to count the strands of her hair, and her eyes rested on the doorway behind him, patient and unaware. THE Infiniverse. His companion, his home, the one existence so intricately connected to him that she felt his every immensity!
Her VERITAS and her PONDUS did not both stand at 10, and so, by a law his own existence had written, he was not in her reality at all.
Of course, he could make himself perceivable at any time. He felt the permission sitting in the Precept, his to grant with a thought. But he wanted to explore this state first.
So he raised his hand, and placed it on her cheek, the same way he had placed it not long ago when she had asked him for reassurance.
And...
Nothing. Her eyes did not move. Her breath did not change. His palm rested against her cheek and her existence reported an empty sea!
Was this...human?
To not be seen by others, once one reached enough of a height. Had that not always been the arrangement?

A father worked heights his children never perceived. A mother carried weights her whole house walked past daily. Every leader he had ever known became less visible the higher they rose, until their people saw the crown clearly and the man not at all!
Perhaps existence had not invented anything new for him. Perhaps it had only taken the oldest loneliness of the human condition and written it down formally, with clauses.
And yet.
She had asked him to reassure her, even though she logically knew.

Knowing a thing and feeling it were two different things. Was that not the answer sitting right in front of him? Humans climbed, and humans went unseen, and then humans came back down and put their hands on each other’s faces and made themselves perceivable again, over and over, every day.
He drew his hand back slowly, and left.
And behind him, THE Infiniverse blinked. Her hand rose, and touched her own cheek, and stayed there a moment, her brows drawing together over an empty sea.
Noah took a step, and crossed thousands of Realms.
He came out standing in the warm air of a farmland realm, gold fields running to the horizon under a kind afternoon sky, and he heard them before he saw them.
Laughter. A long table set outside a farmhouse, crowded with food and more crowded with people. Henry sat sprawled at one end, blue-gold hair catching the light.

Seo-yeon sat cross-legged on the bench beside Amelia, stealing food off her grandmother’s plate. Barbatos and Adelaide argued warmly over a pitcher. Naldine, Titano, Sigrid, and half a dozen others filled out the benches, and the whole table had the settled, unhurried noise of people enjoying themsleves!
Noah floated near them, unperceived, and watched his family eat.
Amelia was smiling as her hand was on her chest, no doubt sensing the newly revamped Causes that were now Telos, oh which she was an Originator of still.
And her eyes went, briefly, to the empty place that had been set at the head of the table.
Seo-yeon paused. Her head tilted a fraction, and for one breath her gaze drifted through the air near him, past him, through him, searching for something she could not name.
Noah stayed longer than he had planned to.
He did not make himself perceivable.
He had many thoughts crossing his mind as...he took another step.
He came out among endless volcanic mountains.

Crimson blue infinity churned through the ranges, rivers of burning power running down black slopes, the sky above lit from below. And near the peak of the nearest mountain, small against all of it, sat the crying figure of Emotive.
Her manic emotions buzzed around her in ragged loops, joy and grief and fury tangled past sorting, and she was doing something with her hands. Taking things out of herself!

Portions of her Everythings, drawn out one after another, glimmering pieces of what she was and what she owned, and she was throwing them into the burning lava below, one by one, and repeating the same words with each throw.
"You don’t deserve love. You have done too much... this is why he threw away your heart...!"
Noah had not thought Emotive would take it this hard!
He made himself perceivable instantly.
Emotive blinked.
Her head came up, and she looked at him floating there in the burning light, and instead of stopping, she cried harder, her whole body shaking, and her voice came out manic and small at once!
"Am I...deserving of any love? Of anything at all?"
Noah came down.
He crossed the black slope and wrapped his arms around her, and she was rigid in them!

"I am sorry I didn’t communicate in advance.I cast out many things from myself. The Source. My Infinity. The heart. But I did not cast them out because I did not want them. I cast them out because my existence had to generate everything truly from itself, and it could not do that in a space already full. What I set down is kept, and safe, and not one piece of it was thrown away."He drew back just far enough to look at her.
"You, and all the others, are deserving of all the love and happiness you could want. Okay?"
Emotive’s face crumpled entirely.
She crashed into his chest and hugged him and cried, loudly, gracelessly, her manic emotions collapsing one by one into plain ordinary weeping!
The lava churned below them. The crimson blue infinity rolled through the mountains.
And then his gaze suddenly changed.
His head came up, and his eyes went distant, because far away, something had just happened.

Above THE Golden Expanse within THE Ymnaros, his clone floated where it had floated since the pledge. And his clone had changed with him. It, too, had become something that could not be perceived. It, too, could now perceive what Noah could not perceive before, the white rivers, the second geography, the layer of existence that had been running silently over everything all along.
And it had just looked up.
Because hanging above the endless skies of THE Ymnaros, in that layer no eye below the law could see, there was something terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 5588: Unperceivable! III
paragraphs: Above THE Golden Expanse, in the layer of existence that no eye below the law could see, something was hanging in the endless skies of THE Ymnaros as the gaze of THE True Human Emperor rose to meet it!
And it was vaster than an Observable Existence.

Noah looked at it through his clone as the looking itself took time, because the thing did not end! It was a single living thing, deep stellar purple in color, and its body stretched past the horizon in every direction as it kept going past the horizon after that, so vast that an entire Observable Existence could have been lost inside it!
And its shape was a simple one to grasp, because it closely mimicked something like a massive bacteria or virus.
Its head was a huge many-sided shell of flat purple plates fitted together, hanging directly above THE Golden Expanse.

From under that head, long thin jointed legs reached down for thousands of miles, and each leg ended in millions of hair-fine threads that spread out across the sky of the domain below! Its long body was see-through in places, and inside that clear purple skin, small violet lights drifted and churned in slow waves, glowing brighter and dimmer as the whole terrifying presense of it pulsed and fed.
Because its jaws were open!
Under the many-sided head, the plates had pulled apart into a huge open mouth as it was drinking, and Noah could see the intake now with his new sight.

Thin ribbons of color were rising up off the entire Golden Expanse below, off the citadel of millions, off the pledged thousands, off every survivor of the war! Their worry. Their pain. Their misery. And even their happiness, the new fragile hope of a domain that had just stopped burying its dead, all of it being pulled up in slow threads into the open mouth of a thing none of them would ever know was there...!
HUUM!

|Identity: a WOE CULTURE. A vast lifeform of the unseen layer.Woe Cultures are relatively harmless lifeforms in themselves: they do not hunt, they do not conquer, and they do not devour bodies. They latch above gatherings of lifeforms and siphon the happiness, anxieties, pain, and miseries of all those around. However: tendrils of its power permeate out across nearby existence, altering probability, and calling in more conflict and adversity to the region it has latched onto. Where a Woe Culture feeds, wars arrive more often, tragedies align more easily, and grief is harvested at its ripening. This nature sits at their core. It is simply who they are. They are not particularly powerful. They will preserve themselves if attacked...|
|STATUS PANEL: WOE CULTURE|
|VERITAS: 12|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: 11|
|PONDUS: 11|
Twelve!
A VERITAS above his own!

It hung fat and glowing over his domain with a Trueness that surpassed him, and of course it was twelve, of course, because the thing was perfectly true to itself! It had no doubts about its nature and no arguments inside its endless body as it fed on sorrow and farmed sorrow to feed on, never once questioning either.
And the tendrils!

The probability-tendrils spread across the sky of THE Golden Expanse were quietly bending the odds of an entire region toward conflict as horrendous questions bloomed one after another. How long had it hung here? How many of the age-cycles of war that had emptied the family graves of Superpowered Lifeforms, one generation after another, had simply been harvest seasons arranged by the thing above the clouds?
The clone of THE True Human Emperor looked at it with a furious gaze as when it came to what exactly he should do here, his existence already knew it clearly.
A thing was farming his people.

In the next second, eight more Provenance Sanguine Clones tore into the unseen layer out of folds of crimson gold as they appeared behind the first, titanic and shamanic and glorious as crowns of blood turned above nine heads!
Nine bloody staffs rose as one, and at the tip of each, a drop of blood formed, crimson gold around stellar blue!
Sanguine Blood Drop!
Nine drops popped!
BOOM!
A battle bloomed...that those around could not even see.

The unseen sky of THE Ymnaros turned crimson gold from horizon to horizon as event horizons bloomed in their uncounted numbers across the stellar purple bulk, twisting force of infinite density detonating along light years of skin and plate! And below, in the seen world, not one soul of THE Golden Expanse felt so much as a breeze as the war above them did not exist in their Dimensionality at all.
The Woe Culture convulsed!

Its many-sided head snapped around as its plates ground against each other, and across its vast surface the violet motes froze mid-churn as Noah felt its attention arrive on his clones carrying something he had not expected from a thing that size.
Shock!
It blinked in its fashion, every mote going dark at once and relighting, because it had been perceived.
Something below had seen it, and things below did not see it, had never seen it, in all the long ages of its grazing!
Then it preserved itself.
Its retaliation came in its own grammar, and its grammar was corruption.

The long thin legs snapped up off the domain’s sky and drove down at the clones as hollow lances longer than mountain ranges struck at crimson gold flesh, and they did not cut, they injected, violet code flooding toward his blood as it tried to rewrite what it touched into more of itself!

Patches of its see-through skin swelled and burst in silent blooms as clouds of glimmering spore-motes latched onto whatever they met and began to replicate, doubling, quadrupling, purple frost spreading across the arms of two clones!
Sheets of dissolving fluid sluiced from its jaws as they unmade the very weave where they fell, and beneath all of it, the probability-tendrils turned on him.
But his blood did not take instruction!

The violet code flooded into Sanguine Mana and found nothing it was permitted to rewrite! The spore-frost spread across crimson gold and instsntly stopped, starved, because his blood answered no authority but his own!

The clones circled the endless body in wide burning arcs as their staffs swept and the barrage did not pause, Sanguine Blood Drops falling in continuous rhythm as they tore gorges of crimson through stellar purple, whole plates of its many-sided head shearing away and dissolving as thousands of miles of its body collapsed in slow silence!
And midway through its tearing, the thing spoke.
Its voice boomed through the unseen layer, heavy and vast and genuinely puzzled.
"Why attack me, Little One? We are all simply moving in accordance with our nature across existence."
Noah answered through nine mouths at once, and his voice came out tyrannically calm.

"I reject your nature. Do you understand what you hang above? Lifeforms who bury their children and cannot say why the wars keep coming. Countless many have died across the ages, bled out in conflicts your tendrils arranged, grieving on schedule so that your jaws would not go empty. Their miseries were your farmland. I reject it. Wholly."
The motes of the Woe Culture churned slowly, and when it answered, there was no cruelty anywhere in it, and there was no comprehension either.
"So... what? Lifeforms live, and lifeforms die. It is nature. It is...existence"
Oh!
"Then let me enforce nature,"Noah said as nine staffs rose together, "and give you your death!"
BOOM!
The barrage redoubled as gorges became canyons across the endless purple!
And the Woe Culture became infuriated!

Every mote down its lighy years flared violet-white at once as its grammar changed! Its long thin legs spread wide as fields of hair-fine threads opened across the whole unseen sky, and it reached, not for the clones, but for the rivers!

The endless white authority of THE Argent Loom answered it! Currents that had flowed serenely through the battle bent out of their courses and poured toward the vast body as white rivers wrapped around its long legs and gathered into its open jaws, threading through the wounds in its body as loomlight knitted across the crimson canyons!

And along its many-sided head, the gathered white began to weave, strand crossing strand at terrifying speed as lances and lattices and turning wheels of pure stellar white assembled above THE Golden Expanse, authority older than the frameworks bending into weapons!

sentences.text: Above THE Golden Expanse, in the layer of existence that no eye below the law could see, something was hanging in the endless skies of THE Ymnaros as the gaze of THE True Human Emperor rose to meet it!
And it was vaster than an Observable Existence.
Noah looked at it through his clone as the looking itself took time, because the thing did not end!

It was a single living thing, deep stellar purple in color, and its body stretched past the horizon in every direction as it kept going past the horizon after that, so vast that an entire Observable Existence could have been lost inside it!
And its shape was a simple one to grasp, because it closely mimicked something like a massive bacteria or virus.
Its head was a huge many-sided shell of flat purple plates fitted together, hanging directly above THE Golden Expanse.
From under that head, long thin jointed legs reached down for thousands of miles, and each leg ended in millions of hair-fine threads that spread out across the sky of the domain below!

Its long body was see-through in places, and inside that clear purple skin, small violet lights drifted and churned in slow waves, glowing brighter and dimmer as the whole terrifying presense of it pulsed and fed.
Because its jaws were open!
Under the many-sided head, the plates had pulled apart into a huge open mouth as it was drinking, and Noah could see the intake now with his new sight.
Thin ribbons of color were rising up off the entire Golden Expanse below, off the citadel of millions, off the pledged thousands, off every survivor of the war!
Their worry.
Their pain.
Their misery.

And even their happiness, the new fragile hope of a domain that had just stopped burying its dead, all of it being pulled up in slow threads into the open mouth of a thing none of them would ever know was there...!
HUUM!
|Identity: a WOE CULTURE.
A vast lifeform of the unseen layer.Woe Cultures are relatively harmless lifeforms in themselves: they do not hunt, they do not conquer, and they do not devour bodies.
They latch above gatherings of lifeforms and siphon the happiness, anxieties, pain, and miseries of all those around.
However: tendrils of its power permeate out across nearby existence, altering probability, and calling in more conflict and adversity to the region it has latched onto.
Where a Woe Culture feeds, wars arrive more often, tragedies align more easily, and grief is harvested at its ripening.
This nature sits at their core.
It is simply who they are.
They are not particularly powerful.
They will preserve themselves if attacked...|
