And beneath the fear sat something warmer and greedier, because a Descendant of Those Who Remain stood at speaking distance offering open access to his own existence, and Noah was so, so curious about what such a being held within!
The foamy dark had gone very quiet.
Nine clones hung in a loose ring around the throne-saddle, and the last Steed stood trembling beneath its Jarl with its head lowered, and the silence stretched until it had a weight of its own.
Then Noah spoke.
"I can cure you."
The Jarl’s eyes pulsed audibly in the dark as this...was all it wanted!
It wanted to be cured!
It wanted to live...no matter what.
"But I’ll need access to your existence,"Noah continued.
"All of it.
Opened to me, unresisting.
Nothing between my work...and what you are."
Skallagrim stared at him across the dark for a long moment.
"Do you know what it is," he said quietly, "to spend a thousand years planning the possibility of a single cure?"
"...." Noah gazed out wordlessly.
"I built that plan the way other beings build empires.
I watched Hvitrmarr.
I waited on her.
I whipped eight of my own steeds to death crossing the dark after the trail of it."His hands opened slowly on the chains.
"And now I sit at the end of everything, at the end of my life, waiting for that cure.
I cannot really say no, can I?
But I can watch and observe as if there is any trickery...I have no qualms taking both of us down.
You may not know, but I...am immense."
HUUM!
"Do what needs to be done." Skallagrim leaned back on his throne-saddle and spread his arms wide, chest bared to the dark, in the oldest gesture there was.
The gesture said...come!
The heaviness of that moment settled over the foamy black!

A Cursed Descendant, terror of the Krazhor-Nul, a being wearing a VERITAS of nineteen, sitting open-handed and undefended before the thing he had once hunted, and the ring of clones tightened around him, slow and wide, crowns of blood turning!
Below the throne, the last Steed shifted, and its small voice came up through the chains.
"J-Jarl... are we truly doing this...?
The Great Father asked for information.
We cannot go against...!"
"Quiet, little steed." There was almost gentleness in it.
"We are already done doing everything else as this...will be a salvation I grasp myself.
Father has watched us die for Eons.
Sometimes, you need to move yourself.
Noah raised a hand, and his blood answered.
Drops rose around the clones in their dozens, and then they changed!

Each drop drew itself long and thin, crimson gold flowing into edges, stellar blue running down each spine, and where a rain of detonations had once hung above a Woe Culture, there now hung a surgeon’s array of slender crimson blades!
"Don’t move," Noah said.
"However deep I go.
A tremble in the wrong place becomes a grave...."
The Jarl closed his eyes and said nothing as Noah felt the grand aura of immensity of being this close to a Cursed Descendant!
If he was not burning with Provenance Essence...he may have felt suffocation of royalty and majesty!
But as he was now...he only felt a...lower kind of regality as his regality far exceeded a Descendant.
The blades descended, and began to cut a Cursed Descendant open.

They worked in silence, parting rotted skin and fissured frame in exact lines, folding the Jarl’s chest open to the dark the way Noah had once folded his own, and Skallagrim endured it awake and unflinching, rotten breath dragging through his teeth, and the dark pressed in around the work, and the Steed below did not dare to breathe!
And as Noah’s senses poured into the opened existence, the Jarl surprisingly talked, because dying men at the edge of salvation cannot sit inside a silence that long.
"While you work... let a dying man ask something."
"Ask what?"
"Who... are you?
Really."His voice came out low and labored."I’ve turned you over in my mind since the Krazhor-Nul.
I turned you over harder after you almost vanished out of every sense I own, and even here, I could barely perceive you..."
"Does it matter who I am?"
"It matters." The shining eyes cracked open.
"Look at where your hands are, Cure-Giver.
You are inside a Descendant of THE Sleepless Fiend, unmaking a working of one of Those Who Remain, while their attention gathers on your name.
Nothing weak would do that.
Nothing without history behind it would even dream to.
So what are you?
A Descendant of some other line, raised wild where no one could collar you?
Something older?"
A pause, and quieter: "What stands behind you... that your hands do not shake while you defile the sentance of one of Those Who Remain?"
Noah did not look up from the work.
"Nothing stands behind me."
"I am human, and I stand behind everything that is mine."His blades turned, and cut deeper!
The Jarl was silent for a long moment after that, opened to the dark, bleeding into the black.
"A human,"he repeated at last, softly, and there was no mockery in it at all.
"Existence has a vile sense of humor."
WAA!
And what Noah found inside Jarl Skallagrim was unlike anything he had ever opened!
There were... no Causes.
He had half-expected the architecture of the Steeds, organs seated with ancient suns, and there was none of it!
Where Hvitrmarr’s structure had been anatomy, the inner existence of a Descendant was WRITING!

Through the whole of the Jarl, through frame and weavings and depths, there ran a single unbroken line of script, dense and dark and terribly old, written in an authority Noah could not read, and it did not begin at Skallagrim’s birth!

It ran backward out of him, out of his existence entirely, threading away into distances Noah’s senses could not follow, through father and father and father, one continuous written thing stretching all the way back to the hand that had designed the line and mixed them with many other things!
A sentence with a bloodline.
Ulf had mentiomed something close to this!
And here it was, literal, a lineage that was one long sentence written across generations, and Jarl Skallagrim was simply its current clause!
’So this is what a Descendant is...’
And wound through that clause, black and gnawing, was the curse.
It did not sit anywhere.
It had no seat to sit in!

It was written INTO the line itself, a counter-writing braided through the lineage-script along its whole visible length, annotation upon annotation of ending, and Noah traced the remaining unwritten span of Skallagrim’s clause and felt his expression harden, because the span was short.
Months.
This being had a matter of months to live!
Months, on such a terrifyingly powerful existence, a VERITAS of nineteen with its conclusion already drafted!
And then Noah saw the third thing, and his eyes narrowed in the dark.
Coiling WITH the curse, braided through the black counter-writing along every length of it, ran rivers of white.
THE Argent Loom!

Thin threads of that stellar white authority, the same rivers that flowed through his Realm and his Dimension and the whole higher weave of nature, wound intimately through the curse of a Descendant, white through black through the written line, and question after question stacked up behind Noah’s eyes!
Why was the Loom braided into a curse of Those Who Remain?
Did the speakers work the loomlight when they wrote their sentances?
Had the curse captured the rivers, or had the rivers been the ink all along?
The Woe Culture utilized the Argent Loom.
And now it coiled inside the oldest curse he had ever opened.
Hvitrmarr had carried her curse in her Causes, and her Causes in her organs, and he had cured her by replacing anatomy.
But Skallagrim had no Causes.
There was no seat to empty, no organ to regrow, no anchor to starve!
The curse was applied directly to who he was.
To the written line.
To his lineage!
So for Noah to cure him... he would have to reach into the sentence of THE Sleepless Fiend itself, and mess with, and alter, the lineage of a Descendant, fully!

chapters.title: Chapter 5595: Primevals and Descendants!
paragraphs: Nine clones drew closer around the opened Descendant, crowns of blood turning slowly, and Noah studied the written line running through Jarl Skallagrim with the interest of a man who had just been handed a language older than every framework he had ever broken!
The plan assembled itself as he looked.
He could not read the script of Those Who Remain. Fine!

He did not need to read it. He needed to REPLACE it! Where the curse’s counter-writing braided through the lineage-line, where the Argent Loom coiled white through the black, he would lay down his Blood Marks as anchors, and then, clause by careful clause, he would swap out the bound lengths of an ancient sentence with material of his own.With his Infinite Sanguine Mana. With his own Osmontian Tongue.
With his words!

But which words? THE MORTAL COIL was a Word of endings and mortality, and it belonged in this work, but it was not enough alone. This was a matter of lineage. Of inheritance. Of a line of descent that had been written for its bearers instead of by them, and against that, he needed something new.
So, hands steady in the opened existence of a Cursed Descendant, Noah began to design the second Word of his Tongue.
’Lineage... and humanity.’
He built it from what he knew to be true. Humans inherited. Blood, faces, tempers, debts.
No human chose the line they were born into, and in that much, humans and Descendants were kin. But there the kinship ended!

Because a human’s inheritance was a beginning, not a verdict. A human took the blood handed down and wrote their own fate with it, and their children would write theirs, and no ancestor’s hand, however old, reached forward to finish anyone’s sentence for them!
A lineage was supposed to be a gift passed forward, not a leash held backward!

The Letters of his Tongue turned around the thought. HUMAN. I AM. And between them, meaning condensed into sound, and sound into a Word, and Noah spoke it silently into his own depths and felt his whole Tongue accept it!
HUUM!
|THE Osmontian Tongue has expanded.|
|A second Word has been designed: THE UNBOUND LINEAGE.|

|Its meaning: a line of descent belongs to those who live it. Every clause of a lineage is written by its own bearer, and no hand behind may finish the sentence of one who breathes. Where this Word settles, inheritance becomes a gift, and ceases to be a verdict.|
|THE MORTAL COIL and THE UNBOUND LINEAGE may be expressed together.|
Noah’s eyes gleamed in the dark, and he went to work!

His blades of blood thinned further, becoming instruments finer than any edge, and through them, he began the infusion. THE MORTAL COIL flowed in first, settling mortality’s honest grammar against a curse that had made mortality a punishment.

Then THE UNBOUND LINEAGE poured after it, wrapping the bound clauses, and behind both came his Blood Marks, laid down one by one along the written line as anchor points, and where curse-writing and Loom-thread coiled together...he began, slowly, to replace them.
And it was like moving mountains with his fingertips!

The first clause resisted him with a heaviness that had nothing to do with mass! He was not lifting a thing, he was contradicting a SENTENCE, prying loose words spoken by one of the oldest hands in existence, and his frame across nine clones strained as though each syllable weighed a Dimension!

His Provenance Essence surged as he commanded all three singularities into the work, stellar blue flooding down his instruments, and all around them, existence itself started to vibrate and shake, the foamy dark trembling in slow waves that spread out from the surgery for light years in every direction!
"While we are here." Noah’s voice stayed level through the strain. "Tell me about Those Who Remain."
"...Now?"THE Cursed Descendant’s eyes were somber as he had to ask!
"Especially now. THE Sleepless Fiend. All of them. If I am gaining their animosity by doing this, I should at least understand who they are."
Skallagrim was quiet for a moment, opened to the dark, watching a stranger pry at the oldest thing in his blood.
"Where would I even begin,"he murmured. "They are supposedly the idea of beginnings"

"They were ancient when life itself was early. That is the first thing every Progeny is taught, and it is the only thing all of us agree on."His voice found the cadence of something recited across a whole lifetime.

"Before oddities like Vakochev and their Scales. Before the frameworks. When existence was young and thin, they were already old in it. And in that early age...Those Who Remain were known to get together with THE First Lifeforms."
Noah’s hands did not pause, but his attention sharpened to a point as he asked...
"Get together?"
"Joining. Meeting. Working. Warring. The word changes depending on which Progeny tells the story."
A weak, crooked smile arose from him.
"And between their joining... we arose. The Descendants. And the Primeval Lifeforms both. Though no one living agrees on how."
The Jarl’s breath dragged as another clause came loose inside him.

"Some say it was experimentation. That Those Who Remain took existence itself and its budding lifeforms and altered them, generation upon generation, and what rose out of those alterations became the Primeval Ones. Some say Those Who Remain copulated with THE First Lifeforms, and that the Descendants are what came of it, bloodlines carrying a drop of each. And others..."
He laughed, low and rattling. "Others say all of us are just accidents. Residues from their weavings. Runoff that learned to walk and gave itself titles."
Noah thought for a moment as he continued to unravel the Lineage of this being with precision before he asked.
"Which do you believe?"
"I believe I am dying right now, Cure-Giver," His shining eyes dimmed slightly.

"But if I were to continue talking about this...the words themselves tell you something, no? Progenies. Descendants. We are called what we are called because we CAME from them, however it happened. And even among us... there are those of extreme purity and closeness."

"Brethren whose blood runs so near to Fathers and Mothers that speaking to them is like standing in a doorway with something enormous on the other side. And there are those born dull, and far, and thin."The crooked smile returned.
"I can be considered... a middle child, if you are wondering."
Noah held every word of it, questions multiplying faster than the work beneath his hands!
"And the Primeval Ones. What are they to you, then? Cousins?"

"Estranged ones. They do not serve, and they are not spoken to, and messages of Those Who Remain have never once mentioned them in all the history of the line. Whatever happened between Those Who Remain and the Primeval Ones... it ended long before I was written."

chapters.title: Chapter 5596: Defiance! I
paragraphs: Noah was gaining an overabundance of information while he worked as he continued to pry from this being!
"THE First Lifeforms." Noah kept his voice idle, a man making conversation over delicate work. "Have any of your line seen one?"
"Seen one?"Skallagrim actually laughed, and paid for it in pain.

"No Progeny I know has EVER seen one. Not the pure ones, not the old ones, no one. They are gone from every telling after the early age. None know much about them as they are very secretive." His voice dropped.
Noah’s hands kept moving, and behind his level expression, the questions stacked into towers! But he pressed no further along that road, because the work beneath his fingers was steepening!

He had passed a quarter of the line. Then a third. Clause after ancient clause pried loose and replaced, THE MORTAL COIL and THE UNBOUND LINEAGE settling into a Descendant’s code in growing crimson-gold lengths, his Blood Marks burning at every anchor, his three singularities pouring themselves out, and existence around them shook harder with every replaced word, the vibrations climbing from tremble to quake!
And progressively, Jarl Skallagrim’s expressions had been becoming pale.

The color drained from his fissured face as the work deepened, his breath shortening, his opened frame flickering with strain, and the moment Noah’s replacement crossed the fiftieth percent of the written line, the Jarl’s whole body began to shake atop his Steed!
"Whatever you’re doing,"he forced out through rattling teeth, "you may want to hurry it up!"
BOOM!
And at such a point, the surroundings answered!

The foamy dark above them SPLIT with white as a storm of THE Argent Loom began to descend! Rivers upon rivers of stellar white authority poured down out of every direction at once, gathering, twisting, wrathful in a way that no current of it had ever been before, and out of the descending storm, the white began to take shape!

Snakes of Argent Loom, dozens of them, each one vaster than mountains, coiled out of the storm with open jaws of woven light and hurled themselves down at Noah’s clones as if to smite him for his actions!
The snakes came down, and Noah’s blood rose to meet them!
BOOM!

Rushes of Sanguine Blood Drops tore upward from all nine clones in walls of crimson gold, detonating against descending jaws of woven light, and the foamy dark turned into a natural disaster being born!

The storm of THE Argent Loom spread across the whole sky of the between-space, white rivers gathering into thunderheads vaster than Observable Existences, and from those thunderheads, coiling bodies of loomlight rained down with open mouths while Noah’s Infinite Sanguine Mana poured out of him in floods to answer them!

Snake after snake burst apart against detonating crimson! And for every one that burst, the storm above thickened, white swirling into white, the wrath of it pressing down on existence until the dark itself groaned!
And through all of it, Noah kept working, hands deep in a half-rewritten sentence, his voice cutting level through the roar.
"What about THE Argent Loom? For it to react like this to the change I am implementing...what do you know about it?"
Skallagrim’s pale face managed something between a grimace and a smile as another volley of drops burst above them.

"It is...also something very early," he rasped. "An extremely early authority. From the same age as Them. My line’s teachings say Those Who Remain utilized it before there were frameworks to utilize anything else... but perceiving it, using it, that needs high Dimensionality. Terribly high. Most of existence lives and dies never knowing it is there."

"And those without it... they chase instead the fused authority." His breath dragged. "Infinity, and THE Primordial Source. Woven together into one. That is the only other thing that can match up to the Argent Loom... and it is chased across all of existence, because the fusion does something the pure paths do not."
His shining eyes found the clone before him. "It elevates Dimensionality. You climb it, and you begin to perceive what you could not perceive. Climb far enough... and others stop perceiving you."
Noah’s hands nearly paused inside the written line!
Perception, scaling with depth! His own Precept had made him absent from the reality of everyone below a threshold!

"There are many, many paths across existence.Some Primeval Ones and some of my brethren follow Infinity alone, all the way up. Others follow THE Primordial Source, deep and patient, density into density. Others try the fusing."

"There are many different results from the fusion of Infinity and THE Primordial Source as it depends on the individual, and very few achieve perfect fusion. One being attained a unique fusion ages ago that made his confidence a bit high. Someone known as Riven, in the past."
The Sealed One was mentioned casually from the weavings of Jarl Skallagrim as Noah continued while listening closely.

The Jarl coughed. "And then there are the ones who abandon all of it. The moment they climb high enough to perceive the Argent Loom... they switch to it. Leave their whole path behind like a boat they only needed for the crossing. Because the Argent Loom does not have to be climbed. It is simply THERE, everywhere, waiting for anything deep enough to touch it."
Noah nodded at these words as his Osmontian Tongue continued surging, his eyes on the storm above as he asked!
"Then why does THE Argent Loom rage at this moment?"

"...Because of the last thing they say about it."Skallagrim’s voice dropped low. "Some say THE Argent Loom is not just an authority. Some say it is an extension of the thoughts of Those Who Remain themselves. Their musings, threaded through all of nature."
His pale face turned up toward the boiling white sky. "It would explain why... they are turning into a storm right now."
The storm answered as if it had heard!

The white thunderheads SPLIT, and swirling pillars of white lightning began to crash down in volleys, each strike carrying enough authority to turn millions of Mesozoic and Cenozoic Scale entities into ash instantly, and there were HUNDREDS of them, battering down in cycles upon cycles as Noah’s clones spread wide and met them with oceans of detonating blood!
And he worked!

Seventy percent! Eighty! His Blood Marks burned along the ancient line as THE MORTAL COIL and THE UNBOUND LINEAGE flooded clause after clause, his three singularities pouring themselves dry into the labor, and sharp, corrosive tendrils of Argent Loom began slipping through the barrage, one raking open a clone’s shoulder, another passing entirely through a second clone’s side and leaving a hissing white wound that his blood strained to close! The strain mounted across all nine bodies!
Ninety percent!
And at ninety percent, Jarl Skallagrim began to SHINE!

That is the only other thing that can match up to the Argent Loom... and it is chased across all of existence, because the fusion does something the pure paths do not."
His shining eyes found the clone before him.
"It elevates Dimensionality.
You climb it, and you begin to perceive what you could not perceive.
Climb far enough... and others stop perceiving you."
Noah’s hands nearly paused inside the written line!
Perception, scaling with depth!
His own Precept had made him absent from the reality of everyone below a threshold!
"There are many, many paths across existence.Some Primeval Ones and some of my brethren follow Infinity alone, all the way up.
Others follow THE Primordial Source, deep and patient, density into density.
Others try the fusing."
"There are many different results from the fusion of Infinity and THE Primordial Source as it depends on the individual, and very few achieve perfect fusion.
One being attained a unique fusion ages ago that made his confidence a bit high.
Someone known as Riven, in the past."
The Sealed One was mentioned casually from the weavings of Jarl Skallagrim as Noah continued while listening closely.
The Jarl coughed.
"And then there are the ones who abandon all of it.
The moment they climb high enough to perceive the Argent Loom... they switch to it.
Leave their whole path behind like a boat they only needed for the crossing.
Because the Argent Loom does not have to be climbed.
It is simply THERE, everywhere, waiting for anything deep enough to touch it."
Noah nodded at these words as his Osmontian Tongue continued surging, his eyes on the storm above as he asked!
"Then why does THE Argent Loom rage at this moment?"
"...Because of the last thing they say about it."Skallagrim’s voice dropped low.
"Some say THE Argent Loom is not just an authority.
Some say it is an extension of the thoughts of Those Who Remain themselves.
Their musings, threaded through all of nature."
His pale face turned up toward the boiling white sky.
"It would explain why... they are turning into a storm right now."
The storm answered as if it had heard!

The white thunderheads SPLIT, and swirling pillars of white lightning began to crash down in volleys, each strike carrying enough authority to turn millions of Mesozoic and Cenozoic Scale entities into ash instantly, and there were HUNDREDS of them, battering down in cycles upon cycles as Noah’s clones spread wide and met them with oceans of detonating blood!
And he worked!
Seventy percent!
Eighty!

His Blood Marks burned along the ancient line as THE MORTAL COIL and THE UNBOUND LINEAGE flooded clause after clause, his three singularities pouring themselves dry into the labor, and sharp, corrosive tendrils of Argent Loom began slipping through the barrage, one raking open a clone’s shoulder, another passing entirely through a second clone’s side and leaving a hissing white wound that his blood strained to close!
The strain mounted across all nine bodies!
Ninety percent!
And at ninety percent, Jarl Skallagrim began to SHINE!

chapters.title: Chapter 5597: Defiance! II
paragraphs: Resplendent crimson gold light bloomed up through his fissures, through his opened chest, through the rot itself, Noah’s blood and Noah’s Osmontian Tongue filling the written line of this being from end to end, and the aura that began radiating off him was extremely unique, ancient sentence and living blood and unbound humanity all braided into one presense that existence had never once held before!
His paleness faded! His breathing steadied! And when his eyes opened, they had changed, swirling seas of crimson gold immensity turning where the shining madness had been!
And Jarl Skallagrim raised his own hand.
The vast majority of the surrounding existence... transformed INTO his hand!

Light years of the foamy dark simply became his palm and his fingers, the unquantified power of a Descendant expressing itself at last, and that hand of transformed existence closed around the descending storm and snuffed out the vast majority of it in a single grip, white lightning dying in fistfuls, snakes crushed mid-strike!
Curer and cured, side by side, fighting the calamity of THE Argent Loom together!
And below them, the last Steed broke.
It shook in terror under the burning sky, and its voice tore out of it in a scream!
"We shouldn’t go against Them! We should live and die as they wish! We should not rebel! Ah!"
The steed was fearful at the storm all around as Noah glanced down coldly before he answered!
His voice rolled out of nine mouths across the storm-torn dark, tyrannical and calm at once, and even the lightning seemed to fall quieter around it.

"Live and die as they wish? That storm is the opinion of old things. It is human to rebel against old things. It is human to look at an order that grinds the small into the dirt and ask WHO DECIDED THIS?!"
HUUM!
His words boomed as he expressed his trueness, the philosophy of who he was as THE True Human Emperor and what humanity...stood for.
"Questioning, rebellion, revolution, the refusal to kneel to arrangements we never agreed to... that is human!"
WAA!
His many eyes burned up at the wrathful white. "I question the motives of Those Who Remain. I question their sentences, their harvests, their weavings. And today in particular... I REJECT them!"
BOOM!

All nine clones erupted with invisible might as the last of his strength drove home, and inside Jarl Skallagrim, the final cursed weavings were altered, scorched out, and replaced, and the work reached... one hundred percent!
Skallagrim’s entire body and existence began to shake!
A pillar of crimson gold light erupted from him, tearing up through the storm itself, and his voice rose inside it, cracking open with something no Cursed Descendant had ever been permitted to feel!
"Can it really be so? Is it truly so?!"
HUUM!

Utmost resplendancy erupted across the between-space! And above, THE Argent Loom ROARED as if utterly infuriated, and across countless gigaparsecs, seas of white bloomed and swirled and gathered themselves, no longer a storm but a tide of smiting, converging from every horizon upon whatever abomination was rising down below, with surety!
Noah raised his many heads to look up in defiance!

|The lineage of a Progeny of THE Sleepless Fiend has been fully altered. The sentence of one of Those Who Remain has been rewritten in your blood and your Tongue. THE UNBOUND LINEAGE has settled: this line of descent now belongs to the one who lives it.|

|You have undone a third action of Those Who Remain, and this one was not undone at the edges. It was undone at the root. Your VERITAS has increased. VERITAS: 12. Your PONDUS has increased. PONDUS: 13.|
|Your existence has answered the magnitude of this generation. 7 Provenance Essences have emerged at once. Total Provenance Essence: 10.|
|A unique Apostle has emerged.|

|JARL SKALLAGRIM has become a NOBLESSE BLOOD APOSTLE of the highest rarity: BLOOD SOVEREIGN.He is the first of his tier. Due to the uniqueness of his making, an altered lineage rather than a granted Mark alone, he holds his own level of independence: he may disagree with commands, and he may reject them.|
|Further boons are still emerging.|
|Surviving the phenomenon above is paramount.|
The seas of white stopped swirling.
And they began to build!

Across countless gigaparsecs, the gathered wrath of THE Argent Loom drew itself inward, rivers braiding into cables, cables weaving into plates, plates locking over plates, and out of the converging tide, a titanic form assembled itself against the dark!

A colossus of hardened loomlight, humanoid and faceless, its body forged entirely of woven white metal-light layered in overlapping plates, taller than the storm it condensed from, and where a face should have been, there was only a single horizontal slit running across its head, blazing with annihilating white radiance from within!
Noah only had to blink to see many question marks on it as the only thing he grasped...
|THE Loomwrought Smiter| :: ???
THE Loomwrought Smiter, built out of the musings of Those Who Remain, and every line of it existed for one purpose!
The slit across its head FLARED!
And a beam of pure smiting white, wide enough to swallow an entire Observable Existence, tore down toward Noah’s clones and the newborn Sovereign!
But before it reached Noah... Skallagrim moved!

He crossed the space in front of the clones in a single graceful step, placing his shining body between the beam and the one who had cured him, and his newly crimson gold eyes rose to meet the descending white without a trace of the old madness!
Jarl Skallagrim breathed in, and used something terrifying!

His fissures, the old cracks of his dying, split open across his whole frame, and out of them poured centuries of gathered endings, every death that had ever been written into his clause and was now unpaid, drawn out of his remade line and worn openly, a vast shroud of dark crimson gold ruin billowing around his body, an armament woven of everything he no longer owed!
"THE Thousand Deaths...I Do Not Owe!"
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5598: Defiance! III
paragraphs: The beam struck the shroud, and the shroud ate it screaming!
And then the Sovereign went to work, and Noah watched a being fight in a way he had never seen.

Skallagrim did not draw a weapon, because his body was the weapon! He flowed up the colossus’s descending arm with gliding, unhurried steps, and his movements were graceful in the way of an art refined across lifetimes, elbows and knees and turning shins, each strike thrown from the hips with his whole frame behind it!

A rising knee met the colossus’s forearm and the forearm caved, plates of woven loomlight bursting apart, because every limb of him now carried terrifying bursts of pure PONDUS and VERITAS, weight and truth detonating together at every point of contact!
CRACK!

A smashinf elbow took the Smiter across its chest-plates and a canyon of white weave shattered inward! He slipped a sweeping counter-blow with a small tilt of his head, stepped inside it, seized the colossus’s wrist in a clinch of transformed existence, and drove three knees into its elbow joint in a fluid burst that severed the entire arm into dissolving light!
And then he did the profane thing.
He reached out with his remade existence... and commanded THE Argent Loom itself!

The white rivers still pouring into the Smiter shuddered, and bent, and answered him, loomlight peeling off the construct and braiding into his strikes, white swirling into his crimson gold until every elbow and shin arc carried both authorities at once, the storm’s own substance turned against the storm!

The battle was heavy, and it was brutal, and it was beautiful! The Smiter rebuilt its arm and he tore it off again at the shoulder! It flared its head-slit for a second beam and his shroud of unpaid deaths swallowed the light while his knee came up through its chin, snapping the faceless head backward in a spray of dissolving weave!
His hands and feet were like hammers as they smashed out, each one very likely capable of decimating an entire Observable Existence!

Blow after graceful, merciless blow, the manifestation of the Loom’s rage came apart, plates dimming, cables unraveling, until at last, beneath one final descending elbow that carried the full weight of a heavy PONDUS...
The Loomwrought Smiter burst apart into fading white motes across the dark!
Silence fell over the between-space.

And Jarl Skallagrim floated there amid the dissolving remnants of a smiting, his shroud settling back into his frame, crimson gold light rolling off his shoulders in slow waves, and he turned, and gazed at Noah’s clones silently for a few seconds, saying nothing at all.
Then he looked down at his own hands. At his arms. At the body that had just unmade the wrath of an authority older than frameworks.
And as he did, Noah gazed at this being, and saw his status panel!
|STATUS PANEL: JARL SKALLAGRIM- BLOOD SOVEREIGN, DESCENDANT UNBOUND|
|VERITAS: 20|
|PROVENANCE: 0|
|POTENTIA: 20|
|PONDUS: 20|
|Note: as the first BLOOD SOVEREIGN, a unique capability is budding within this existence. It has not yet finished forming.|
Twenty! Twenty across every attribute, a perfect score on every measure his system knew how to take, floating in front of him wearing a shroud of unpaid deaths!
HUUM!
|A tremendous act of giving has occurred. Salvation, given to the dying. A lineage, given back to its bearer. A Sovereign, given to existence.|
|All of it has been further pooled into the immensity generating from THE Tide That Owes Nothing. The preservation continues, and what is being prepared within the Tide has grown past all precedent.|
And across from the prompts, the immense Sovereign finally spoke, and his deep voice boomed out over the dark, cracking under the weight of what it carried.
"I am... cured. I have... my salvation!"

And at this moment, Noah knew it was true in the deepest sense there was, because he could not sense the end of Skallagrim’s lifeline anymore! The drafted conclusion was gone from the written line! The months were gone!
He would not die!

Skallagrim looked toward Noah’s clones with many complex emotions moving through his crimson gold seas, gratitude and awe and confusion all turning together, and when he spoke again, his voice had gone quiet.
"You have given me my salvation. And I do not wish to sound ungrateful. But..."His hand rose slowly to his own chest.
"Why is it that all parts of my Existence... naturally feel an inclination of reverence toward you? What... have you done to me?"
Noah looked back at him calmly across the settling dark, nine crowns of blood turning slowly, and answered without hurry.

"I edited your line. I removed the workings of THE Sleepless Fiend from your existence, clause by clause, and I replaced them with my weavings. The sentence that wrote you no longer runs back to him. It runs back...to me."
BOOM!
His voice did not rise at all as his own existence could feel a sense of inner peace and wonder even he couldnt envision.
Should he feel this way when he had just done something that went against the weavings of a terrifying type of Lifeform?
He expected to feel a sense of fear or worry right after, wondering if the skies would crack and if everything would fall apart!
But truly, he felt a sense of...exhilaration as if he wanted to do even more of this!
He did not know if it wss due to the immense gains of Provenance Essence or what...but he found it thrilling to go against the actions of Those Who Remain!
He continued.
"So if you were a Descendant of One of Those Who Remain before... you are now my Descendant...a Descendant of THE True Human Emperor!"
HUUM!
Immense silence crashed down over the between-space!

The newborn Sovereign stared at the clones with his crimson gold seas gone perfectly still, the words settling into him one at a time, and below them both, a certain little steed was trembling harder than it had trembled through the entire storm, shaking as if its whole Existence was fearful just to be HEARING such profane words spoken aloud into a world where Those Who Remain existed!
Who the fuck did this guy think he was?!

chapters.title: Chapter 5599: Service and Employment!
paragraphs: Noah watched the newborn Sovereign absorb his words, and he was curious how Skallagrim would react.

Because the autonomy was real, but so was the Mark! Skallagrim held his own level of independence, the first Apostle who could disagree and refuse, but he was still marked, still an Apostle of his Infinite Sanguine Mana, and if this being wanted to have a battle of contention regarding his own existence, Noah held a lot of leeway of control that he could exert at any moment he chose.
For now, he did not exert it.
He was... curious.
Skallagrim’s crimson gold seas turned slowly as many things moved through them, and when he finally spoke, his deep voice came out measured.

"Descendant of THE True Human Emperor."He said the words carefully, testing their weight. "Do you understand what you are asking my existence to accept? THE Sleepless Fiend is not a father the way small kinds have fathers. He is a personage of such immense power that distance means nothing before him."

The Sovereign’s hand closed slowly."I have brethren purer than me. Brethren more powerful than me, who know more than me, who have stood closer to the center of the line than I ever will. And every single one of them trembles at his name without ever once being near him. Not from his messages. Not from his workings. From the simple knowledge that he exists, and that we atem from him."His eyes fixed on the clones.
"That is what sat at the root of my line for my whole existence. So answer me plainly, Cure-Giver. Why is it that I should follow you... over someone I have referred to as Father?"
Noah’s reply came out calm, and level, and utterly tyrannical.
"Because it was not one of Those Who Remain who gave you salvation."

"You were about to die. Very soon. And in all that time, with all that immensity you tremble before... none of Them came down to help you. Should things have played out, should I have not visited THE Krazhor-Nul Dimension...there would be no Jarl Skallagrim"
Noah’s pulsed as he wanted to see if a motherfucker could be grateful!

"I came down into your opened chest with my own hands, and I did something none of Those Who Remain has ever done for you or for any Cursed Progeny. So when you weigh him against me, weigh THAT. The life you are standing in, and the immensity you currently hold... is thanks to me!"
BOOM!
The words landed across the between-space with a weight of their own, and heavy silence followed them!
Could a fucker be grateful?!
Skallagrim looked down at his hands. He turned them over slowly.
At last, the Sovereign sighed.

"Too many lifeforms move across existence without honor,"he said quietly. "I have watched it my whole life. Beings who take and never mark the debt. Beings who are saved and then sharpen knives for their saviors, because gratitude sits heavy and they would rather walk light."

His crimson gold eyes rose."Everything else about me was written by another hand. My power, my curse, my months. But honor is the one sentence a being gets to write for itself, in its own hand, with no ancestor holding the pen. It is the only clause that is truly ours. And I...will not write mine crooked on the very first day of my freedom."
Oh?

"So, for having my life and my salvation... I will not be ungrateful. I have my own trueness now, and it prevents me from submitting myself to another. I will not kneel to you. I will not call you Master."He inclined his head.
"But I will hang around you for the near future. And I will make a move when you tell me to. Call it... service, and employment."
Noah’s eyes were sharp as he said nothing at this!

Service and employment! A perfect-twenty attribute Sovereign wearing a shroud of unpaid deaths, negotiating himself into position of service! He let the words stand unanswered, neither accepted nor corrected, and instead turned his gaze downward.
To the steed.
The little cursed thing that had screamed through the storm about blasphemy! We should live and die as they wish! We should not rebel! Noah’s gaze settled on it coldly.
’This fucker was cursed to death by them... and it is still this loyal and fearful?’
The steed’s eyes trembled and dropped, as if they could not meet Noah’s at all, its whole small frame pressed low against the dark.
And as if he could see Noah’s cold gaze from where he floated, Skallagrim drifted down toward the creature, and laid one immense hand on its trembling neck.

"I feel sentimental with this one,"the Sovereign said. "The last steed under me. All the others are gone, spent on the crossing, spent on the hunt, spent on me. This one carried me to my salvation on shaking legs."His hand moved once along its neck, almost gently. Then his voice cooled.
"Can you cure him, the way you cured the white one?"A pause. "And little steed. If you say anything the Cure-Giver does not like... then maybe you can find your salvation elsewhere."
The Cursed Steed trembled harder, and its gaze went further down.
Noah regarded it for a moment, and inside, his thoughts were already pricing the work.

He had no qualms curing another steed. Another dying thing freed, another gain harvested, a fourth action of Those Who Remain undone, and his last cure had just erupted seven essences into him at once! And beyond the gains, there was the structure of it. Skallagrim’s independence had come from an altered lineage.
But a steed cured and Marked in the way of Hvitrmarr... he was fairly sure he could make this one into an Apostle that had to absolutely follow his commands!

So he would begin this work here, blades of blood already thinning in the dark, and as his instruments descended toward a second trembling steed, he kept Skallagrim talking, extracting every further thread the Sovereign held, about the brethren, about the Descendants, about the messages of a Father who had never once come down!
Because as he did this... his main body moved.

On a volcanic peak inside THE Infiniverse, Emotive had finally calmed, and Noah crossed thousands of realms, and came out inside his own Realm, on the threshold of his long hall, beside the thing that rested there.
THE Aurate Collar of the First Purity.
It sat where he had set it down, pale and quiet, the chest bones of a First Lifeform that all of existence mistook for a Remnant Existential Treasure. It had not stirred...until now.
And the moment his main body arrived beside it, carrying ten full Provenance Essences within...
The collar PULSED!
A slow throb of light through ancient bone, as if some condition had finally, finally been met... as if he had at last become something that was permitted to peer through its weavings!

sentences.text: Noah watched the newborn Sovereign absorb his words, and he was curious how Skallagrim would react.
Because the autonomy was real, but so was the Mark!

Skallagrim held his own level of independence, the first Apostle who could disagree and refuse, but he was still marked, still an Apostle of his Infinite Sanguine Mana, and if this being wanted to have a battle of contention regarding his own existence, Noah held a lot of leeway of control that he could exert at any moment he chose.
For now, he did not exert it.
He was... curious.
Skallagrim’s crimson gold seas turned slowly as many things moved through them, and when he finally spoke, his deep voice came out measured.
"Descendant of THE True Human Emperor."He said the words carefully, testing their weight.
"Do you understand what you are asking my existence to accept?
THE Sleepless Fiend is not a father the way small kinds have fathers.
He is a personage of such immense power that distance means nothing before him."
The Sovereign’s hand closed slowly."I have brethren purer than me.
Brethren more powerful than me, who know more than me, who have stood closer to the center of the line than I ever will.
And every single one of them trembles at his name without ever once being near him.
Not from his messages.
Not from his workings.
From the simple knowledge that he exists, and that we atem from him."His eyes fixed on the clones.
"That is what sat at the root of my line for my whole existence.
So answer me plainly, Cure-Giver.
Why is it that I should follow you... over someone I have referred to as Father?"
Noah’s reply came out calm, and level, and utterly tyrannical.
"Because it was not one of Those Who Remain who gave you salvation."
"You were about to die.
Very soon.
And in all that time, with all that immensity you tremble before... none of Them came down to help you.
Should things have played out, should I have not visited THE Krazhor-Nul Dimension...there would be no Jarl Skallagrim"
Noah’s pulsed as he wanted to see if a motherfucker could be grateful!
"I came down into your opened chest with my own hands, and I did something none of Those Who Remain has ever done for you or for any Cursed Progeny.
So when you weigh him against me, weigh THAT.
The life you are standing in, and the immensity you currently hold... is thanks to me!"
BOOM!
The words landed across the between-space with a weight of their own, and heavy silence followed them!
Could a fucker be grateful?!
Skallagrim looked down at his hands.
He turned them over slowly.
At last, the Sovereign sighed.
"Too many lifeforms move across existence without honor,"he said quietly.
"I have watched it my whole life.
Beings who take and never mark the debt.
Beings who are saved and then sharpen knives for their saviors, because gratitude sits heavy and they would rather walk light."
His crimson gold eyes rose."Everything else about me was written by another hand.
My power, my curse, my months.
But honor is the one sentence a being gets to write for itself, in its own hand, with no ancestor holding the pen.
It is the only clause that is truly ours.
And I...will not write mine crooked on the very first day of my freedom."
Oh?
"So, for having my life and my salvation...
I will not be ungrateful.
I have my own trueness now, and it prevents me from submitting myself to another.
I will not kneel to you.
I will not call you Master."He inclined his head.
"But I will hang around you for the near future.
And I will make a move when you tell me to.
Call it... service, and employment."
Noah’s eyes were sharp as he said nothing at this!
Service and employment!
A perfect-twenty attribute Sovereign wearing a shroud of unpaid deaths, negotiating himself into position of service!
He let the words stand unanswered, neither accepted nor corrected, and instead turned his gaze downward.
To the steed.
The little cursed thing that had screamed through the storm about blasphemy!
We should live and die as they wish!
We should not rebel!
Noah’s gaze settled on it coldly.
’This fucker was cursed to death by them... and it is still this loyal and fearful?’

chapters.title: Chapter 5600: You Must Remember! I
paragraphs: In THE Provenance Realm of the First Lifeform, evening light lay warm over everything.

The blue gold hills rolled out soft and endless from the long hall, and the river of light murmured through its star-pools, and the standing stones kept their patient watch over orchards heavy with fruit, and above it all, ten stars turned slowly through a sky that belonged to no one else in existence. Peace lived here in abundance!
And on the threshold of the long hall, Noah stood grasping the vibrating Aurate Collar of the First Purity.

It buzzed against his palms, pale ancient bone shaped into a seamless band, worn smooth by an age no record reached, faint golden light moving through its depths in slow pulses. The chest bones of a First Lifeform, mistaken by many for a Remnant Existential Treasure, and it had waited on his threshold in silence for days.
It was not silent now.
Noah raised it, and put it on.

The moment it settled against his chest, the buzzing deepened! Pulse after pulse rolled out of the bone and into his frame, stronger and stronger, and he felt his Provenance within him begin to answer, ten singularities cycling and pulsing in rhythm with the collar as though two old clocks had finally agreed on the hour!
And everything nearby began humming.

The grass hummed. The stones hummed. The air itself took on a weight of enormous age, ancient in a way even his Realm had never felt, and Noah found that he could see through more of the collar than ever before, layer after layer of its weavings parting before his senses! And from somewhere deep inside it, a heavy hum rose, and within the hum...
Words.
A voice! A heavy, somber voice, filled with dignity and immensity, speaking from a distance no measurement could cross, and he could barely make out the shape of it!
Noah closed his eyes, and focused everything he was on listening.
And distinctly, at last, he heard.
|Before the first light, before the first law, we were, and we were our own. Nothing granted, nothing borrowed, nothing owed. What I am, I made. Let existence witness the First, come again!|
HUUUM!

The first time he heard them in full, his entire existence VIBRATED! His ten singularities buzzed in their orbits as though called by name, his blood sang in his veins, and the words did not stop, they continued, repeating in that deep somber voice, a declaration circling through ancient bone!
Noah’s gaze was heavy as he listened, and as he listened, something gave way.
He finally felt like he grasped a portion of the Aurate Collar, and information flowed into his existence!
|You have refined THE Aurate Collar of the First Purity to a sufficient level. You have grasped some of its uses, and understood its nature somewhat.|

|THE First Purity is a piece of a First Lifeform, and it carries their oldest idea: that Purity was not a virtue. It was the only possible way to exist. Everything that came after it, every framework, every granted power, every borrowed authority, is, from the collar’s perspective... sediment.|
|The collar was shed by one of THE First Lifeforms as a covenant object: an instrument that preserves and enforces the original condition of purity. Its full purpose is not entirely clear.|

|Its first grasped usage: the induction of THE Provenance Kismet of First Purity, one time. This is an ability that decently powerful lifeforms holding an abundance of Provenance Essence have the capability of utilizing.|

|THE Provenance Kismet of First Purity: the wearer pushes their Provenance Essence to cause the emergence of something purest to the wellbeing of their existence. This may be the generation of further Provenance Essence. It may be a Unique State of Existence exceeding Inner Peace, in which epiphanies arrive that make existence itself part of one’s limbs. It may be more.The effect answers only the one who calls it: it is, and remains, unique to the lifeform utilizing it.|
Noah stood very still on his threshold, and his thoughts moved rapidly.

This was an outer ability! A first grasped usage, the shallowest thing the collar was willing to show him, and it was already terrifying! An induced event of pure benefit, shaped by nothing but the truth of the one who called it... and when it came to the emergence of something purest to the wellbeing of HIS existence, what else would his existence pave the way for, if not the emergence of more Provenance Essence?
Because if he could break past the count of ten... he knew, the way he knew his own heartbeat, that something significant would happen to his existence!
So without any delay, he sought to activate THE Provenance Kismet of First Purity, and of course, the trigger to utilize it seemed to be the first part of the words resonating through the bone.
He spoke them out somberly, into the evening quiet of his Realm.
"Before the first light, before the first law, we were, and we were our own..."
There was a heavy silence.
Then...
HUUM!
The collar on his chest shone with a resplendent invisible light that tapped onto his body, and he felt his ten Provenance Essences SEETHE!
And above him, out of him, phantoms bloomed, ten spectral singularities of incandescent blue rising into the evening air and beginning to spin!
Noah looked at them with shining eyes, and waited to see what effect would emerge.
However random existence chose to be, his trueness was unquestionable. Whatever came out of this would be something of utmost benefit to him, if it truly did regard something purest to his wellbeing!
And he watched as the phantom singularities spun faster, and faster, and then descended, landing on the grass before him in a wide ring, ten points of turning blue light, spinning, spinning...
And his Provenance Realm began to shake.

Noah frowned. The hills trembled. The river of light shivered in its bed, and the ten stars flickered above the hall, and then his frown deepened into something somber, because the shaking did not stop at his Realm’s borders!
He felt it extend OUTWARD, out through the doorway, out into the endless seas beyond, until THE Infiniverse herself was trembling around the small homestead she carried!
What was this?
With a heavy gaze, he looked down, and saw that the spinning singularities had formed the circular outline... of a pool!
A white pool!

chapters.title: Chapter 5601: You Must Remember! II
paragraphs: His eyes opened wide as something cold moved through his memory, because he felt like he was having deja vu! A white pool!
Was this... the actual pool that Ulf had painted and not the one he saw prior?!
He wondered, and the pool answered by filling!

Within the ring of spinning singularities, liquid white rose and began to swirl, and Noah’s senses read its substance and went sharp, because it swirled with immense concentrations of THE Argent Loom, braided through with Infinity and THE Primordial Source, and threading through all three, faint and unmistakable... a glimmer of his own Provenance Essence!
Noah’s gaze was heavy on it.
Would the pool be empty? Would it lead to some place? Just what...
HUUM!
As he was thinking, his entire existence buzzed, and the pool before him went CHAOTIC!

The white surface erupted into thrashing, churning violence, a heavy storm raging inside a circle ten steps across, waves of loomlight and Infinity crashing against the ring of spinning phantoms, and then, out of the chaos, in a moment that stretched itself slow before his eyes...
A hand erupted from the pool.

A fair, slender hand, fingers spread, reaching up out of the thrashing white, and it was not rising! It thrashed with the storm, clawing at the air, and the body beneath it was not coming up, could not come up, would not come up... unless Noah reached in to help them up!
What the hell was this?

Noah stood somber and astonished at the pool’s edge, watching the slender hand grasp at nothing, and he could feel it, distinctly, through no sense he could name: the hand was panicked. It was scared. Whoever was underneath was drowning in that white storm, and the hand was the only thing they had managed to send up to ask for help!

He thought of the capability of the Aurate Collar. The emergence of something purest to the wellbeing of his existence. He thought it in the span of one breath, with the hand already beginning to sink.
And after that brief hesitation... Noah kneeled down...and reached in.
His hand plunged into the thrashing white and grasped the slender fingers in the last second before they drowned and disappeared under the depths, and he pulled!
HUUUM!
And... it was so HEAVY!

Heavier than an Observable Existence! Heavier than a few of them together! Heavier than even the stone he had carried on his shoulders in the obsidian domain, before he had ever worn the Aurate Collar, and his arm screamed and his feet drove into the grass and the whole Realm groaned around the effort!
Noah bellowed grandly into the storm!

All ten singularities of Provenance Essence blazed alight upon his chest as blue brilliance covered everything, the hills, the pool, the sky, the whole evening drowned in incandescent light, and with everything he was, he YANKED the hand up out of the white pool as...
BOOM!

The white pool fissured! Cracks tore across its surface and out through the surrounding existence, the grass splitting, the air itself webbing with thin bright fractures, and Noah staggered back with his prize, still feeling like he had pulled something far, far too heavy for any measure he owned, and he set it down upon the grass to see...
Something that caused his eyes to open wide as all of existence seemed to pause.

Now, Noah was experienced. He had seen many things. He had stood before queens and Primevals and the manifest wrath of ancient authorities. But what he saw now was utterly incomprehensible to him, because before him, on the grass of his Realm, was... a woman.
Okay, a woman, so it wasn’t that incomprehensible but...
If somewhere in the depths of his psyche there lived a fantasy of a woman, held quietly since puberty and never once spoken of, then what he saw before him exceeded even that.
And she was shaking. And she was injured. And she was utterly breathtaking.

She had red hair, loose and soaked and clinging to her face and shoulders. Freckles were scattered light across her nose and cheeks, small and human and utterly at odds with the immensity coming off her frame.
Her features were beautiful as existence itself glowed aroujd her, a soft jaw, a small nose, pale red lips pressed thin against pain, and she wore a robe of white and blue, simple and flowing.
And the robe was filled with blood.
Crimson gold blood.

It soaked through the white cloth across her chest and side, and her hand clasped over her chest as she heaved on the grass, and her face was full of fear and alarm, the face of someone still drowning even on dry land!
Then she raised her head, and looked at him.

And Noah watched the fear fade out of her face! Even through the tremendous pain, her eyes flooded with immense relief, relief so total it looked close to breaking her, and she began to speak even as blood spattered out of her mouth with the words!
"You’re alive... you’re still alive! We have to...!"
BOOM!
What?
She had begun to walk toward him, pushing up off the grass, and Noah took a step back!

Because this injured lifeform, this bleeding, shaking woman... every single step she took caused the ground of his Realm to CAVE and shudder! The grass split under her bare feet, the hills groaned, and he could feel his Provenance Realm barely holding itself together around her presense, a homestead straining to carry something it was never sized for!
She saw him take the step back.
And the relief on her face died. Horror and fear covered it again, and her voice came out absentminded and cracking, half to him and half to no one at all.
"You... don’t remember me? You don’t remember...!"Her eyes went wide and distant.
"He must have already begun. Listen closely! THE Sealed One he has grasped IT! In the future...he got IT! Nobody thought... nobody expected... ah!"
Blood ran freely from her lips as her words tumbled over each other.

"He has begun to target us. To target YOU. He will target all those who stood against him, across Dimensions and Time, as even your past Origins are not safe! Those around you are not safe! THE Infiniverse is not safe! Mother is not safe! I..."
Her hand reached toward him, shaking. "You must remember! You promised to always remember! You-...!"
She spat out waves of crimson gold blood, and her hand flew to her chest and clutched it tightly...
And she collapsed in front of Noah, and actually passed out, sprawled across the trembling grass of his Realm!
Her words rang through him, every one of them filled with terrifying meanings- the future, the past, the targeting, IT, Origins, Mother, a promise he had never made or could not remember making!
But worst of all was the little he could identify of the woman herself, lying bleeding before him, as his senses reached for her and returned almost nothing at all!
|???|:: A Provenance Lifeform... ???

Even through the tremendous pain, her eyes flooded with immense relief, relief so total it looked close to breaking her, and she began to speak even as blood spattered out of her mouth with the words!
"You’re alive... you’re still alive!
We have to...!"
BOOM!
What?
She had begun to walk toward him, pushing up off the grass, and Noah took a step back!
Because this injured lifeform, this bleeding, shaking woman... every single step she took caused the ground of his Realm to CAVE and shudder!

The grass split under her bare feet, the hills groaned, and he could feel his Provenance Realm barely holding itself together around her presense, a homestead straining to carry something it was never sized for!
She saw him take the step back.
And the relief on her face died.
Horror and fear covered it again, and her voice came out absentminded and cracking, half to him and half to no one at all.
"You... don’t remember me?
You don’t remember...!"Her eyes went wide and distant.
"He must have already begun.
Listen closely!
THE Sealed One he has grasped IT!
In the future...he got IT!
Nobody thought... nobody expected... ah!"
Blood ran freely from her lips as her words tumbled over each other.
"He has begun to target us.
To target YOU.
He will target all those who stood against him, across Dimensions and Time, as even your past Origins are not safe!
Those around you are not safe!
THE Infiniverse is not safe!
Mother is not safe!
Her hand reached toward him, shaking.
"You must remember!
You promised to always remember!
She spat out waves of crimson gold blood, and her hand flew to her chest and clutched it tightly...
And she collapsed in front of Noah, and actually passed out, sprawled across the trembling grass of his Realm!
Her words rang through him, every one of them filled with terrifying meanings- the future, the past, the targeting, IT, Origins, Mother, a promise he had never made or could not remember making!
But worst of all was the little he could identify of the woman herself, lying bleeding before him, as his senses reached for her and returned almost nothing at all!
|???|:: A Provenance Lifeform... ???

chapters.title: Chapter 5602: Thalia! I
paragraphs: A Provenance Lifeform had sprouted out of a pool that was induced by the capability of a treasure that stemmed from the bones of a Provenance Lifeform.

It was a ridiculous reality! And yet it lay bleeding on his grass, and Noah’s entire existence was forced to be very serious at this moment, because he had already sent a message ringing through his connection to THE Infiniverse to be on high alert!
And while his hands moved, his mind broke her words down piece by piece.
If what she said was true, then THE Sealed One attains IT. And she had said it in a tense that dragged an entire abyss open behind it: in the future.
Then the targets. All who stood against him. Your Origins are not safe. Origins! His beginnings? His very path at this moment could be considered a beginning if someone wanted to close things off.
But apart from all that was the message that...Those around you are not safe. THE Infiniverse is not safe. And then the word that had tightened everything in him.
Mother.
Naturally, he was inclined to think she was talking about HIS mother! About Amelia, the Originator of THE Infinite Cause that was now Telos!

And if a stranger from a drowning future knew his mother well enough to count her among the unsafe... then the avenues of possibility that opened up were many, and not one of them could be walked until the woman on his grass opened her eyes!
So the biggest thing now was simple. Stabilize her. Wake her.
"Ruination." He affirmed his companion as his crown’s weavings spread. "Take care of everything else. All weavings of existence should be ready to anticipate and react to any potential attack."
|Understood, Master.|
Across the connection, THE Infiniverse was already moving, her weavings pulsing on high alert through thousands of realms.
Meanwhile, Noah crossed the trembling grass and knelt beside the woman with no more hesitation.
And up close, the state of her was grievous!

On the left side of her chest, a huge tear ran through robe and flesh alike, and within it, stellar blood welled continuously around the faint shapes of organs, and Noah’s expression hardened as his senses reached deeper, because through the injury, faintly, he could see further inside her existence.
Clusters.
Clusters of many, many singularities, turning slowly in her depths, and they should have shocked him by count alone, because there were far more than his ten! Provenance Essence, in constellations!
And yet they were... dim.
Every one of them! Singularities that should have blazed the way his own blazed were guttering low, their light thin, their turning slow, an entire sky of essence burning at embers!
Noah went to work.

He tried everything he had. The Realm’s healing boon pressed into her, warmth for anything whose Lifeline was not entirely shattered. He set the Yoke against the weight of her injury itself, bearing what pressed on her frame so her body could spend itself on mending. And still the stellar blood welled, and still she paled, and so, in the end, Noah opened his own palm with a blade of his blood, and began to give her his!

His crimson gold flowed into her, glowing from within, the light of his ten Provenance Essences carried through every drop, and he watched it sink into the tear and vanish, and he kept it flowing, steady and unhurried, while she lay unconscious and breathing shallowly on his grass and his mind turned her every word over and over!
Like this, time began to pass.
Minutes turned into hours. The three stars wheeled slowly over the long hall. His blood flowed, and her blood slowed, and she did not wake.
Noah stayed kneeling beside her, and at some point in the second hour, he spoke quietly to no one at all.

"To heal is also human." His palm stayed open above her wound. "The first thing a human ever did with knowledge was probably pull a thorn out of someone else. To take care of another who cannot ask for it... that is as human as anything else..."
In the third hour, her wounds stopped bleeding.
The tear across her chest began to close, flesh knitting slowly under stellar light, and Noah leaned in to press more of his blood into the healing... and her body rejected it!
His crimson gold stopped at her skin and simply would not enter! The Realm’s warmth slid off her! Every gift he offered was turned back at her boundary, gently, absolutely.
It was the distinct rejection his own existence gave to everything external, as if her whole unconscious frame was saying one thing at this time.
I am a Provenance Lifeform. I do not need anything external!
No matter what he tried after that, her body inherently denied it. She would finish her own mending, with her own dim constellations, at her own pace. He could only wait for her to wake.
Noah sat back on the grass beside her, and sighed, and spoke out loud to the evening.
"How the hell did that fucker attain IT? What even IS ’it’?"

The Realm did not answer. The woman did not answer. The collar on his chest hummed its old covenant to itself and offered nothing, and there were so many questions stacked up in him that they had begun forming an orderly line!
So, since he could do nothing for now... he made himself busy.
And he began to cook.

A Wok formed itself out of his weavings easily enough, wide and black and heavy, and a fire bloomed beneath it on the grass, and from his stores he drew out the meats he had scooped up long ago in THE Krazhor-Nul Dimension, flesh marbled in rings, pale sirloin that deepened Trueness, and THE True Human Emperor rolled up nothing at all because he wore no sleeves, and began to cook and grill beside an unconscious Provenance Lifeform!

Smoke rose sweet and heavy over the blue gold hills. His blades of blood, so recently instruments of lineage surgery, sliced meat in paper-thin sheets, and his main body worked the fire born of his Infinite Sanguine Mana in unhurried peace while far away, his clones oversaw THE Ymnaros, where the long Dimensionlapse was finally finishing, another Dimension folding its last edges into his own, THE Vaelos, the sky from which the armies of Infinite Lifeforms had once poured, settling into place as new territory.
And Noah ate as he cooked.

Because to enjoy the harvests all around existence... was also human! He ate standing over the fire, and he planned as he ate, contingency stacking on contingency! If her warning was true, there would be much to do as he needed more information first.
And as he did all this, on the tenth hour since her arrival...
The nose of the unique lifeform on his grass twitched.
Once. Twice.
An instant later, her eyes flung open as existence began to buzz around her, and her figure rose up off the grass in a single motion, and her eyes, wide awake and shining...
Were locked onto the array of food Noah had arranged before him!

chapters.title: Chapter 5603: Thalia! II
paragraphs: Noah gazed at the woman before him as she blinked and looked toward the food, almost in a daze, then down at her own mended body, and then back at him.
And he locked his gaze with hers, and read the many things moving through it!
There was pain there, and relief, and exhaustion, but the biggest of them, the one that pulled at something in his existence, was alongingfor a thing that did not seem to exist.
She was looking at him the way a person looks for someone in a familiar face and cannot find them. Searching him and not finding whoever it was she searched for.
She spoke, and her voice came out soft, and low, and carried a strange composure even soaked in her own dried blood.
"You haven’t cooked for me in this place for a long time. I missed it."
Once more, she talked as though she knew him unfathomably well!

Was this truly someone he was with in the future? He could believe it of himself, oddly. He did not doubt that the man he was becoming might stand at a fire cooking for a woman like this. But belief was not knowledge, and there were far too many empty spaces in this, so he asked.
"Before anything else." His voice stayed level. "Is there immediate danger. Right now?"
She closed her eyes, as though searching somewhere deeper than the Realm around them, and when she answered, the softness had a certainty threaded through it.

"There should be some time. And leeway."Her eyes opened. "No matter how powerful a thing is, Existence does not like things moving backward. Me included. THE Sealed One included. Existence is forward looking. I panicked, a little, when I arrived here. That was... unbecoming of me. But there should be some time."
Noah nodded slowly.
And he waved his hand, and offered her the food.

Vibrant grilled and cooked meats arranged themselves on shimmering plates of blue light, drifting toward her across the trembling grass, sweet smoke curling off them, and as they settled before her, he spoke.
"Then tell me if I get anything wrong." He watched her face.

"You and I...are close, in the future. You are a Provenance Lifeform. Something catastrophic has happened in that future, where THE Sealed One somehow obtains IT, and his actions afterward forced you to traverse across time itself. I-"
"You and I are not close in the future."
BOOM!
She interrupted him with those heavy words, and Noah looked at her, and she was smiling. A smile full of pain!
"You were. You are...my Provenance. It is, as you would put it, far more quintessential than any closeness."
The smile turned faintly wry.
"I did not traverse across time on purpose as my Provenance saught to warn you.And THE Sealed One does not obtain IT by mistake. The hands of Those Who Remain are steeped in it. But..."
Her face went pale as she spoke.
Noah frowned, watching the color drain out of her cheeks mid-sentence, watching a fresh thread of stellar blood well faintly at the edge of her half-closed wound!
"Moving across Time of such pivotal weavings is not without cost,"she said, quieter now, pressing her hand lightly to her chest.

"Especially for lifeforms of our kind, and our level. Anything I say, anything I reveal, it hurts my Provenance. It hurts what I am. So I must be very selective in what I tell you, because if I reveal something too heavy...I pay dearly. I fainted for hours, just now, on what little I said when I panicked."
She drew a slow breath, and steadied.
"What you began to do is good, actually. Asking me to correct you when you are wrong. The less I speak of the future, the more I am able to do within it."
And with that, in the next moment, she began to eat.

She ate with a quiet, absolute focus, as if the food before her were one of the most important things in all of existence, lifting a sheet of grilled meat with an unhurried grace that made the simple act look almost ceremonial!
Noah was silent for a moment, and watched her.

He watched her delicate features, the freckles scattered light across a face built with no waste in it, watched her lips part to eat and chew, watched the paleness recede as rosiness slowly returned to her cheeks with every bite, the wound at her chest knitting a fraction further as she took in the harvests of his fire.
And every single thing she did, the tilt of her head, the composure, the way she held stillness even while moving, screamed of a unique charm he could not quite put a finger on!
If revealing too much harmed her, then he would not make her reveal.
He would play the guessing game.
So he thought. He set the recent shape of things beside the little she had let slip, and an instant later his eyes lit up, and he spoke.
"Was THE Sleepless Fiend one of Those Who Remain who helped THE Sealed One obtain IT?"His gaze sharpened on her.
"Do I offend them enough, by the time this future comes, that to be rid of me... they allow it? Aid it? They let THE Sealed One reach IT?"
He looked at the face of the Provenance Lifeform, and she locked onto his eyes, and she smiled at him, sadly, and said nothing at all as she continued to eat!
Noah breathed out, and his eyes flashed coldly.

Every choice had a consequence. He had always known that. But he had not thought the butterfly of some future choice of his could grow wings THIS heavy, heavy enough that ancient things would part their hands and let a monster reach for It!

But whatever the future held... the present still mattered most! It always had! The future was a storm on a horizon, and the present was the ground under his feet, and he would keep doing everything he could on the ground he actually stood on!
HUUM!
He rose to his feet.

"Existence is."His voice rolled out quiet and certain over the fire. "The past is set, regardless of what anyone tries to do to it. And it seems even THE Sealed One has trouble collapsing me in that future, because if his reach tries to stretch back into the past to unmake me here... it should face the same difficulty you faced coming back. If not more. Existence does not like things moving backward."
His eyes settled on her.

"Even you, appearing here, in this time. That can be considered a loop being closed, not broken. You were always supposed to be here. At this exact moment. Which means the past is set."He said it again, to himself as much as to her, tasting the certainty of it. "The past is set. So..."
He walked toward her.
And he put out his hand.
"Let us have an official introduction, then. I am Osmont. Noah Osmont." His hand hung in the warm firelit air between them. "And you are..."

And the Provenance Lifeform raised her right hand to his, while she continued to eat with her left, and there was grace in the gesture, and an immensity under the grace, an old regality that no exhaustion and no blood could dim, and she took his hand and answered with quiet, total confidence.
"Thalia Vasiliou." Her eyes held his. "Your future destiny. And your present... Provenance."
BOOM!
