chapters.title: Chapter 5604: The Weight of All Things!
paragraphs: His Destiny! His Provenance!
She said the words with such total confidence that even Noah paused, because when he held her hand, he felt something he had not expected!

It was as though he were holding onto a boundless sun. A pull came off her frame through their joined hands, an unfathomable sense of attraction that reached into him and did not ask permission, drawing at his existence.
Thalia smiled, and let go!

"While I did say we have some leeway," she said, folding her hand back into her lap,"the dangers are very much real. You have to prepare. Nobody knows what THE Sealed One is truly capable of, with IT."
Her eyes stayed steady on his."I need to make sure that you and THE Infiniverse are ready. So that Mother, and the others, are safe."
Her poise was grand even seated in her own dried blood, and Noah looked at this unfathomable woman and repeated her name silently, cementing it into his existence.
Thalia Vasiliou. Thalia!
"And what could be done to prepare that I have not already set in motion?" he asked.
"Nobody progresses across existence as fast as I do."
Thalia looked up, and raised her brows.
"Do not be so sure."
Noah’s eyes sharpened.
"Existence is vast. And Provenance Lifeforms are grand." She set down her plate of light. "Even you have not fully grasped your own Provenance. By the measure of what you could be... you are weak."

"Us First Lifeforms. Our power comes from within. That is what makes us the strongest things in existence. It is also what makes us the slowest. Everything we are, we must generate. And so where our peers consume treasures, devour one another, drink external authorities to swell their power in leaps, we cannot. We can only spur our own existence to produce more, and more, and more Provenance. From nothing but ourselves."
"...Which is slow," Noah said.
"Which is agonizingly slow."A small nod. "So agonizing that among the very first of us, a technique was developed. A way to spur the existence to grow faster than it ever would on its own."
She wiped her lips with a slow grace and rose to her feet, and Noah caught himself watching the red of her lips as she moved.

"You always become distracted when you look at me."She said it as a simple, established fact. "But I need you to focus. This will be critical. We fortify you first, and then we fortify Mother and the others, so that even across time, their existences cannot be targeted, because THE Sealed One WILL reach for them, exactly as he reached for me. And for that, you need to be far more than you currently are."

Her expression steadied into something almost solemn. "This will injure me. So I will show it to you while I explain, and spend the cost only once. In the ages past, this was designed by lifeforms you and I would both revere."
She lifted her chin, and the exhaustion fell away from her bearing, and immensity gathered around her slender frame.
"This...is THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin."
HUUM!

"It is not a technique of movement, or of striking, or of casting,"Thalia said, and as she spoke, the air of the Realm began to change around her. "It is a technique of bearing. You have already met its shallowest cousin in your own bones, I think. The bearing of weight. This reaches out... and calls the weight down."
The blue gold hills groaned!

Above Thalia, the evening sky of the Realm darkened, and something began to descend, invisible and immense, pressing down toward her standing figure, and Noah’s senses flared as he read what it was, and his eyes widened!
It was the weight of Existence itself!

"You open your existence," she said, her voice tightening with the growing pressure, "and you invite the weight of all that surrounds you to settle upon it like a challenge through your Provenance. The weight of THE Primordial Source. The weight of Infinity. The weight of THE Argent Loom."

The white rivers of the Realm bent toward her, pouring their pressure onto her shoulders. "The weight of Dimensions. Of Observable Existences. Of the frameworks, the Scales, the whole architecture of everything near you."

Her knees bent under a load Noah could feel from where he stood, the grass caving in a wide ring beneath her. "And the weight of things you cannot yet perceive. All of it. Called down. Set upon a single existence, on purpose."

"It will try to crush you. That is the entire point. The weight becomes a catalyst. A pressure so total that your existence, refusing to be flattened, is forced to answer it, and the only answer a Provenance Lifeform has... is to generate! Pressed hard enough, from every direction at once, the existence spurs itself to produce more Provenance simply to have something to push back with. The weight is the enzyme. The Provenance is what it forces out of you!"
The pressure peaked, and Noah watched it happen!

Within Thalia’s dimmed depths, among her guttering constellations, a change moved, her existence straining against the descended weight of all things, and slowly, painfully, one of her dim singularities flickered, and brightened a fraction, spurred to answer a pressure that would not relent!

"And it does more than generate," she forced out, her frame trembling under the invisible mountain of existence. "The adversity refines you. The same weight that squeezes out your Provenance also grinds your existence finer, layer by layer, tempering what you are against the pressure of everything you are not. You come out the other side both greater... and truer"
Then she exhaled, and released it.
The weight lifted off her in a slow tide, the sky lightening, the grass beneath her sighing back up, and she stood breathing hard, one hand at her wounded chest!

"But understand the danger, because this is why it is a technique of the first among us and almost no one else." Her eyes were hard and clear. "You are calling down the weight of Existence itself. If you call too much, or hold it wrong, or your own generation cannot rise to meet the load in time... the weight does not simply hurt you. It flattens you out of existence entirely. One wrong movement, and the mountain you invited becomes the mountain that buries you. There is no injury to recover from. There is only perishing."
Noah’s gaze burned as he studied everything she had shown!

"It is simple to speak," Thalia continued, quieter, "and it is monstrous to begin. To even attempt the first cycle, an existence must meet heavy conditions. It must generate Provenance already, truly, from within, or it has nothing to answer the weight with and dies in the first breath. It must be able to bear great weight without shattering, or the load caves it instantly. And it must be true enough to itself that the pressure of all that is NOT itself cannot rewrite it into sediment." She looked at him.
And Noah’s eyes shone.

Generate Provenance from within. He had ten singularities! Bear great weight without shattering. He had...well, THE Yoke of the Standing Sky and a spine seated with the Telos of Paradox! Be true enough that the weight of everything else could not overwrite him. He was...Quintessentially true.
He looked towards Thalia because the cost had come due!

Her face had gone pale again as she spoke and demonstrated, the color she had eaten back into her cheeks draining away, a fresh line of stellar blood welling at her healing wound, the price of passing down even this knowledge landing on her Provenance exactly as she had warned!
And yet she remained unfettered, standing straight through it, and she wiped a thread of crimson gold from the corner of her lips, and looked at him, and said one word.
"Try."

It was as though he were holding onto a boundless sun.
A pull came off her frame through their joined hands, an unfathomable sense of attraction that reached into him and did not ask permission, drawing at his existence.
Thalia smiled, and let go!
"While I did say we have some leeway," she said, folding her hand back into her lap,"the dangers are very much real.
You have to prepare.
Nobody knows what THE Sealed One is truly capable of, with IT."
Her eyes stayed steady on his."I need to make sure that you and THE Infiniverse are ready.

Thalia Vasiliou.

chapters.title: Chapter 5605: Try!
paragraphs: Thalia waved her hand.

A single small singularity of light drifted off her fingertips and crossed the space between them, unhurried, turning slowly, and Noah lifted his own hand and let it settle against his palm, where it sank into him and unfolded, and the whole methodology of THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin flowed into his existence at once!

"Before you try, understand the shape of it,"Thalia said, lowering herself back to a seat on the grass, one hand resting light at her wounded chest. "Because failure here is not a bruise. It is a beginning erased."
Noah held still, receiving.

"You cannot simply call down the weight of Existence and stand under it as one man. The art works because the weight must course through the anatomy of your Provenance itself. It moves the way a resource moves. Directed. Channeled. Placed. And you begin at the smallest possible place."
"A cell?" Noah said, reading it even as she spoke.

"A single cell." She nodded. "You take the entire descending force of all incoming existence, every ounce of the weight you call down, and you land it on ONE cell of your body. And that one cell must bear the weight of THE Primordial Source, of Infinity, of THE Argent Loom, of Time, of Dimensions and Observable Existences and the imperceptible, alone, and survive it. And when it survives, when that single cell has borne all of existence and held... you move the weight. Off that cell. Onto the next one."
Noah’s eyes sharpened.

"There are fifty trillion cells in a Provenance Lifeform,"Thalia said quietly. "When each one of them, individually, one after another, has borne the full weight of Existence and survived it... the first cycle is complete."
Fifty trillion!
Fifty trillion times, the weight of all things called down onto a single point of him, borne, survived, and moved along! And she was not finished!

"This is why so few of even our kind walk this path," she continued. "Because if you fail with even a single cell, if one bursts under the weight instead of bearing it, the cycle collapses, and you begin again. From the first cell. Every time."Her eyes held his, steady and unsoftened.

"There is no partial progress. There is only a completed cycle, or a body that has to start over. And you will fail. Everyone fails, at the start. The question the art asks is not whether you can bear the weight once. It is whether you can begin again fifty trillion times without your will breaking before your body does."

"Each cycle, you call down more. More weight, more of existence, pressed through more of you at once, and each cycle your existence is forged grander against it. It is not only your Provenance that swells. It is the whole of what you are, tempered by adversity."Her hand rose, and touched her own forearm.

"Early on, your skin alone begins to change. Cultivate far enough, and that skin, with no Provenance spent at all, no art, no essence, nothing but what the weight has made of it... will reject the power of any Primeval One. It will turn aside the strike of a Descendant the way a wall turns rain."
Noah went very still at that.

"And beyond that?" Thalia’s voice dropped, quiet and vast. "Cycle upon cycle upon cycle, the body climbs through tiers most never live to see. A stage where your flesh alone shrugs off authorities that flatten Provenance Lifeforms. A stage where, cultivated high enough..."She looked at him.

"You could stand before one of Those Who Remain, in the flesh, and feel no pressure at all. Not because you shielded yourself. Because your existence had simply been made heavy enough, and true enough, to stand in the same room as theirs and remain unbent."
Stand before one of Those Who Remain, and feel nothing!
The words settled into Noah with enormous weight of their own, and his eyes burned, because a path that ended there was a path worth fifty trillion failures!
|You have received the initial methodology of THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin.|

|A cultivation art of THE First Lifeforms. You call down the weight of surrounding Existence and channel it, through the anatomy of your Provenance, onto a single cell of your body, which must bear it alone and survive. The weight is then moved to the next cell. When all cells have individually borne the full weight, one cycle completes. Cycles repeat without limit, each calling down more, each refining your existence grander and truer.|

|Per-cell reinforcement: a cell that bears the full weight and survives does not merely endure. In the moment of surviving, your existence floods that cell with Provenance, and the pressure that would have shattered it instead tempers it, the way a blade is quenched. That single cell is remade, reinforced with your own generation, refined until it can withstand the weight of Existence itself and hold. It is no longer ordinary anatomy. It has become one grain of a true Provenance Body.|
|Failure of a single cell collapses the cycle. You begin again from the first cell. There is no partial progress.|
|THE FIVE TIERS OF THE PROVENANCE BODY:|

|FIRST TIER- THE SEDIMENT-SHED SKIN: the outer body is remade. Your skin alone, with no Provenance spent, rejects the authority of Primeval Ones and Descendants, turning aside their strikes as a wall turns rain.|
|SECOND TIER- THE UNBREAKING PROVENANCE FRAME: flesh and sinew are remade. ???|
|THIRD TIER- THE WEIGHT-BEARING SOVEREIGN BONES: ???.|
|FOURTH TIER- ???.|
|FIFTH TIER- ???. You may stand in the flesh before one of Those Who Remain and feel no pressure at all...|
|Conditions to attempt met: you generate Provenance from within. You bear great weight without shattering. You are true enough that what is not you cannot overwrite you.|
|Warning: the weight you invite can flatten you out of existence.|
Noah breathed out slowly, and set his stance on the grass, and closed his eyes.
He reached out with his existence and pulsed his Provenance Essence out into the surroundings almost like a challenge.
As if he was telling existence...come at me!
The sky of the Realm darkened. The hills groaned. And the weight of Existence began to descend toward him, invisible and total!
Noah gathered all of it, and channeled it through the anatomy of his ten singularities, and aimed the entire crushing mountain of it at a single cell within his body!
A cell inside his palm.
He raised his hand and looked at his palm thst pulsed, observing that single cell as...
BOOM!
The cell burst instantly!

It did not bear the weight for even a fraction of a moment! The full force of existence landed on one point of him and that point simply ceased, and worse, it did not end there, because the sudden collapse tore into the cells around it, and a chain reaction ripped outward, a million cells bursting in a cascade before Noah could wrench the weight back up off his own body!

He staggered, and stellar crimson gold blood sprayed from his palm as a ragged wound of ruptured existence bloomed, the mountain of weight scattering back into the Realm’s air as his control shattered!
He had failed. Instantly. Completely. On the very first cell!
Noah wiped the blood and looked up.
And Thalia was watching him calmly, seated in the grass, entirely unsurprised.
"Failure is the sudden, illuminating friction between what we imagined and what simply is."

She gestured at the grass before him, and settled her hand back over her wound, and there was no pity anywhere in her, only a boundless, patient certainty that reached into him like the pull of a sun.
"Try again."
WAA!
But Noah did not try again. Not yet.
Istead of reaching for the weight a second time, he turned his attention inward, and examined the art itself. Piece by piece.
And as he examined it, his existence pulsed!

It rose out of his depths without his willing it, the plain Quintessential tyranny that had crowned him, the same voice that had refused a borrowed system and cast out an entire ocean of power to build his own, and it looked at THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin, this grand and ancient technique of the First Lifeforms, and it rejected it!
Not because the art was weak. Because the art was not HIS.
"This is a magnificent technique. Truly. But I...am not going to use it."
HUUM!
Thalia said nothing. She only watched him!
"I watched why it failed. My cell burst the instant the weight touched it, and it burst because a cell is too large." He held up one hand, turning it slowly in the firelight.

"A single cell is a crowded thing. It contains so much. Structures, and processes, and pieces beyond count, all bound together, all interfering, all of them a hundred different points where the weight of Existence can find a seam and tear. You asked one cell to bear everything, and the cell had too many parts to hold anything cleanly. It did not fail because I was weak. It failed because the vessel was impure."
His eyes lit with a cold, climbing brilliance.
"So I will not start at the cell. I will go smaller. Far smaller. Smaller than the cell, smaller than the molecule, smaller than the atom itself!"His voice rose, tyranny gathering under every word.

"Because the smaller I begin, the purer the vessel is, and the purer the vessel, the more perfectly it can bear a pure and total weight! I will not ask a crowded cell to hold all of existence. I will ask a single, simple, indivisible thing to hold it!"
He closed his hand into a fist.
"I will start with my quarks!"
HUUM!

"There are two hundred Decillion quarks in my existence,"Noah declared, and the number rolled out of him without strain, "and every single one of them will individually bear the weight of Existence! One quark. The weight of Existence imposed on the purest and simplest vessel my body owns, borne, survived, reinforced, and moved to the next!"
The grass caved around him. The sky darkened. And Thalia’s eyes were shining now, wide and fixed on him!

His ten singularities blazed to life on his chest, incandescent blue drowning the fire."This will be my technique. Not borrowed. Not inherited. Generated, from the truth of my own existence, the way everything I own must be. This will be MY first Provenance Art!"
He threw his head back, and named it into the darkening sky of his own Realm.
"THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis!"
HUUM!
His Provenance Essences pulsed brilliantly, ten suns turning on his chest, and the whole Realm rang like a struck bell around the naming!
And as the art settled into his existence, it took on one more dimension that even he had not spoken aloud, because his nine Teloi answered the design on their own!
|You have designed a Provenance Art of your own: THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis.|

|It shares its root with THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin, and diverges completely in execution. Where the Genesis conditions a Provenance Body cell by cell, your art conditions your existence from its subatomic foundation, quark by quark, across the 200 Decillion quarks that compose you. A vessel this small holds no seam for the weight to tear, and so bears a purer and more total load.|

|A further divergence, arising from your Nine Osmontian Provenance Teloi: a quark that merely survives the weight is not enough for you. In the moment a quark bears the full weight of Existence, you seat one of your Teloi within it, and the weight, the Provenance, and the aim fuse. The quark is not simply reinforced.It is REMADE into a PROVENANCE TELOS QUARK: a subatomic vessel that is stable, self-generating, and aimed, carrying a grain of Quintessence, or Existence, or Paradox, or Chaos, or Adversity, or Apocalypse, or Mana, or Harvest, or Tyranny within it.|

|A quark is only counted as borne once it has become a stable Provenance Telos Quark. Only then may the weight move to the next. An unstable quark that has taken the weight but not yet seated an aim will collapse, and its collapse fails the cycle.|

|Consequence of completion: an existence rebuilt in this way is not a body threaded with Teloi. It is a body in which every one of 200 Decillion foundational particles is itself a seated aim. Your Nine Teloi would no longer sit in nine organs. They would compose the whole of your matter, from the ground up, indivisible from what you physically are.|
|The five tiers of the Provenance Body will be reformed under your vision as you see fit.|
Noah read the technical shape of what he had made, and a slow, cold smile touched his mouth, because this was right!
Without any further word, without pause, without a breath of hesitation, he got started!

He reached out with his existence, and called the weight of all things down once more, THE Primordial Source and Infinity and THE Argent Loom and Dimensions and the imperceivable descending toward him in an invisible mountain, and this time he did not aim it at a cell!

He channeled it through the anatomy of his ten singularities, refined it, narrowed it, focused the entire crushing weight of Existence down to a single point finer than any his body had ever isolated, and he set it upon one quark!
One indivisible thing. One pure vessel. The whole weight of everything, landing on the smallest true piece of him!
And the quark trembled, and strained, and did not burst!
It did not burst!

Across the glory, Thalia Vasiliou watched him work, watched the man call down the weight of Existence and shatter a grand old art to build his own in the span of a single failure, and she raised one hand, slowly, and wiped away a tear that had gathered at the corner of her eye.
A sad tear. A relieved one. Both at once.
He truly was her Provenance. He...made the same choice even now!

Noah gathered all of it, and channeled it through the anatomy of his ten singularities, and aimed the entire crushing mountain of it at a single cell within his body!
A cell inside his palm.
He raised his hand and looked at his palm thst pulsed, observing that single cell as...
BOOM!
The cell burst instantly!
It did not bear the weight for even a fraction of a moment!

The full force of existence landed on one point of him and that point simply ceased, and worse, it did not end there, because the sudden collapse tore into the cells around it, and a chain reaction ripped outward, a million cells bursting in a cascade before Noah could wrench the weight back up off his own body!

He staggered, and stellar crimson gold blood sprayed from his palm as a ragged wound of ruptured existence bloomed, the mountain of weight scattering back into the Realm’s air as his control shattered!
He had failed.
Instantly.
Completely.
On the very first cell!
Noah wiped the blood and looked up.
And Thalia was watching him calmly, seated in the grass, entirely unsurprised.
"Failure is the sudden, illuminating friction between what we imagined and what simply is."

She gestured at the grass before him, and settled her hand back over her wound, and there was no pity anywhere in her, only a boundless, patient certainty that reached into him like the pull of a sun.
"Try again."
WAA!
But Noah did not try again.
Not yet.
Istead of reaching for the weight a second time, he turned his attention inward, and examined the art itself.
Piece by piece.
And as he examined it, his existence pulsed!

It rose out of his depths without his willing it, the plain Quintessential tyranny that had crowned him, the same voice that had refused a borrowed system and cast out an entire ocean of power to build his own, and it looked at THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin, this grand and ancient technique of the First Lifeforms, and it rejected it!
Not because the art was weak.
Because the art was not HIS.
"This is a magnificent technique.
Truly.
But I...am not going to use it."
HUUM!
Thalia said nothing.
She only watched him!
"I watched why it failed.
My cell burst the instant the weight touched it, and it burst because a cell is too large." He held up one hand, turning it slowly in the firelight.
"A single cell is a crowded thing.
It contains so much.
Structures, and processes, and pieces beyond count, all bound together, all interfering, all of them a hundred different points where the weight of Existence can find a seam and tear.
You asked one cell to bear everything, and the cell had too many parts to hold anything cleanly.
It did not fail because I was weak.
It failed because the vessel was impure."
His eyes lit with a cold, climbing brilliance.
"So I will not start at the cell.
I will go smaller.
Far smaller.
Smaller than the cell, smaller than the molecule, smaller than the atom itself!"His voice rose, tyranny gathering under every word.
"Because the smaller I begin, the purer the vessel is, and the purer the vessel, the more perfectly it can bear a pure and total weight!
I will not ask a crowded cell to hold all of existence.
I will ask a single, simple, indivisible thing to hold it!"
He closed his hand into a fist.
"I will start with my quarks!"
HUUM!
"There are two hundred Decillion quarks in my existence,"Noah declared, and the number rolled out of him without strain, "and every single one of them will individually bear the weight of Existence!
One quark.
The weight of Existence imposed on the purest and simplest vessel my body owns, borne, survived, reinforced, and moved to the next!"
The grass caved around him.
The sky darkened.
And Thalia’s eyes were shining now, wide and fixed on him!
His ten singularities blazed to life on his chest, incandescent blue drowning the fire."This will be my technique.
Not borrowed.
Not inherited.
Generated, from the truth of my own existence, the way everything I own must be.
This will be MY first Provenance Art!"
He threw his head back, and named it into the darkening sky of his own Realm.
"THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis!"
HUUM!
His Provenance Essences pulsed brilliantly, ten suns turning on his chest, and the whole Realm rang like a struck bell around the naming!
And as the art settled into his existence, it took on one more dimension that even he had not spoken aloud, because his nine Teloi answered the design on their own!
|You have designed a Provenance Art of your own: THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis.|
|It shares its root with THE Sovereign Genesis of the Weighted Origin, and diverges completely in execution.
Where the Genesis conditions a Provenance Body cell by cell, your art conditions your existence from its subatomic foundation, quark by quark, across the 200 Decillion quarks that compose you.
A vessel this small holds no seam for the weight to tear, and so bears a purer and more total load.|
|A further divergence, arising from your Nine Osmontian Provenance Teloi: a quark that merely survives the weight is not enough for you.
In the moment a quark bears the full weight of Existence, you seat one of your Teloi within it, and the weight, the Provenance, and the aim fuse.

The quark is not simply reinforced.It is REMADE into a PROVENANCE TELOS QUARK: a subatomic vessel that is stable, self-generating, and aimed, carrying a grain of Quintessence, or Existence, or Paradox, or Chaos, or Adversity, or Apocalypse, or Mana, or Harvest, or Tyranny within it.|
|A quark is only counted as borne once it has become a stable Provenance Telos Quark.
Only then may the weight move to the next.
An unstable quark that has taken the weight but not yet seated an aim will collapse, and its collapse fails the cycle.|
|Consequence of completion: an existence rebuilt in this way is not a body threaded with Teloi.
It is a body in which every one of 200 Decillion foundational particles is itself a seated aim.
Your Nine Teloi would no longer sit in nine organs.
They would compose the whole of your matter, from the ground up, indivisible from what you physically are.|
|The five tiers of the Provenance Body will be reformed under your vision as you see fit.|
Noah read the technical shape of what he had made, and a slow, cold smile touched his mouth, because this was right!
Without any further word, without pause, without a breath of hesitation, he got started!

He reached out with his existence, and called the weight of all things down once more, THE Primordial Source and Infinity and THE Argent Loom and Dimensions and the imperceivable descending toward him in an invisible mountain, and this time he did not aim it at a cell!

He channeled it through the anatomy of his ten singularities, refined it, narrowed it, focused the entire crushing weight of Existence down to a single point finer than any his body had ever isolated, and he set it upon one quark!
One indivisible thing.
One pure vessel.
The whole weight of everything, landing on the smallest true piece of him!
And the quark trembled, and strained, and did not burst!
It did not burst!

Across the glory, Thalia Vasiliou watched him work, watched the man call down the weight of Existence and shatter a grand old art to build his own in the span of a single failure, and she raised one hand, slowly, and wiped away a tear that had gathered at the corner of her eye.
A sad tear.
A relieved one.
Both at once.
He truly was her Provenance.
He...made the same choice even now!

chapters.title: Chapter 5606: Two Halves!
paragraphs: The first quark held, and Noah seated a Telos within it instead!

His Telos of Adversity answered first, a grain of the aim that lived in his lungs threading down into the borne quark, and the weight and the Provenance and the aim fused in one instant, and the quark stabilized and turned bright and stayed! One Provenance Telos Quark, the first grain of a body that would eventually be nothing but grains like it!
He moved the weight to the next one.
And the grandness of what followed filled the Realm from its first hill to its last!

The weight of Existence hung over him unending, an invisible mountain of THE Primordial Source and Infinity and THE Argent Loom and Time and Dimensions and Observable Existences and everything imperceivable, and Noah stood beneath it and did not sway, and quark after quark took the whole of it and held!
Bear, seat, stabilize, move! Bear, seat, stabilize, move!

The rhythm found itself and then quickened, ten quarks, a hundred, a thousand, the weight sliding through the anatomy of his ten singularities with less and less friction as his existence learned the shape of its own art!
And Thalia Vasiliou did not take her eyes off him.
She sat in the grass with her hand at her wound and she watched, and she did not blink more than she had to, because what she was watching should not have been happening!

There was supposed to be failure here! There was supposed to be a body bursting and starting over, and starting over, and starting over, and instead there was a man beneath the weight of all things transforming himself particle by particle without a single collapse!
Because Noah’s body was changing in real time.

His muscles rolled beneath his skin, sliding and pulsing as though they were being rewritten while they moved, fibers unmaking and remaking themselves denser with every thousand quarks converted! His frame drew tighter and grander, shoulders broadening under a weight that would have flattened Dimensions, his bare chest hardening as stellar blue threaded through the crimson gold of his blood beneath the surface!

His hair lifted in the pressureless air. His obsidian singularity pupils burned brighter. And all of him took on the bearing of some ancient lifeform overcoming its own limits again and again, tearing past the ceiling of what it was, then finding a new ceiling and tearing past that too, an existence in the middle of arguing with the size of itself and winning!
Ten thousand quarks!

Fifty thousand! The grass beneath him had caved into a crater and the hills groaned around the crater’s rim! Eighty thousand! His breathing had gone deep and slow and enormous, each inhale pulling the weight further into him instead of pushing it away!
One hundred thousand Provenance Telos Quarks!
And on the one hundred and first thousand... his existence ERUPTED!
BOOM!

Provenance detonated out of his depths in a flood, all ten singularities blazing at once as the accumulated generation of a hundred thousand aimed and remade particles finally crossed some threshold his existence had been climbing toward without telling him, and in the incandescent blue storm at his core...
An eleventh singularity bloomed!
Eleven! He had broken past the count of ten, and the moment he did, the moment that new sun turned its first turn, something else happened, and Noah felt it arrive at the sides of his own head.
Radiant...blue wings bloomed!

They unfurled on either side of his head in brilliant light, wide and layered and beautiful, feathers of pure incandescent Provenance stretching out from his temples, and for one breath the Realm was lit by them alone!
Then the wings tranaformed!

They folded inward, drew together, condensed, and out of each of them rose a figure! Two miniature humanoids of stellar blue gold light, each hovering at either side of his head, each no larger than a forearm, and each one wearing his own face!
Two versions of Noah Osmont, floating at his temples with their eyes closed.

The one at his right sat cross-legged in the air, hands resting open on its knees, its light soft and even and warm, a stillness coming off it that felt like the doorway of his long hall and the murmur of his river and the calm of a man entirely aimed.Peace, personified. His Provenance as the thing that heals, protects, and gathers.

The one at his left stood upright with its arms folded, and its light burned dark gold at the edges, and its miniature frame carried a fiendish ancient weight that made the air around it feel narrower, a crown of shadowed brilliance turning above its head.Tyranny, personified. His Provenance as the thing that takes, breaks, and rules.
Both of them kept their eyes closed. Both of them waited.
HUUM!
|Your Provenance Essence has broken past the count of 10. PROVENANCE: 11.|

|A threshold has been crossed. The generation of 100,000 Provenance Telos Quarks and 11th Provenance Essence has produced what your art was designed to produce: an existence that no longer merely holds Provenance, but personifies it.|
|A UNIQUE PRECEPT has been written: THE PRECEPT OF THE SUNDERED PROVENANCE.|
|Your Provenance now expresses itself as two manifestations of yourself, seated at either side of your head: THE PROVENANCE OF THE OPEN HAND and THE PROVENANCE OF THE CLOSED CROWN.|

|THE PROVENANCE OF THE OPEN HAND: the peaceful half of your generation, personified. It heals, shelters, gathers, and mends, and it will pursue your Provenance through kindness by whatever means it judges best.|

|THE PROVENANCE OF THE CLOSED CROWN: the tyrannical half of your generation, personified. It breaks, claims, rules, and ends, and it will pursue your Provenance through dominion by whatever means it judges best.|

|You may select one to act. The selected manifestation carries out your Provenance however IT chooses, requiring nothing further from you: you may sit back entirely. Whichever one acts expresses power at twice your own current strength.|
|Only one may be awake at a time. What one begins, the other cannot undo.|
|Your cultivation has borne further fruit. VERITAS: 14. PONDUS: 16. Your existence has been refined by the imposed adversity of all things.|
|100,000 of 200 Decillion quarks converted. Cycle 1 continues.|
Noah opened his eyes and looked at his own immensity.

At the eleven suns turning in his depths. At the two small versions of himself floating at his temples with their eyes shut, one open-handed and still, one crowned and folded, both of them him, both of them waiting to be chosen. At his own hands, which had been rebuilt one hundred thousand particles’ worth while he stood in one place, and which now held a weight of presence that made the very grass lean away from them.
Twice his current strength. From a thing that acted on its own judgment while he sat back and watched.
He had wondered, once, what an Art built on Provenance Essence itself rather than through his blood would give him. Now he knew!
And ahead of him, Thalia Vasiliou nodded slowly.
She had watched every moment of it without once looking away.
"You should be good, for now."Her hand pressed lightly at her healing chest as she rose to her feet. "But the others are not."
Noah’s gaze sharpened.

"Can we..." And for the first time since she had come out of the white pool, her composure thinned, and what came through the gap was not a Provenance Lifeform of constellations and immensity, but something much smaller and much older in its want.
"Can we go see Mother?"

chapters.title: Chapter 5607: Your Most Favorite!
paragraphs: Mother!
Noah looked at this unique lifeform before him, and wondered just what her future with him had actually been. Mother. Not "your mother." Mother, the way a person says it about their own.
He felt the Provenance and the power rolling through his existence, eleven suns turning in his depths, and he nodded and turned to lead the way...
And Thalia hummed, and started walking.

She crossed the grass of his Realm without waiting for him, unhurried, her bare feet finding the path between the standing stones as though she had walked it ten thousand times, and she angled toward the distant doorway with the ease of a woman going home!
Noah followed.

"Causes," she said as she walked. "That is where we start. Causes are one of the surest protections in all of existence, because they do not require the protected to do anything at all. A being backed by Causes is simply harder to touch. The Causes stand under their existence, and anything reaching for them has to reach through those first."
"Yours are not Causes anymore. What you have covers you well enough, and they extend to Mother to a degree, because she is the Originator."She stepped over the river of light without looking down.

"But the others? Barely at all. Your daughter, your son, your people, the ones who eat at your table and sleep inside your home. If something reached for them tomorrow, most of them would have nothing beneath their existence but your reputation."
Noah’s eyes pulsed as he asked grandly...
"Is there anything more you can reveal so I have a better picture?"

"Its all because of him."Her voice cooled. "What I can say without paying too dearly is that something happened to the mind of THE Sealed One. Before he attained IT, his mind had seemingly... shattered."

"He now moves with different motivations depending on the vessel he is wearing. One will be reasonable. One will collect. One will burn a Dimension for the pleasure. Too many things about him are unknown, even to me, but two are certain. His main vessel is vindictive. And he is tying up loose ends."She glanced back over her shoulder. "You are an unfathomably big loose end."

Noah walked behind her figure as she moved through his own home like she owned a key to it, and he watched her dazzling red hair catch the last of the evening light, and the grace of how she moved and talked, that composure that never once slipped even while she bled...
And at this time, a voice spoke up in a heavy, cool tone.
"We got a baddie right beside us who obviously has history, and why ain’t we made a move yet? Just tap me in and let me do what needs to be done."
Noah blinked!

The voice had come from the left side of his head, and it was HIS OWN voice, deeper and colder and entirely unbothered, and THE Provenance of the Closed Crown had actually spoken, arms still folded, crown of shadowed brilliance still turning, its grand eyes still closed!
And not a moment later, another voice echoed out from his right.
"All things happen in due time. She is obviously traumatized by whatever happened, and we are different from the man she later knows. Give her time. Let her acclimate."
THE Provenance of the Open Hand, cross-legged and calm, hands open on its knees, eyes closed as well.

Noah felt like he was going insane, and yet not, because this was not madness. This was simply listening to his own thoughts the way he always had, except now they were sorted, separated, defined out to their absolute extremes, and spoken aloud, loud and clear, by two halves of himself that no longer bothered to compromise before reaching him!

"Every time she looks at us,"THE Closed Crown said, "her entire existence exudes how much she wants to come close to us. Our future self already did all the work. All that is left is for us not to drop the ball, and you want to kick the ball away?"A pause. "We can also use this as a chance to understand the anatomy of a genuine Provenance Lifeform."
"Our anatomy is what matters most," THE Open Hand answered calmly. "Do not rush a process. And think about her."
His thoughts buzzed in his mind, and he was so focused on the argument happening at both sides of his own head that he did not notice they had left his Provenance Realm entirely!

The doorway had passed behind them, and the endless blue of THE Infiniverse had opened and closed, and now he was floating in the skies above a realm of harvests and abundance, golden fields rolling out beneath him under a warm sun, orchards heavy, rivers bright.
His mother’s realm.
Thalia turned back in the air to look at him, and her eyes went to the two small figures floating at either side of his head, and a mischievous, knowing smile spread across her face.
"Are you hearing voices in your head, my Provenance?"Her smile deepened. "You should listen to your tyrannical side more."
BOOM!
And she took one step and vanished toward the lands below, leaving Noah floating there astonished, as the voice of THE Closed Crown boomed out angrily beside his ear.
"I fucking told you."
With no words at all, Noah went down as well!
Below, on a vibrant cliff overlooking a radiant river, Amelia Osmont sat fishing with Seo-yeon.

Two rods leaned out over the water, catching light. A small basket sat between them. Seo-yeon’s legs swung off the cliff edge as she watched her line with fierce concentration, and Amelia sat beside her with the deep unhurried ease of a woman who had earned every quiet hour she would ever get.
Thalia appeared behind them. Noah touched down a second later.
Both heads turned, and Seo-yeon brightened up, dropped her rod entirely, and smashed into Noah’s chest with a hug!
"Aba, you have changed again!"
"I have," Noah said, smiling as he patted her head.
Amelia turned with a smile of her own, and then her gaze moved past him, and found the red-haired woman standing on the grass in a white-blue robe stained with dried crimson gold.
"...Who is this?"
And Thalia walked forward with her eyes full of respect and adoration, and bowed to Amelia Osmont.
"Hello again, Ama." She straightened, composed as ever. "I am Thalia Vasiliou. Your most favorite daughter in law."

The doorway had passed behind them, and the endless blue of THE Infiniverse had opened and closed, and now he was floating in the skies above a realm of harvests and abundance, golden fields rolling out beneath him under a warm sun, orchards heavy, rivers bright.
His mother’s realm.
Thalia turned back in the air to look at him, and her eyes went to the two small figures floating at either side of his head, and a mischievous, knowing smile spread across her face.
"Are you hearing voices in your head, my Provenance?"Her smile deepened.
"You should listen to your tyrannical side more."
BOOM!
And she took one step and vanished toward the lands below, leaving Noah floating there astonished, as the voice of THE Closed Crown boomed out angrily beside his ear.
"I fucking told you."
With no words at all, Noah went down as well!
Below, on a vibrant cliff overlooking a radiant river, Amelia Osmont sat fishing with Seo-yeon.
Two rods leaned out over the water, catching light.
A small basket sat between them.

Seo-yeon’s legs swung off the cliff edge as she watched her line with fierce concentration, and Amelia sat beside her with the deep unhurried ease of a woman who had earned every quiet hour she would ever get.
Thalia appeared behind them.
Noah touched down a second later.
Both heads turned, and Seo-yeon brightened up, dropped her rod entirely, and smashed into Noah’s chest with a hug!
"Aba, you have changed again!"
"I have," Noah said, smiling as he patted her head.
Amelia turned with a smile of her own, and then her gaze moved past him, and found the red-haired woman standing on the grass in a white-blue robe stained with dried crimson gold.
"...Who is this?"
And Thalia walked forward with her eyes full of respect and adoration, and bowed to Amelia Osmont.
"Hello again, Ama." She straightened, composed as ever.
"I am Thalia Vasiliou.
Your most favorite daughter in law."

chapters.title: Chapter 5608: Tesseracts! I
paragraphs: Silence fell over the cliff!

Seo-yeon’s mouth opened. And Amelia turned her head slowly toward her son, looked at him for a long moment, then shook her head with the exasperation of a mother who had given up on receiving news in a timely fashion, walked forward, and raised Thalia’s bowed head with both hands and a smile.
"How did he hide you for so long without me knowing?"She kept hold of her. "Come on. Let us get to know each other."
"Mm!"
Thalia smiled brightly and nodded.
"I know you like fishing," she said as they walked."I have a technique that lets you fish across Dimensions, from your own home. The things you can catch..."

And she began talking to his mother so naturally, so easily, that both Noah and Seo-yeon stood there astonished, watching the two of them stroll off along the cliff together like they had been doing it for years.
And as they walked, Thalia’s voice arrived quietly in his mind.

’I will relax by Mother’s side for now. See if you can get started on expanding the backing of Causes on those closest to you. Existence is vast and full of terrors, and dangers are going to come at you and yours from all sides. You may be invulnerable... but your enemies will look for the easiest way to hurt you, and that way runs through the Provenance of those around you. And THE Sealed One is not your only enemy. To get me, you offended a great many Provenance Lifeforms. And another one of Those Who Remain.’
Such crazy words dropped on him, and Noah shook his head slowly while Seo-yeon leaned up and whispered against his chest.
"Aba. She is very pretty. I approve!"
Noah sighed.
"I approve as well."
He definitely approved. Everything this woman did and said was magnetizing to his very existence! But there were much more important matters right now, and his mind had already gone to them.

He knew the threads of existence connected to him. A few dozen beings within THE Infiniverse whose threads ran thick and bright, and many more whose connections were thinner but present all the same. To protect them all through Causes was hard, and it was also simple. Even Those Who Remain worked this way. Even THE Sleepless Fiend played with Causes inside the bodies of Steeds!
And for him to back somewhat weak lifeforms with Causes, the easiest way was something he had already done three times, for Seo-yeon, for Henry, and for his mother.
When he had made them backers of their own emerging Observable Existences.
THE Genesis Tesseract!
The thing he had gained from THE Tide That Owes Nothing, in return for reaching into a drowned existence and giving it another chance.
And THE Tide had been preserving the generation of boons for everything he had done and never claimed, for a while now, growing past all precedent while he told it to continue and walked away!
It seemed that now was the time to take all of it. Every generated boon, in the form he needed most.
Genesis Tesseracts.

It would mean the birth of many, many Observable Existences with many different founders, nested inside THE Infiniverse, and that would elevate HER as well, her Dimensionality, her Causes, the whole architecture of what she was, guaranteeing a web of Causes standing beneath everyone he loved!
Noah stretched his neck, and looked up at the warm golden sky of his mother’s realm.
"Infiniverse. It’s time to unleash all that has been generated within THE Tide That Owes Nothing."
From the surroundings, a grand affirmation came!
|Understood.|
The sky above his mother’s realm changed.

It began with a single point of light kindling high in the warm gold, and then another beside it, and then a hundred, and then the whole vault of the heavens was catching fire in quiet increments as the preserved generation of THE Tide That Owes Nothing came due all at once!
They bloomed into being like stars arriving early.

Every one of them a hypercube of deep blue-white, a cube nested inside a cube and joined across an axis the eye kept sliding off, edges burning with a light that had no business being that clean, and each one turned slowly in place, unfolding and refolding through a dimension that the sky of an Observable Existence simply had to make room for!

They littered the heavens from horizon to horizon, uncountable at a glance, a canopy of geometry hanging over golden fields and a radiant river, and the fields below lit up blue as their light came down through the orchards!
Seo-yeon’s eyes opened wide.
Far along the cliff, Amelia had stopped walking and beside her, Thalia Vasiliou looked up at a sky full of folded beginnings with an expression Noah could not read from where he stood.
HUUM!
|THE Tide That Owes Nothing has released everything it preserved for the first experiment of a Generation of a select prior reward.It bodes well for targeting the Laestrygonians as further rewards.|

|Ledger settled. Boons generated and held in trust for: leadership given to a domain. Protection given to millions. Marks given to the marked. Affirmation given to the grieving. Salvation given to the dying. A lineage given back to its bearer. A Sovereign given to existence. Death granted to a unique lifeform. Every act of giving you performed and never claimed a return for.|
|The Tide has answered in the form its ledger judged most fitting to what you gave.|
|Yield: 1,800 GENESIS TESSERACTS.|

|Each holds the Infinite Source Potential of a First Cause, and the latent template of all nine Prime Causes folded within. Each is the graspable seed of an entire Observable Existence, awaiting a founder honest enough to tell it what is true.|
|This is the largest single return in your records.|
Eighteen hundred!

Noah looked up at a sky he had accidentally filled. Eighteen hundred foundations, eighteen hundred nine-Cause structures, eighteen hundred sets of roots that could be planted beneath the existences of everyone who mattered to him!
It was a ridiculous number.
He raised his hands.
And he called them down.
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 5609: Tesseracts! II
paragraphs: The heavens answered as eighteen hundred Tesseracts fell out of the gold at once, streaming down in long blue-white lines toward the cliff, and they did not scatter or crash, they came to him, gathering into a vast slow orbit around his body, hundreds upon hundreds of folded hypercubes turning through the air in nested rings, their light washing the cliff and the river and the orchards in deep cerulean, and the whole realm hummed with the pressure of that much beginning held in one place!
Noah stood in the middle of his own storm of seeds, and turned to his daughter.
"Seo-yeon."
She looked up at him with wide shining eyes, and he reached into the orbit and drew out nine.
They drifted across to her, one after another, settling into a small ring around her, and their light lit her face blue as she stared at them.

"Nine," Noah said. "THE Mirrored Hearth was your first, now design nine more."He crouched to her level, the way he always did. "Whatever you want them to be. Reach for what you are, and let them take their shape from that. And when they are grown, ten Observable Existences will stand under your existence, and anything that ever reaches for you will have to reach through all ten first."
Seo-yeon’s small hands closed around the nearest hypercube with trembling hands!
And she nodded so hard her hair bounced!
Then Noah rose, and looked out over the turning orbit of everything else he held, and began sorting it in his mind.

Henry would receive multiple. Adelaide. Barbatos. Kazuhiko. Khor. Sigrid. Titano and the Emperor Penguin and Erikson and Lich Ra’Zan, Amser Modred, Malphas the butler who had been bowed to by a being that once mistreated him, Emotive, the nine Daughters of THE Dora Shath’yar, Naldine, even the arrogant goat Heidrun who would probably found something insufferable and beautiful!
Every single one of them, given not one seed but several, so that each existence at his table would stand on the backing of the Causes of MULTIPLE Observable Existences!
And after them, the ones whose threads ran thinner but ran all the same would receive something.
Not everyone could be what he was. That was simply true. Provenance was not transferable, and no gift he could make would let another being generate the way he generated!
But that had never been the only road to grandness!

Existence had frameworks, ancient and established and full of ladders, and he had spent his whole climb learning exactly how those ladders worked. Causes. Foundations. Observable Existences. Intents and Scales and Sources. The whole architecture that beings like THE Sleepless Fiend used to make Steeds carry Causes and Descendants carry sentences, the architecture that Vakochev had built a ladder out of and named after himself!
Noah could not make his people First Lifeforms.

But with eighteen hundred Genesis Tesseracts turning around him, he could make them unfathomably grand inside every framework that existence had ever offered, until each one of them stood on so many foundations that reaching them meant unmaking a dozen Observable Existences first!
And every single one of those Observable Existences would be born nested inside THE Infiniverse.
Which meant she would grow too.
His eyes lifted, and he got to work!
<THE Sealed One>
Far too many days had passed since a new Sword had stood in THE Hall of Swords.
The Hall did not stand anymore.

Its vaulted ceiling was gone, torn open to the raw dark of a separate Dimension of Existence that no longer had walls to separate it from anything. The ancient stone lay in continents of rubble. Out beyond where the Hall had ended, the fold of reality itself had been decimated for a distance no measure in the Source Lands bothered to keep, whole stretches of the Dimension hanging in unlit ruin, the light that had come from no visible source snuffed out entirely.
And THE Throne of Swords was broken.

The great obsidian structure of countless blades lay split down its center, and hundreds of the swords woven into it were shattered, each broken blade meaning a Source Armament somewhere across existence had just stopped being whole.
Before the ruin of that throne, THE Queen Regnant knelt.

Her hundreds of glistening tentacles were spread flat against the shattered stone, her gaunt elongated arms braced, her writhing head bowed so low that the pale suctioned tendrils around her clattering aperture brushed the ground.

Grey and obsidian flesh wept slime and something darker. The Primordial Source and Infinity running side by side through her existence still ran, still nearly touching union, and both of them guttered.
And she was not willing.

Every wet twitch of her said it. The tendrils along her torso strained upward against the posture, over and over, and were pressed back down. Her claws had gouged trenches into the stone beneath them from the effort of holding still. The kneel had been imposed on her body, and her existence had not agreed to it, and it went on refusing in small useless increments with every breath she did not have!
Behind her, in rows that stretched back through the rubble, the Swords of Existence knelt too. Mesozoic Scale beings and more... all of them down, all of them shroudless, most of them bleeding.
And walking through the ruin of it, unhurried, was a tall pale man in layered dark robes.
THE Sealed One looked around the wreckage with mild interest, and when he spoke, his voice carried easily through a Dimension too broken to echo.
"You know, I do not truly wish to destroy."
He stopped beside a fallen column and rested a hand on it.

"Destruction is expensive. It is loud, it is imprecise, and it leaves nothing behind that can be used."He looked up at the missing ceiling."I did not want this. This was the cost of a hall that would not open its doors."
"...Then unbend my spine," THE Queen Regnant said, "and we will discuss doors, O Infinite Liar."
Her voice came out of the bowed writhing mass, and even flattened, even wrecked, it was sweet. Calm and sweet, almost gentle!
"There she is."THE Sealed One smiled slightly."I was hoping the pressure had not taken the voice. Your voice is the finest thing in this hall. Was, I suppose."

"I am making an offer right now." He resumed walking, threading between kneeling rows."I seek to rule. That is all. Not to end. You, the Swords, the True Lifeforms, the Primeval Ones who graze across THE Source Lands and think their earliness makes them permanent, all of it will soon fall to me. And the falling is not the point. What comes after is the point."
"After?"Her teeth clattered. "You ground an Age of your own children into three pills and ate one where everyone could watch. What exactly do you imagine comes after, for the rest of us?"
He crouched, comfortable amid the rubble and smiled.

"Do you know how many exceptional lifeforms existence produces in an Age? Thousands. Do you know how many of them ever amount to anything, left to their own devices? A handful. The rest bloat, and squabble, and are eventually eaten by something with a better appetite, and every ounce of what they were goes into a mouth that does nothing with it."
His voice stayed perfectly reasonable.

"I took an Age of waste and I concentrated it. Their potential exists TODAY, doing something, instead of having been spent on nothing across ten thousand pointless little conflicts. Nothing was destroyed. Things were merely... reassigned."

"My disciples...my Followers...Do you imagine I felt nothing? I remember all of their names. Every one. I keep them, which is more than existence ever offered them. Existence would have forgotten them entirely. I am the only reason a single one of those disciples still exists in any form at all."He tilted his head. "A farmer does not hate his pigs when the winter comes. But he does remember which ones fed him."
Her tendrils strained upward again, and were pressed down again.

"That is the part none of you ever understand," THE Sealed One continued, rising, brushing dust from his robes. "You think I am hungry. Hunger is what I use, it is not what I am for. Look at what existence IS. Chaos. Dimensions folding into other Dimensions and drowning everything inside them while nobody is even accountable for the folding. Millions of petty sovereignties, each one certain it is the center, all of them grinding against each other forever, and the total sum of all that motion across all those Ages is... nothing. No direction. No decision. No one accountable."
HUUM!

His voice sharpened, and for one moment something almost passionate showed through the collector’s calm."I do not want to eat existence, Your Little Majesty. I want to FINISH it. I want one hand on it, and one accounting, and an end to the endless committee of the useless mighty. And I am the only being who has been at this long enough to do it. Fuck Those Who Remain as they won’t do it, so I will do it on their behalf."
THE Queen Regnant was silent for a long moment.
"And your followers?" she said at last."In this finished existence of yours. Do they get names, or do they get shells?"
"They get to be part of something that arrived somewhere."He said it gently.
He walked past her, toward the split obsidian throne, and stopped in front of the broken blades of every Sword in existence.

"I will not rush this. I never rush." His pale hand traced the shattered edge. "There is a being out there, a new thing that you have met before, a genuine anomaly, and he cannot be handled the way anything else is handled. Strike him unprepared and you do not wound him, you feed him. Every adversity he survives makes him grander. So I do not offer him adversity. I offer him nothing at all, and I gather, and I map, and I wait, and when I finally move it will not be a contest he can survive and grow from. It will be a collection."He glanced back over his shoulder.
"Do you see the discipline in that? I have watched a thousand mighty things die of impatience. I intend to die of nothing."
"You may consider yourself a preparation. It is not an insult. Everything is a preparation."
He turned fully then, and looked out over the rows of the kneeling, and the mildness in him thinned into something very old.
"One last thing, and then I will leave you to your rubble and your thinking."
The ruined Dimension held still.

"Lately, I have begun hearing whispers." His borrowed eyes lifted, past the missing ceiling, into the unlit dark. "From myself. From a version of me that is not here, and has not happened yet, speaking backward into the ear of the one who is."
He listened for a moment, and the smile that came over his face was almost reverent."I do not yet know all of what he says. But I know the shape of it. And whatever is coming..."
HUUM!
"...it seems to be GRAND."

Dimensions folding into other Dimensions and drowning everything inside them while nobody is even accountable for the folding.
Millions of petty sovereignties, each one certain it is the center, all of them grinding against each other forever, and the total sum of all that motion across all those Ages is... nothing.
No direction.
No decision.
No one accountable."
HUUM!
His voice sharpened, and for one moment something almost passionate showed through the collector’s calm."I do not want to eat existence, Your Little Majesty.
I want to FINISH it.
I want one hand on it, and one accounting, and an end to the endless committee of the useless mighty.
And I am the only being who has been at this long enough to do it.
Fuck Those Who Remain as they won’t do it, so I will do it on their behalf."
THE Queen Regnant was silent for a long moment.
"And your followers?" she said at last."In this finished existence of yours.
Do they get names, or do they get shells?"
"They get to be part of something that arrived somewhere."He said it gently.
He walked past her, toward the split obsidian throne, and stopped in front of the broken blades of every Sword in existence.
"I will not rush this.
I never rush." His pale hand traced the shattered edge.
"There is a being out there, a new thing that you have met before, a genuine anomaly, and he cannot be handled the way anything else is handled.
Strike him unprepared and you do not wound him, you feed him.
Every adversity he survives makes him grander.
So I do not offer him adversity.
I offer him nothing at all, and I gather, and I map, and I wait, and when I finally move it will not be a contest he can survive and grow from.
It will be a collection."He glanced back over his shoulder.
"Do you see the discipline in that?
I have watched a thousand mighty things die of impatience.
I intend to die of nothing."
"You may consider yourself a preparation.
It is not an insult.
Everything is a preparation."
He turned fully then, and looked out over the rows of the kneeling, and the mildness in him thinned into something very old.
"One last thing, and then I will leave you to your rubble and your thinking."
The ruined Dimension held still.
"Lately, I have begun hearing whispers." His borrowed eyes lifted, past the missing ceiling, into the unlit dark.
"From myself.
From a version of me that is not here, and has not happened yet, speaking backward into the ear of the one who is."
He listened for a moment, and the smile that came over his face was almost reverent."I do not yet know all of what he says.
But I know the shape of it.
And whatever is coming..."
HUUM!
"...it seems to be GRAND."

chapters.title: Chapter 5610: Which One Am I?
paragraphs: <THE Sealed One>
Far from THE Source Lands.
Deep in THE Infinite Carcosa, in the drifting Dimension called THE Hollow Argosy, an army stood waiting.
Millions of them!

Rank upon rank of Infinite True Lifeforms filled the middle distance, their silent seas running silver through their frames, escalation stacked upon escalation until the air of the Dimension rang with compounding weight.

Beside them and above them stood the Gilded Ones in their brilliance, amplified Egos burning gold and white across the ranks, an ocean of exposed glory that lit the underside of the Dimension’s broken sky.
Millions of the mighty, holding formation in silence, waiting on one man at the forefront.
And at the forefront stood a vessel of THE Sealed One.
This one wore a tall frame in dark imperial layers, hands clasped behind its back, and it looked out over the assembled millions with the easy pleasure of an owner walking his own fields.
Beside him stood a Primeval Lifeform.

The old thing was pale as cooled glass, tall and thin and hairless, its flesh carrying the faint grain of stone that had been polished across ages by nothing but time. Its eyes did not blink and did not warm. It had watched the gathering of this army the way it watched everything, from a great distance that had nothing to do with the space between them, and every line of it made plain that it found the being beside it distasteful.
And it obeyed anyway.
"What are your plans?" the Primeval said.

The vessel smiled. "The plan is rulership. All of these forces, spread across the Carcosa, taking region after region under one accounting. Not slaughter. Subjugation. A thing that has been subjugated still works."
"Rulership for its own sake."

"No. Never for its own sake." The vessel turned his head. "What I am seeking cannot be grasped by any being that only wields power. It can only be grasped by one who holds rulership over a large portion of Existence, and who carries a tremendously high Dimensionality. And those two things go hand in hand most of the time. Rule enough of existence and your Dimensionality rises to meet what you rule. Raise your Dimensionality and you begin to perceive what is worth ruling."
He gestured out over the silver and gold ranks. "So I gather. And with every region that answers to me, I climb, and the thing I am reaching for comes a little further into view."
He clasped his hands. "Now. Your assignments..."
The Primeval waited.
"THE Pale Meridian first. The old spine of roads through the Carcosa, where every crossing eventually touches. Take it under my name."
"Then THE Nine Silent Markets. True Lifeforms have bartered there since before many had names..."
The vessel continued smoothly to list names of various places within THE Infinite Carcosa!

"After the Markets, THE Ossuary Terraces. Stacked bones of dead Observable Existences, gigaparsecs of them, and every scavenger in the Carcosa keeps a house on those terraces. Clear them, and hold them, subjugate all of them."
The Primeval regarded him with its unblinking, unwarming stare as if he wanted to ask...was that fucking all? Because that was a lot!
But in the end...
"As you command"
"Mm. As I command."The vessel’s smile widened, and he changed subjects entirely with the ease of a man turning a page. "Do you know what I like about this particular body I am wearing?"
The Primeval said nothing.
"This one is unique among all my vessels. It is the only one I did not take."The vessel raised his own hand and studied it, turning it in the light of a million Gilded auras.

"This one came for ME. It was ambitious enough, and frankly stupid enough, to attempt to assimilate something as True as I am, carrying a Dimensionality it could not have measured on its best day. That should have ended the way such things always end. Something small opens its mouth around something enormous and discovers what enormous means."
He flexed the borrowed fingers.
"And yet, somehow... he actually succeeded."

"Not completely and definitely not cleanly. But he got his teeth into the thing he bit, and it held, and what stood up afterward was not him and was not entirely me either."The vessel sounded genuinely delighted.

"This portion of myself is half me, and half this vessel. Neither party filed a complaint, because by the time either of us could have, there was no longer a clean seam to complain across."He looked out over the waiting army with something almost like affection.

"Existence is so unique. All the Mutants. All the Anomalies. You spend eons believing you have catalogued every way a thing can go wrong, and then some ambitious creature swallows a piece of you and comes out the other side as a co-author."
"Ah, I just find it interesting, and I do not find much interesting anymore."The vessel waved a hand at the ranks. "Go. THE Pale Meridian in a few days."

The Primeval turned without a word, and the silver and gold sea parted around it as it walked into the army, and the ranks began to move behind it, millions of the mighty flowing out of THE Hollow Argosy toward the roads of the Carcosa.
And the vessel of THE Sealed One stood alone at the forefront, and hummed.

It was a small hum, and an old one, and it did not belong to THE Sealed One at all. It belonged to whoever this body had been, and the vessel let it come out anyway, and then it stopped humming and smiled at nothing.
"Adrastia," he said. "Emperor King. Sealed One."
He tilted his head.
"Which one am I, in this vessel?"
The ranks flowed past. The broken sky held its light.

"Due to the fact that I cannot even imagine harming little Rose, or a single one of those inside your Inner Dimension..."He laughed softly, and the laugh had two textures in it, one patient and ancient, and one that was simply a young man’s. "Am I you? Or are you me?"
"Hmm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 5611: Chain Them! I
paragraphs: <Axon>

Gigaparsecs from THE Ymnaros, inside a pocket of dimension that had been folded out of the dark and would be folded back into it within the hour, two collared servants of an unnamed order made their report.

The pocket held nothing! No stone, no floor, no light of its own. Only white rivers of THE Argent Loom threading slowly through the fold, and standing among them, an illusory figure of Warden Yrsa, plain garments, dark hair bound back, pale eyes, and no authority radiating off her even in projection.
Axon stood before her as his halos of white light turned slowly, shoulder to heel. Ohmran stood behind him, vast and clay-skinned and silent, the pale gray band catching the loomlight at his throat.
"Report."
"THE Ymnaros has completed its Dimensionlapse,"Axon said. "Another Dimension folded into it fully. We observed for a few hours after the fold settled."
"And?"
"Well, it has been taken over, Warden."Axon’s gaze stayed level. "The whole fused Dimension answers to a single figure. They call him the Blood-Crowned One."

"The dominant lifeforms of the largest domain are unique ones. The Superpowered Lifeforms..."Axon’s halos brightened faintly as he came to it. "They hold no traditional authority. No Intent. No Source. No Infinity. Nothing our instruments read as authority at all. Their power appears to derive from their own physical existences as they exert weight and they endure weight and they do it with nothing under them but themselves."
"Really now? Okay."Yrsa turned back. "What about the figures around this Blood-Crowned One?"
"We listened to the most powerful of them speak among themselves, which is where the useful informstion was." Axon inclined his head.

"There is a dragon. White beneath, crimson within, red gold wings. They call her Hvitrmarr. There is a being with a blindfold of crimson gold hands over a single great eye, Damodred. There is a scholar who emanates absolutely nothing and around whom Intent visibly splits. There are others below them."
Axon’s voice sharpened with the pleasure of a clean finding.

"Every one of the key figures is surrounded by a unique authority. The same authority. It is not their own. It is The Blood-Crowned One’s, wrapped around them, seated in them, and it is unlike anything we have catalogued."
"Hmm."Yrsa’s projection folded its hands. "What else?"
"There is a being standing guard outside the Dimension entirely, in the crossing-dark, and he is not one of theirs by lineage."Axon’s halos slowed. "He should be... a Descendant."
BOOM!
Silence filled the pocket!
"...You are certain?"

"His existence is written as it gives off that same sensation. One unbroken line running backward out of him past the horizon of what I can read. There is no mistaking it, and there is more."Axon lifted his chin. "He has what looks to be... a Mount with him. A Steed."
Ohmran’s slow eyes shifted at that.

"I know many variations of Descendants," Axon continued. "Across the Dimensions we have visited. Lineages that hold thrones. Lineages that hold silence. But those known to travel with Mounts, with Steeds...Are they not the Cursed Descendants of THE Krazhor-Nul Dimension?"
"They... should be..."
Even Yrsa seemed surprised to confirm this!

"Then a Cursed Descendant of THE Krazhor-Nul is standing guard outside THE Ymnaros. And Warden, he is very much not looking cursed! There is no rot on him. Nothing failing anywhere in that existence. His Steed either! Both of them are whole!"
"And both of them emanate the aura of the Blood-Crowned One."
HUUM!

"We watched manifestations of that same figure hold the sky over the largest domain for a little while observing the Dimensionlapse," Axon said, "and then vanish some hours ago. Whatever moved them, moved them together. And this Descendant and his Steed carry that same crimson gold signature threaded through their existences."His halos turned.

"This should be the being THE Sealed One had trouble with. The Remnant Existential Treasure should be on him or near him, and everything the vessel told you about a young lifeform growing into power was true and also badly incomplete."
"Because a young lifeform growing into power does not have a Cursed Descendant standing in his doorway!"
Axon’s composure finally showed a crack, and what came through it was... appetite!
"What cured that Descendant? How? Under what authority? By whose permission? And if it was done without permission..."
He stopped there, because there was nowhere polite to take it.
Yrsa’s projection said nothing for a long moment.
Then she spoke, and her voice was exactly as calm as it had been when she broke a hand.
"This Dimension is now of the highest importance."
Axon straightened as her pale eyes moved between them.
"Descendants have been off limits. We had been waiting on instructions, and the instructions have not come."
"But Warden..."
"I am clearing it as of now."

"We move on THE Ymnaros. I will seek clearance, but I now have enough basis."Yrsa did not pause. "We will use the Inhibitors in one sweeping action: the Descendant first, and every important and most powerful figure in that Dimension simultaneously. The dragon, the blindfolded one, the scholar who emanates nothing, all of them, in the same breath. Nothing sequential. Sequential gives the mighty time."
"And the Superpowered Lifeforms?"

"A lifeform to study."Something almost like interest touched her voice. "We do not know whether our Inhibitors work on them. That question needs answering. Collar what you can reach among them and record everything."
"Understood."

"I will arrive myself. I will lead this incursion, and I will bring others."Her projection’s hands unfolded."I will handle the shackling of the Descendant personally. The rest of you move in one sweep on the others. And to ensure success..."
She said it grandly!
"I will requisition a Dimensional Inhibitor."
A Dimensional Inhibitor!
Axon’s halos flared bright before he could govern them, and even Ohmran’s slow head turned!

Because that was one of their foremost weapons! A device that made authority obsolete across a region of an entire Dimension, everything within it stripped and inert at once, no exceptions, no negotiation, no ladder that held! Barely less than a second of effect, and then nothing for a long while after!
But in that second, everything mighty inside the region was simply a body!
They had taken down Primeval Ones this way. They had taken down True Lifeforms, in a single second, in one sweep, before any of them understood the shape of what had happened to them!
The last of her flickered in the loomlight.
"Hold your positions and observe. Touch nothing."
"I will arrive soon,"Warden Yrsa said. "Then we will actually get started."
