Farther out, cage-caravans slid along the string-roads between mountains, boxes in trains a thousand long, bound for reaches he could not see the end of.
In the middle distance, silent crews of Shrouds were hollowing out an entire mountain, carving its radiant stone into tier upon tier of empty archive.
Compared to what he had first assumed, an incursion force with a fortress behind it, this was something else entirely.
This was a complex organization!
Ultimately, they came to one of the larger mountains, and Yrsa guided the cloud down toward a single purple tower on its upper slopes.
The tower was tall, windowless, and smooth, and they passed through its gates on foot, his chains ringing softly in the quiet.
The halls inside were filled with Loomwrought Shrouds.
They lined the corridors in stationary rows, filling alcoves and junctions, and some of them had clearly stood in their places for centuries.
Not one turned its head as a leashed emperor walked past.
At a wide junction, another figure came out of a side hall.
An Enforcer, judging by the layered robes and the purple gold sash, broad and scarred, with a ledger of light folded under one arm.
He stopped when he caught sight of them, and looked Noah up and down with open appraisal.
"Warden Yrsa." A nod."I heard you bagged a unique one?"
"Mind your own business, Enforcer Halvard."said Warden Yrsa, and kept walking.
The Enforcer laughed once behind them before his expression became cold as he moved on.
Noah noted the exchange without comment.
The corridor ended at massive purple gold doors, and they ground open before Yrsa’s raised hand.
What lay past them was, of all things, a mess.
The great hall beyond was cluttered from wall to wall.
Loomwrought Shrouds filled it, though not in ordered ranks.

Some stood active, drifting between tables on silent errands, while others slumped against the walls and across benches as if they simply were not operational, white-wrapped bodies folded over in the manner of set-down tools.

Hundreds of collars and leashes lay strewn about in heaps and coils, gray bands and golden bands, whole and half-made and taken apart, spread across tables and hanging from racks and pooling on the floor between instruments Noah had no names for.
Yrsa entered with shining eyes, looking straight ahead, and Noah understood why quickly enough.
At the center of the clutter sat an area where even he was forced to focus, because a boundless immensity rested there without bothering to announce itself!
A figure stood at a long table with his back to them.
He was tall and lean.

Pale gold hair fell straight and unbound down his back, and every thread on him was royal: a long coat of deep black, high-collared, worked with fine gold embroidery down its seams, over a white shirt whose laced collar rose elegant at his throat, a dark half-cloak hanging from one shoulder.
Upon his brow, half-veiled by the pale hair, sat a small mark of pure obsidian.Amid all the mess of his own making, he alone was immaculate!
This was Descendant Mahishasura!

chapters.title: Chapter 5619: THE ETERNAL PAX! III
paragraphs: And at this moment, curiously enough, he was tweaking with an opened Loomwrought Shroud. The artificial lifeform lay spread on his table with its white wrappings parted and its inner weavings exposed, threads of refined Loom glowing softly around a dim core, and his long fingers worked inside it with total delicacy. When Yrsa and Noah arrived, he set his instruments down, turned around, and wiped his hands on a cloth.
Then he looked at Noah with shining eyes!
Noah looked back, and his own eyes flashed.
|Descendant Mahishasura|:: VERITAS: ??? PROVENANCE: ??? POTENTIA: ??? PONDUS: ??? A Descendant of ???. His purpose here is ???. ???

Rows of veiled unknowns, where nearly every other being had opened to him. Apart from the name, and the fact of what he was, very little was visible at all. Compared even to Yrsa, whose panel had at least given him her numbers, this being was a closed book with a title on its spine!

His existence began to silently work to unmask more details of this being as just because they were question marks now did not mean they would be question marks in a few minutes as his Foundations and Appendages went to work!
"A Lifeform that cured one of my Cursed Brethren."The voice came out soft, each word set down with care. "You have outdone yourself, to bring such a creature to my door, Yrsa."
The amber gold eyes did not leave Noah.

"In the weavings of the Descendants, a little rumor had risen, here and there. Something unique occurring among our Brethren on the far side of existence. I confess I dismissed it as the weavings of our people embellish themselves, as they do."A faint smilearose.
"I never expected to have the one responsible standing in my workshop."
He looked Noah up and down slowly, and Yrsa nodded.
"I wanted affirmation on what to do with him, since he is so unique. He was even involved with THE Sealed One. There are multiple unique threads of existence around him, and I..."
As she spoke, she smacked Noah forward a step.
Descendant Mahishasura frowned.
"None of that."The soft voice went stern, and the sternness filled the cluttered hall. "Treat him with a level of respect, my dear Yrsa."

The admonishment visibly surprised her. Warden Yrsa, who had broken a finger and burst a steed’s skull with the same expression, blinked once, nodded, and stepped back. Noah looked at her coldly from behind his chains, and in his mind, nothing about her standing had improved.Her death had been decided long ago. The only open question was the order of it!
He turned the same cold gaze on the Descendant, tyranny sitting open in his crimson gold eyes, and when this fucker saw that gaze, he actually smiled, and walked closer through his own clutter.
"I know, I know." He spread his elegant hands."It looks like we are the bad guys here, putting lifeforms in cages. I see how all of this looks. Truly, I do."
He stopped a few paces away, entirely at ease before a leashed emperor.

"But nothing good comes easy. Many kings only ever achieved peace by killing millions first. You yourself, across your own life, have likely killed a great many to arrive at your peace... before we interrupted it. Yes?"
He did not wait for an answer.
"We are only containing lifeforms, at present. We had the option of genocide on the table, and we looked at it, and we said no. We are better than all the others. Let us simply collect them all."
He turned, pacing slowly along his tables, one hand trailing across a heap of half-made collars.

"Two Ages ago, there was a Primeval One that grazed the borderlands of THE Infinite Carcosa. Old past records, and patient past measure. Every third of an Age, it would drink a Dimension. Every civilization inside, every Observable Existence, every small bright thing that had spent years becoming itself, swallowed in an afternoon, because a being with an appetite past all measure and the accountability of nothing happened to be hungry."
He glanced back at Noah.

"It sits in a cage now, four columns east of this mountain. It has drunk nothing for a long while. Run the count yourself, Cure-Giver. How many countless decillions are alive at this moment, in Dimensions that still exist, because one appetite was subtracted? Weigh every despondent face you saw on the way here against that number, and tell me honestly which way the scale falls."
Noah said nothing, and the Descendant seemed to enjoy the nothing, and continued.

"Or take a fresher example. THE Sealed One."The amber eyes glinted. "We know him well. We hold multiple of his vessels in inhibition at this very moment. Bodies he spent Ages hollowing and seeding across existence, each one a plot with a pulse, each one meant to burn something down on a schedule only he can read. Every vessel we chained is a Dimension that does not burn. A court that is not hollowed. A war that never finds its excuse. He has noticed the silences, I am sure, and it unsettles him, and I consider that unsettlement a public service."
A soft laugh echoed, and then the warmth deepened!

"The mighty of existence produce catastrophe the way harvests produce grain. Reliably. Seasonally. At scale. And existence has never once had a structure whose task it was to stop them. Not the Scales, which only rank them. Not the frameworks, which only feed them. Us. We are the first accountable thing existence has ever built, and our early reports from the resettlement Observable Existences say the first generations born there, with no authority anywhere among them, are the most peaceful populations in any record we hold."

He set a golden band down on the table. "Cages are ugly. I know. But they are the ugliness of a hospital, not the ugliness of a slaughterhouse, and everyone in existence has been living in the slaughterhouse so long they have forgotten there was ever another building."
HUUM!
Mahishasura came to a stop before him again, and folded his hands behind his back, and his composed face held something genuinely curious.

"Well. That is one thing. The other is how to put you to use."A slight pause. "You see, I keep watch over some Cursed Descendants here. Brethren who earned the ire of Those Who Remain, and well... became Cursed for it. I have made promises to each of them, and now the being who can keep those promises has walked leashed into my workshop."
The soft voice did not change at all as he said it. "Each of them will have their chance with you. And if you play ball... if you play along... even your freedom is not out of the question."
The amber gold eyes shone.
"I am not trying to be some ridiculously evil guy here. I am very reasonable. Existence is give and take, and you currently find yourself in a predicament, and depending on how much you give..."
A slight, elegant bow of his head.
"...there may be a lot to take, Cure-Giver."

chapters.title: Chapter 5620: A Dance Beneath Budding Skies!
paragraphs: Inside THE Infiniverse, a body of Noah floated quietly beneath the endless blue, looking up at the skies with a heavy gaze.

Of course, the heaviness had little to do with anything above him. It had to do with what was unfolding countless gigaparsecs away, before a main body that the members of THE ETERNAL PAX believed to be leashed, chained, and safely inhibited. An organization with grand workings and origins!
THE ETERNAL PAX.
As he turned the name over yet again, a figure came over the grass toward him.

One moment the stellar fields held only wind, and the next she was beside him, red hair loose over the white and blue of her robe, composed and unhurried, carrying her immensity so lightly that the grass barely bent beneath her feet. Since her wounds had closed, something in her bearing had settled as well, and what remained was simply grace with patience wrapped around it.
"For you to have your cute serious face on,"she said, "you must have made a lot of progress in obtaining information."
Noah gave a light nod.

"THE ETERNAL PAX." He watched the skies as he said it. "So in addition to the threat of THE Sealed One, there is also an organization intent on enslaving all those who utilize authority, wherever they deem the holder unworthy of it. And both sides are likely backed by Those Who Remain."
He glanced at her."I have only now come across a single Descendant of Those Who Remain belonging to THE ETERNAL PAX. But can I assume there are many, many Descendants making up that organization?"
He looked at the exquisite lifeform before him and waited.

After all, she could not tell him too many things explicitly, since every revelation about what was to come cost her a piece of what she was. But he had learned the shape of their arrangement by now. He reasoned aloud, and came to his own conclusions, and she could simply do something small.
Thalia nodded lightly, with a smile.
And Noah thought about it for a moment.

Existence was vast and full of terrors, and enemies and adversity were not at all scarce. If anything, the count of them only grew the higher he climbed. So the path forward was not complicated, however long it was!

He needed to continue becoming unfathomably powerful at an increasingly faster pace. He needed to keep forcing the very weight of all existence onto his quarks, filling them with his Provenance and his Teloi, becoming a grander version of himself particle by particle, all while continuing to spread his rulership across everything his hands could reach.
That was the most straightforward way of raising his attributes and his Provenance alike. And when he held enough power, everything else would fall into place. It always had!
As he was thinking about all of this, Thalia had come around in front of him.
Her hand was outstretched, palm up, as if she was asking him for something.

Behind her, on the distant cliff above the radiant river, his mother sat with Seo-yeon, and neither of them was watching the water. They were watching the skies. Because above all of them, something utterly exceptional was occurring.
"Focus on the present," Thalia said softly. "Focus on the now. Look up to the skies."
HUUM!
The skies of THE Infiniverse were blooming.

Dozens of Observable Existences were being born above them. Wherever his people unfurled the Genesis Tesseracts under his guidance, blue-white geometry unfolded and opened, and out of each unfolding a newborn vastness bloomed into being, foundations declaring themselves, nine Prime Causes seating true around the honesty of each founder.
One moment a stretch of sky held only endless blue, and the next it held a young existence turning its first light, radiant and enormous and new!

And after every passing second, another one bloomed. Another, and another, births stacking upon births until the heavens of his home were a garden coming up all at once, hundreds of beginnings unfurling in silence above a farmland, a river, and a fishing cliff.
Compared to any wonder Noah had witnessed across his climb, and he had witnessed many, this was the one that made his eyes shine brightest!
Yes. Even for him, this was surreal. He had stemmed from a single Observable Existence. Even further down, he had stemmed from a single, tiny world.
One world of green and blue among an uncountable many. And now the seeds of Observable Existences were things he conjured and handed to his people, hundreds at a time.
For a human, he had truly come far!

"Regardless of what is happening around you,"Thalia said, her hand still open between them, "you need to be the only one who decides how your emotions are flowing. Whether to be happy, or angry, or calm, or just neutral. Not your enemies. Not your circumstances. Not an organization that believes it holds your leash, and not a future that frightened even me. We can fail. Even I failed after coming back here and seeing you again. But..."
Her voice stayed level, and warm underneath."A man controls his emotions. My Man controls his emotions. My Provenance... controls his emotions."

The faintest curve touched her lips."So, to anchor you down. Do not leave me hanging too much, and take my hand. Dance with me, while above you, something as grand as Observable Existences constantly budding sits in the sky because of your hands."
Dance? At such a time?
Noah looked at this utterly graceful and exquisite lifeform, her open palm, her patient eyes, the whole composed immensity of her waiting on his answer. And perhaps that was precisely her point!
If a man could dance at such a time, then no time would ever own him!
He took her hands.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Existence itself began to play a symphony.
The sound rose out of the surroundings with no source at all, a symphony, a melody, deep notes rolling through the grass and the river and the light, and Thalia led him into it.

She drew his hands into place and brought her body close to his, close enough that he could feel her vibrant breath filled with immensity against him, and her feet began to move across the stellar grass, unhurried and certain, and his moved with hers.
They danced.

Below skies budding with Observable Existences, two figures turned slowly through the stellar grass, red hair and crimson gold, while above them beginnings bloomed by the hundreds, and on a distant cliff a mother watched her son dance with a woman from a drowning future, and said nothing at all, and smiled.
And all the while, Noah’s body continued the art.

THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis did not pause for the music.In truth, it settled deeper into him because of it. The weight of existence came down as it always came, THE Primordial Source and Infinity and THE Argent Loom and Time and everything imperceivable, and he ushered it seamlessly through the anatomy of his eleven singularities and onto a single quark, and then the next, and the next, bearing and seating and stabilizing in rhythm now, the whole crushing procession moving through his frame without a single thread of pressure escaping outward!
The grass beneath their turning feet did not bend. The river did not tremble. A mountain of everything was landing on him, particle by particle, and from the outside there was only a man dancing.

Was it her doing? Partly, perhaps. With a Provenance Lifeform in his arms, he could feel that her movements were doing something, some quality in the way she turned him and steadied him that his senses could not fully name, and she offered no explanation of it, and he did not ask for one yet.

But between her reminder on emotions, and the art running seamless through him, his Inner Peace, and the power of THE Infiniverse rising by the second as hundreds of newborn existences fed her vastness, something within Noah began to gather!
The music played. The skies bloomed. Her hand rested in his.
And Noah’s eyes changed.

The crimson gold of them drained away, and the singularity pupils faded, and what remained was blue. Endless blue, with no pupils at all, deep and grand and ancient and early all at once, the eyes of something that had been present before frameworks learned their names. He danced on without missing a step, and within him, everything accelerated!

The Baryogenesis surged. Where the weight had moved quark to quark in steady rhythm, it now moved three times faster, four times faster, the bearing and the seating and the stabilizing flowing together into a single continuous motion. And more than the pace, the depth changed. Improvements arrived in him unbidden, one after another, small profundities blooming fully formed: a truer angle for the weight to land, a cleaner braid of Provenance and Telos in the seating, a temper in the remaking that left each Provenance Telos Quark immensely more powerful than the hundred thousand that had come before!
He was not merely converting anymore. He was refining the art while performing it, and the art was refining him back!
|You have entered a Unique State of Existence: THE PROVENANCE REVERIE.|

|A state spoken of among the first Provenance Lifeforms, and attained by the exceptional among them. It exceeds Inner Peace. Where Inner Peace is the absence of argument within an existence, THE PROVENANCE REVERIE is agreement so complete that the existence and its surroundings begin to move as one. Existence itself becomes part of your limbs.|

|Within the Reverie: all processes of your existence are accelerated. Cultivation, generation, comprehension, and refinement flow together rather than in sequence.Profundities and epiphanies arise constantly and unbidden, each one an improvement to what you are and what you practice. Your arts may be advanced in the act of using them. Your perception deepens, and what you perceive, you may briefly wield as though it were your own body.|
|The entry was threefold: a heart that alone decides its weather, an art in seamless motion, and the hand of another Provenance in yours.|

|Cost: the Reverie drains the light of your Provenance Essence and of your existence itself to remain active.To hold it for long is to spend what cannot be easily replaced, and among the first of your kind, the Reverie was a thing of moments, entered rarely and exited poor.|

|However. Your existence holds Infinite Sanguine Mana atop your limited Provenance Essence. No record exists of a Provenance Lifeform sustaining this state upon an infinite reserve. The duration available to you is ???.|
Glorious prompts, arriving one after another while the music played!

Noah held Thalia tighter in his arms, and they turned together across the stellar grass as wonder bloomed within him and around him in equal measure, quarks igniting by the thousands in his depths, beginnings igniting by the hundreds above!

And through all of it, the symphony went on, old past any counting, filling the surroundings from nowhere and everywhere at once, as if existence itself had drawn near to bear witness to the emergence of something utterly immense!

Dance with me, while above you, something as grand as Observable Existences constantly budding sits in the sky because of your hands."
Dance?
At such a time?
Noah looked at this utterly graceful and exquisite lifeform, her open palm, her patient eyes, the whole composed immensity of her waiting on his answer.
And perhaps that was precisely her point!
If a man could dance at such a time, then no time would ever own him!
He took her hands.
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!
Existence itself began to play a symphony.
The sound rose out of the surroundings with no source at all, a symphony, a melody, deep notes rolling through the grass and the river and the light, and Thalia led him into it.

She drew his hands into place and brought her body close to his, close enough that he could feel her vibrant breath filled with immensity against him, and her feet began to move across the stellar grass, unhurried and certain, and his moved with hers.
They danced.

Below skies budding with Observable Existences, two figures turned slowly through the stellar grass, red hair and crimson gold, while above them beginnings bloomed by the hundreds, and on a distant cliff a mother watched her son dance with a woman from a drowning future, and said nothing at all, and smiled.
And all the while, Noah’s body continued the art.
THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis did not pause for the music.In truth, it settled deeper into him because of it.

The weight of existence came down as it always came, THE Primordial Source and Infinity and THE Argent Loom and Time and everything imperceivable, and he ushered it seamlessly through the anatomy of his eleven singularities and onto a single quark, and then the next, and the next, bearing and seating and stabilizing in rhythm now, the whole crushing procession moving through his frame without a single thread of pressure escaping outward!
The grass beneath their turning feet did not bend.
The river did not tremble.
A mountain of everything was landing on him, particle by particle, and from the outside there was only a man dancing.
Was it her doing?
Partly, perhaps.

With a Provenance Lifeform in his arms, he could feel that her movements were doing something, some quality in the way she turned him and steadied him that his senses could not fully name, and she offered no explanation of it, and he did not ask for one yet.

But between her reminder on emotions, and the art running seamless through him, his Inner Peace, and the power of THE Infiniverse rising by the second as hundreds of newborn existences fed her vastness, something within Noah began to gather!
The music played.
The skies bloomed.
Her hand rested in his.
And Noah’s eyes changed.
The crimson gold of them drained away, and the singularity pupils faded, and what remained was blue.
Endless blue, with no pupils at all, deep and grand and ancient and early all at once, the eyes of something that had been present before frameworks learned their names.
He danced on without missing a step, and within him, everything accelerated!
The Baryogenesis surged.

Where the weight had moved quark to quark in steady rhythm, it now moved three times faster, four times faster, the bearing and the seating and the stabilizing flowing together into a single continuous motion.
And more than the pace, the depth changed.

Improvements arrived in him unbidden, one after another, small profundities blooming fully formed: a truer angle for the weight to land, a cleaner braid of Provenance and Telos in the seating, a temper in the remaking that left each Provenance Telos Quark immensely more powerful than the hundred thousand that had come before!
He was not merely converting anymore.
He was refining the art while performing it, and the art was refining him back!
|You have entered a Unique State of Existence: THE PROVENANCE REVERIE.|
|A state spoken of among the first Provenance Lifeforms, and attained by the exceptional among them.
It exceeds Inner Peace.
Where Inner Peace is the absence of argument within an existence, THE PROVENANCE REVERIE is agreement so complete that the existence and its surroundings begin to move as one.
Existence itself becomes part of your limbs.|
|Within the Reverie: all processes of your existence are accelerated.

Cultivation, generation, comprehension, and refinement flow together rather than in sequence.Profundities and epiphanies arise constantly and unbidden, each one an improvement to what you are and what you practice.
Your arts may be advanced in the act of using them.
Your perception deepens, and what you perceive, you may briefly wield as though it were your own body.|
|The entry was threefold: a heart that alone decides its weather, an art in seamless motion, and the hand of another Provenance in yours.|

|Cost: the Reverie drains the light of your Provenance Essence and of your existence itself to remain active.To hold it for long is to spend what cannot be easily replaced, and among the first of your kind, the Reverie was a thing of moments, entered rarely and exited poor.|
|However.
Your existence holds Infinite Sanguine Mana atop your limited Provenance Essence.
No record exists of a Provenance Lifeform sustaining this state upon an infinite reserve.
The duration available to you is ???.|
Glorious prompts, arriving one after another while the music played!

Noah held Thalia tighter in his arms, and they turned together across the stellar grass as wonder bloomed within him and around him in equal measure, quarks igniting by the thousands in his depths, beginnings igniting by the hundreds above!

And through all of it, the symphony went on, old past any counting, filling the surroundings from nowhere and everywhere at once, as if existence itself had drawn near to bear witness to the emergence of something utterly immense!

chapters.title: Chapter 5621: Dimensionality! I
paragraphs: The dance continued and simply grew quieter!

Somewhere between one turn and the next, the symphony had settled into a slow old melody, and Thalia’s steps had eased to match it, and the two of them moved across the stellar grass in small unhurried circles beneath a sky still budding with beginnings.
Since the Reverie asked for an art in seamless motion, the dance itself had become part of the cultivation.
Within Noah, the epiphanies had begun to arrive in streams!

Of course, they did not arrive as answers. They arrived as better questions, one unfolding out of another, each profundity opening a door that three more waited behind. And as the weight of existence came down onto quark after quark, as his attributes rose in slow increments with every hundred thousand particles remade, his thoughts kept returning to a single word that had been circling his climb recently.
Dimensionality.
|1,000,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted.The quality of quarks remade within THE PROVENANCE REVERIE exceeds all prior conversions.|
|Your attributes have risen. VERITAS: 17. PROVENANCE: 13. POTENTIA: INFINITE. PONDUS: 18.|
What was Dimensionality, truly?

He had been collecting pieces of it for a long while without assembling them. The Argent Loom could only be perceived and used by those of high Dimensionality, and the fused authority of Infinity and THE Primordial Source was chased precisely because the fusion elevated it.
Climb far enough and others stop perceiving you!

Then there was his own Solipsism, which rendered him imperceivable to any being whose VERITAS and PONDUS both sat below ten. And there was the quiet fact he had noticed in the cages of THE Serenaros, where a Primeval One’s panel read in the low tens while a True Gilded Lifeform read below one, though both were called mighty by everyone beneath them.
So the pieces were there. Within the Reverie, they finally moved toward each other.
Perhaps Dimensionality was not a measure of power at all. Perhaps it was a measure of depth.How much of existence a being actually occupied, and how much of existence could actually reach them.
Power asked how hard a thing could push. Dimensionality asked where a thing truly stood, and the two questions only looked similar from far away.

Compared against everything he had witnessed, the model held! When his attributes had passed ten, an entire layer of existence had opened to his senses, the Argent Loom’s white rivers appearing where nothing had been, and beings who once read as blanks unfolding into panels.
Others below that wall could not perceive him at all. It was not that they were weak. It was that he stood somewhere their existence did not extend to!
A fish did not fail to see the mountain because the mountain hid. The fish’s whole reach simply ended at the water.
Thus, the attribute walls were not merely thresholds of strength. Every ten, existence itself seemed to admit a being one tier deeper.
And uniqueness bent all of it.

Two beings could stand on the same tier of Dimensionality, and if one of them was unique enough, if the gap in the quality of their depth ran wide enough, the unique one could still slip beneath the other’s perception entirely. His Solipsism was precisely that: not a trick of hiding, but a Precept written from a truth so singular that ordinary depth could not hold onto it. Yrsa perceived him because her panel cleared the double wall. But would she still perceive him if his uniqueness widened further? How wide did such a gap have to grow?
And was that the real reason his sight slid off Mahishasura’s panel, rows of veiled unknowns where every other being had opened? Not concealment, but depth beyond his reach?
He did not know. Yet!
So, since he was a being who sought to understand everything, Noah began to build a ranking.
He kept the backbone of it plain, and he measured it against the only proxy his sight could count: attributes.

But the more the pieces settled, the clearer it became that the walls did not fall every ten. There were only two shores he could actually verify, and one more he could only guess at across the water.
Below ten attributes was one kind of existence entirely.

He had lived in it. Nearly everything alive still did. Mortals, Monarchs, most True Lifeforms, entire civilizations of the mighty, all of them held within the same vast layer, able to perceive one another, able to reach one another, and entirely blind to what ran above them.

And what defined that layer, when he truly weighed it, was that everything within it could be counted. Their power had edges. Their reach had ends. Their reserves ran dry, their senses stopped at walls, their lives closed on schedules, and the frameworks that fed them measured out authority in finite portions to finite holders!
A whole layer of existence, magnificent and teeming, and every single thing in it was a finished sum.
He would call it THE FINITE VERSE.
Above ten attributes, existence changed its agreement with a being.
He remembered the crossing in his own body. The white rivers appearing where nothing had been!

Beings below the wall losing the ability to perceive him at all. It was not strength that had changed first. It was standing. Existence had admitted him past the edges of the countable, into a layer where the old sums stopped closing. Beings here reached across distances that had no business being crossed!
They held reserves that replenished from sources the Finite could never see, wielded authorities that compounded rather than depleted, perceived rivers and layers that ran through everything.

They had gone beyond the finite without yet becoming boundless, deeper than any count and still, somewhere far above, countable by something. His own footing. Skallagrim’s twenties. Yrsa’s twenty-eight. Primevals at their height, and what he had seen of THE ETERNAL PAX so far, all of them sharing this same deeper water.
He would call it...THE TRANSFINITE VERSE.
HUUM!
And above that?

Here his weavings ran out of verified entries, and hypothesis had to carry the rest. Was there a third wall at thirty? He doubted it, since Yrsa’s panel sat within the twenties and she read to his senses as the same kind of being he was, only deeper. At forty, then? Perhaps. But when he weighed everything he had seen, the veiled rows of Mahishasura’s panel, the auras seated on the inner mountains, the beings existence itself was supposed to agree with, his reckoning kept settling on a higher number.Fifty?

A wall at fifty attributes or above, past which his every instrument of understanding simply failed. Not a deeper water. The end of water as a description. A standing that could not be measured, compared, or even properly spoken of in the language of counts at all, where his sight returned rows of veiled unknowns not because something was hidden, but because nothing in him yet existed that could hold the answer.
He would call that hypothesized shore THE INEFFABLE VERSE!

chapters.title: Chapter 5622: Dimensionality! II
paragraphs: And as he finished outlining the framework within himself, the Reverie took his taxonomy and set it into record, prompts unfolding one after another in plain confirmation.
|Your framework of Dimensionality has been recorded.|

|THE FIRST DIMENSIONALITY: THE FINITE VERSE. Attributes above zero through ten. The layer in which nearly all of existence resides, and the only layer most of it will ever know. Every being here is a closed sum: finite power, finite reach, finite perception, finite time. They perceive only their own layer. THE Argent Loom, and all beings standing deeper, are entirely beyond their senses, and what they cannot perceive, they cannot touch, resist, or flee.|

|Empires rise here, frameworks crown their chosen here, and entire histories of the mighty play out here, all within a vessel whose walls the Finite will never see. To the layers above, the grandest wars of THE FINITE VERSE are...ants fighting.|

|THE SECOND DIMENSIONALITY: THE TRANSFINITE VERSE.Attributes of ten and above. Existence admits these beings past the countable. The Argent Loom becomes visible. The Finite become unable to perceive them unless perception is granted. Reserves, reach, and authority here exceed every closed sum of the layer below, yet remain ordered, comparable, and climbable: within this Verse, depth continues to matter, and a wide enough gap in attributes or in uniqueness may still place one Transfinite being beyond another’s senses, as your Solipsism already demonstrates.|

|Your current footing, the Wardens and Enforcers of THE ETERNAL PAX, and Primeval Ones at their height all reside within this Verse. It is deeper than any count of the Finite, and it is still not the deep end.|

|THE THIRD DIMENSIONALITY: THE INEFFABLE VERSE. Hypothesized. Estimated to begin at fifty attributes or above. Unverified by your senses. If it exists, it is the standing at which measurement itself fails: no panel opens, no comparison holds, no count closes, and no language of attributes properly applies. The Ineffable would be that which water, depth, and shore were always insufficient words for. To them, THE TRANSFINITE VERSE may appear as the Finite appears to you, and existence may not merely admit them, but defer. Candidates: the summit of THE ETERNAL PAX. THE Sealed One, should he attain what he seeks should be far past this Dimensionality. Those Who Remain may be far, far above this Dimensionality. ???|
|The framework is yours, and it will be refined as your perception deepens. Hypotheses are recorded as hypotheses.|

There was one more rung, and it sat below all the others, and it was the one that unsettled him. The inhibited of THE Serenaros, pressed to decimals, a True Gilded Lifeform reading below one. The Pax did not merely chain its captives. It pressed them beneath even THE FINITE VERSE, down into a shallowness that existence had never intended for anything, where everything could perceive them and they could reach nothing at all. Perhaps that was the true cage, and the metal boxes were only furniture.
|2,500,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted.|
|5,000,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted. The pace of THE Infinite Provenance Baryogenesis continues to rise within the Reverie.|
WAA!
The dance turned. The sky bloomed!

Thalia’s hand rested in his, and her eyes were closed now, and if she could feel the storm of reckoning moving through the man she was dancing with, she gave no sign beyond the smallest curve at the corner of her mouth.
And the epiphanies moved on, from what Dimensionality was to what rulership was, because in truth the two had been the same question wearing different clothes.
Rulership over a large portion of existence, and tremendously high Dimensionality...seemed like something that went hand in hand.
But how did one actually spread rulership across something as vast as existence? For Existence was vast!

The obvious road was the one he had been walking: take Dimensions, take Observable Existences, seat authority over territory and let the territory answer to him. It worked. It was also slow, and loud, and it painted a target on every border he drew.
THE ETERNAL PAX had partly noticed him because he ruled a Dimension...alongside the fuckery of THE Sealed One. Territory was rulership that announced itself.
HUUM!
Another epiphany arrived, fully formed in the manner the Reverie delivered its best ones!
He did not need to rule Dimensions. He did not even need to rule Observable Existences.
He needed to rule lifeforms!
Humans. Beings. The living, wherever they stood, whatever framework fed them. Territory was only ever a container for them!
And the moment he thought it, another memory surfaced to meet it
THE Infinity Eater.

A Descendant of Those Who Remain that did not rule an inch of territory, so far as any record showed. And yet it was the source of Infinity itself for entire populations of Infinite Lifeforms, beings who drew their seas from threads the Eater lent, and most of them did not even know. They believed their Infinity was their own. They built lives and Pantheons and empires on a borrowed wellspring, and somewhere far away, a single being held the other end of every thread.

Was that not rulership of the deepest kind? No borders. No banners. No target painted anywhere, because the ruled did not know they were subjects. The Eater did not govern where its dependents stood. It governed what they were made of!
Could he not extend his rulership the same way?
The question opened, and the Reverie poured into it, and the pieces of his own existence began raising their hands one by one.

His Infinite Sanguine Mana. An inexhaustible ocean, generated from within, unperceivable to beings beneath his depth, already proven to pass through loomlight itself untouched. What was Infinity, to an Infinite Lifeform?

A reserve that answered when called. If threads of his mana could be spun fine enough, thinned past all perception, and set where Infinite Lifeforms drew their power, would their calls not be answered just the same? They would pull, and something would answer, and the something would be him!
He could become a source of Infinity, the wellspring beneath other beings’ seas.

And his Provenance Essence. Rarer, dearer, limited where the mana was not, but of a purity that predated frameworks entirely. THE Primordial Source was the other great root that Source Lifeforms drank from, dense foundational being itself.

Could refined essence, or the light it shed, stand in that place? Could he become a source of THE Primordial Source and Infinity, so that Infinite Lifeforms, Gilded Ones burning their Egos bright and Source Lifeforms deepening their patient cores were, at the very bottom of their draw, drawing on him?
Two wellsprings. One infinite, one precious. Between them, they touched nearly every variety of powered lifeform existence had produced!
Which left only the question of reach. How did one lay a wellspring beneath beings scattered across Dimensions and Observable Existences beyond counting?

For a moment he considered the Argent Loom, since the Loom already did something similar, invisible rivers threading all of existence, unperceived by everything beneath the Second Tier. But the thought discarded itself almost as quickly as it formed. The Loom was not his!

It was the Pax’s industry and, if Skallagrim’s theory held, an extension of the thoughts of Those Who Remain. Building his rulership on a borrowed road meant the road’s owner could close it, and he had rejected borrowed foundations once already, on obsidian sands, with an entire system watching.
No. The answer was already inside him, and it had been all along.

His Infinite Sanguine Mana was not perceivable by those beneath him. That was not a limitation. That was the entire mechanism. An infinite, self-generated, imperceivable substance, spun into threads finer than any sense that would ever check for them, spread outward across existence the way his blood already answered him across any distance, latching quietly onto the draw of every lifeform that reached for Infinity, for Source, for power it assumed was its own!
No conquest. No announcement. Every pull, answered. Every answer, a thread of rulership!
They would never even realize!
HUUM!

The dance turned once more beneath the budding sky, and Noah held that design in the endless blue of his pupilless eyes, complete and patient and enormous, and only one small question kept turning quietly at the edge of it.
The seat he intended to occupy already had an occupant. Somewhere across existence, THE Infinity Eater held the other end of countless threads.
And what did such a being do, he wondered, when it noticed a second hand on his rulership?
|10,000,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted.|
|Your attributes have risen. VERITAS: 19. PROVENANCE: 16. POTENTIA: INFINITE. PONDUS: 19.|

They built lives and Pantheons and empires on a borrowed wellspring, and somewhere far away, a single being held the other end of every thread.
Was that not rulership of the deepest kind?
No borders.
No banners.
No target painted anywhere, because the ruled did not know they were subjects.
The Eater did not govern where its dependents stood.
It governed what they were made of!
Could he not extend his rulership the same way?
The question opened, and the Reverie poured into it, and the pieces of his own existence began raising their hands one by one.
His Infinite Sanguine Mana.
An inexhaustible ocean, generated from within, unperceivable to beings beneath his depth, already proven to pass through loomlight itself untouched.
What was Infinity, to an Infinite Lifeform?
A reserve that answered when called.
If threads of his mana could be spun fine enough, thinned past all perception, and set where Infinite Lifeforms drew their power, would their calls not be answered just the same?
They would pull, and something would answer, and the something would be him!
He could become a source of Infinity, the wellspring beneath other beings’ seas.
And his Provenance Essence.
Rarer, dearer, limited where the mana was not, but of a purity that predated frameworks entirely.
THE Primordial Source was the other great root that Source Lifeforms drank from, dense foundational being itself.
Could refined essence, or the light it shed, stand in that place?

Could he become a source of THE Primordial Source and Infinity, so that Infinite Lifeforms, Gilded Ones burning their Egos bright and Source Lifeforms deepening their patient cores were, at the very bottom of their draw, drawing on him?
Two wellsprings.
One infinite, one precious.
Between them, they touched nearly every variety of powered lifeform existence had produced!
Which left only the question of reach.
How did one lay a wellspring beneath beings scattered across Dimensions and Observable Existences beyond counting?
For a moment he considered the Argent Loom, since the Loom already did something similar, invisible rivers threading all of existence, unperceived by everything beneath the Second Tier.
But the thought discarded itself almost as quickly as it formed.
The Loom was not his!
It was the Pax’s industry and, if Skallagrim’s theory held, an extension of the thoughts of Those Who Remain.
Building his rulership on a borrowed road meant the road’s owner could close it, and he had rejected borrowed foundations once already, on obsidian sands, with an entire system watching.
No.
The answer was already inside him, and it had been all along.
His Infinite Sanguine Mana was not perceivable by those beneath him.
That was not a limitation.
That was the entire mechanism.

An infinite, self-generated, imperceivable substance, spun into threads finer than any sense that would ever check for them, spread outward across existence the way his blood already answered him across any distance, latching quietly onto the draw of every lifeform that reached for Infinity, for Source, for power it assumed was its own!
No conquest.
No announcement.
Every pull, answered.
Every answer, a thread of rulership!
They would never even realize!
HUUM!

The dance turned once more beneath the budding sky, and Noah held that design in the endless blue of his pupilless eyes, complete and patient and enormous, and only one small question kept turning quietly at the edge of it.
The seat he intended to occupy already had an occupant.
Somewhere across existence, THE Infinity Eater held the other end of countless threads.
And what did such a being do, he wondered, when it noticed a second hand on his rulership?
|10,000,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted.|
|Your attributes have risen.
VERITAS: 19.
PROVENANCE: 16.
POTENTIA: INFINITE.
PONDUS: 19.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5623: Glory! Quintessence!
paragraphs: His immensity rose rapidly as the Reverie went on, and within it, Noah had arrived at the edge of a decision!

The design was complete in him. Threads of Infinite Sanguine Mana, spun finer than any sense that would check for them, laid beneath the draw of lifeforms who believed their power was their own. All that remained was the first test, and the test had an obvious ground.

THE Ymnaros, fused and healing, where the folding of THE Vaelos had delivered millions of Infinite Lifeforms into his territory, weak and strong alike, every one of them pulling on seas they had never once questioned. He gathered the first threads at the edge of his existence, and prepared to let them go.
And THE Infiniverse shook at such a time.
HUUM!

It was not an attack, and he knew that within the first fraction of the tremor, because the shaking carried no wrongness in it at all. It carried the opposite. It moved through the grass and the river and the blooming skies in slow, enormous waves, and it felt, more than anything else, the manner in which a held breath feels when it is finally released!
Thalia’s hand tightened once in his. On the distant cliff, his mother had risen to her feet.
Prompts began to unfold, and they did not stop!
|More than 1,000 Observable Existences have now emerged within THE Infiniverse.|

|One thousand First Causes and foundations. Nine thousand seated Prime Causes and above, each declared true around its own founder, all of them rooted within a single containing existence. No record holds a precedent for this structure. The Causes do not merely reside within THE Infiniverse. They back her. A Dimension ordinarily stands upon its own foundation alone. THE Infiniverse now stands upon thousands.|
|Her Dimensionality has risen past all prior measure, and continues to rise.|
|A Unique Precept has arisen for THE Infiniverse: THE PRECEPT OF THE UNFOUND HEARTH.|

|Its truth: a home is not a place. A home is an arrival. What seeks THE Infiniverse as a place will never find her, for she has ceased to be findable in the manner of places. She may now traverse: gathering the whole of herself, every Realm, every nested Observable Existence, every life she holds, and crossing to elsewhere within reach of nearby Dimensions in a single unperceivable motion.These crossings are designated HEARTHSHIFTS.A Hearthshift emits nothing, disturbs nothing, and may not be perceived, predicted, or followed by any being of insufficient depth. Those within her will know they have moved only if she tells them.|
|THE Infiniverse is transforming. Designation: a UNIQUE TRANSFINITE DIMENSION.|

|She has crossed the wall your framework names. Her reserves no longer close. Her reach no longer ends. She is the first Dimension in your records to carry an Intent, a Precept, and a thousand rooted foundations at once, and existence has admitted her into deeper standing accordingly. The Finite may dwell within her without ever perceiving what holds them. The Transfinite may stand within her and still not find her edges.|
|And from the joining of her new depth with your Infinite Sanguine Mana, something is rising through her that belongs to no framework and no record.|
|Rivers of authority, unique to THE Infiniverse, are forming. Designation: THE CRIMSON WEFT.|

|THE CRIMSON WEFT runs through the whole of her: through every Realm, every nested Observable Existence, every life she carries. It is unperceivable to all beings and all instruments, at any depth, with a single exception: you. Its current is your Infinite Sanguine Mana. Its nature is binding: where the Weft touches an Observable Existence or a Dimension, within her or beyond her, it may latch, quietly and completely, and what it binds becomes reachable, anchorable, and holdable. A bound point may serve as an anchor for a Hearthshift. A bound existence may be fed, protected, or drawn upon through the Weft without ever perceiving the thread. Where THE Argent Loom is a road built by others and watched by others, THE CRIMSON WEFT is grown, and it is yours, and no eye in existence has been built that can see it.|
|The Weft deepens with every Observable Existence that takes root within her. It has only begun.|
The prompts settled, and the changes began!

Across THE Infiniverse, the countless Realms answered her transformation one after another. Skies deepened in color, richer than any eye within them remembered. Rivers of light ran fuller. The thousand young Observable Existences turned brighter in their cradles, and between all of it, visible to exactly one being in all of existence, thin crimson rivers rose and began to thread themselves through everything, through farmland and citadel and sanctuary, through the roots of newborn foundations, unhurried and silent and everywhere at once.
Noah watched the Weft weave itself through his home, and on the far cliff, Seo-yeon laughed at something she could not see but could somehow feel, and the sound of it carried across the water.

Was this what the Pax had, when they looked upon their Argent Loom? He doubted it. The Argent Loom was inherited, and argued over, and possibly the extension of someone else’s thoughts. This had grown out of a mother and a bloodline and a thousand honest declarations, and there was no committee anywhere inside it!
So, with his home transforming around him and the Reverie still burning steady on its infinite subsidy, Noah released the threads.

His Infinite Sanguine Mana left him without sound or light. It passed out of THE Infiniverse along the first bound points of the Weft, crossed the dark, and entered the fused Ymnaros Dimension, and there it began to spread across the countless gigaparsecs where the millions of THE Vaelos lived.

Infinite Lifeforms beyond counting, from sovereigns commanding old escalations down to the young and thin whose infinities barely filled a valley, all of them going about the hours of a Dimension recovering from an incursion, grieving their dead, rebuilding their terraces, scared of a Blood-Crowned One most had never seen.
And beneath every one of them, unperceivable and patient, the threads arrived!

They simply settled where each lifeform’s draw of Infinity met its source, finer than any sense that would ever check, and waited for the next pull. And when the next pull came, as it always came, the seas answered as they had always answered, and the answering was subtly different now, and not one being in all those gigaparsecs noticed the difference!
Their Infinity felt fuller, if anything. Cleaner. A well that had always been theirs, running a little sweeter than yesterday!
They had begun to pull from another source. The source was him!
|Your rulership is extending along a road no instrument can register.|
|104,318 Infinite Lifeforms across THE Ymnaros now draw, in part, upon your Infinite Sanguine Mana as the wellspring of their Infinity. They perceive nothing. The count is rising.|
|418,772 Infinite Lifeforms now draw upon you.|

|1,296,439 Infinite Lifeforms now draw upon you. Every draw deepens the thread. Every deepened thread widens your standing. Rulership, as you have redefined it, is no longer a matter of territory: it is a matter of substance. You are becoming what your subjects are made of.|

Noah stood in the stellar grass with his eyes of endless blue, watching numbers rise that no border would ever contain, and it was at this moment, of course, that the two halves of him chose to hold a discussion!
"It works," THE Provenance of the Closed Crown said. "So the only question left is pace. And I say we stop waiting for existence to get thirsty on its own."
"Meaning what, exactly?" THE Open Hand asked, though its tone suggested it already knew.
"Meaning that a well nobody needs is just water in the ground."The Crown’s voice ran low and unhurried, and there was a great deal of patience in it, and none of it was gentle!

"Listen. Every lifeform that pulls on Infinity, or Source, or any framework’s allowance, already depends on something. They simply depend on it invisibly, the same as they now depend on us. The Infinity Eater holds many threads. The frameworks meter out their portions. Those Who Remain built ladders and own every rung. Existence is already a web of wellsprings, and every one of them has an owner, and not one of those owners asked permission either. We would not be introducing dependence into a free existence. We would be competing for dependence in a market that has never once been free."

And here the Crown’s voice settled, and the whole Reverie seemed to lean in to listen. "We become the best water in every valley. Wherever a framework rations its chosen, our thread runs a little fuller. Wherever a source runs thin, ours arrives without being asked. Wherever the Pax subtracts authority and leaves the mighty as beggars, we are the quiet spring the beggars find. We never demand. We never announce. We simply out-provide every wellspring in existence until pulling from us is not a choice anyone remembers making, because it will feel to every one of them the way breathing feels. And then, when enough of existence is made of us..."

"We never close the well. We give them free access to abundance, and everyone whose depths we run through will come to understand, slowly, in the marrow where understanding actually lives, that their next breath was always going to be drawn through us."
HUUM!

"You do not rule beings by commanding their choices. You rule them by becoming what their choices are made of. That is tyranny perfected, and it requires no cage, no collar, and no Pax. Existence itself becomes the leash, and we never even have to pull it."
Silence held for a moment across the turning dance.
"We make certain that what flows through the threads is genuinely better than what flowed before," the Crown said. "Fuller Infinity. Cleaner Source...immensity! Glory! Quintessence!"
The Hand did not answer that.

And Noah, turning slowly through the stellar grass with Thalia’s hand in his and a million threads deepening beneath a distant Dimension, listened to the tyrant half of his own Provenance lay out the road, and found, with no argument anywhere in his existence...
That he agreed!
Let them draw from him! And they would find their Infinity greater, their Source sweeter and grander!
His...would be the only source they would ever pull from as any other source would feel lackluster!

chapters.title: Chapter 5624: The Severed Demesne!
paragraphs: The dance ended the way it had begun, with her deciding!
The old melody wound itself down to a last few notes, and Thalia drew him close on the final turn, and rose onto her toes, and kissed him on the lips.

It was a single action, soft and brief and entirely unhurried, and it very nearly broke him out of the Reverie. Warmth moved through his existence with no permission asked, and the endless blue of his eyes flickered once, and steadied!
’This woman...’

"I can sense your Provenance pulsing with momentum," she said, still close. "Continue with what you need to do. I will ensure all those who are potential targets of THE Sealed One finish the emergence of their Observable Existences. I will also introduce myself to Barbatos and the others."
A faint curve of her lips formed. "And I will keep an eye on anything coming across Dimensions and Time."
She said such words, and then she moved away from him like a dream, unhurried across the stellar grass toward the distant cliff, and his mother and his daughter were already waving her over.
Noah watched her go.
Then, with his eyes still shining stellar blue, he spoke to the whole of his home.
"Infiniverse...conduct your first Hearthshift. Take us from THE Ymnaros."He paused."I will leave one clone behind to brief Anaximander and the others..."
|Understood, Master.|
HUUM!
And there was, of course, a strangeness in what came next, which was that almost nothing came at all!

No engines lit. No skies tore. Within THE Infiniverse, the rivers kept running and the thousand plus young Observable Existences kept turning, because a home does not tremble when it arrives somewhere new!
Only two beings in all of existence perceived the motion itself: a mother gathering the whole of herself, every Realm and foundation and life she carried, and stepping, once, across the dark.
|THE Infiniverse has conducted her first Hearthshift.|
|Departure: the fused Ymnaros Dimension. Nothing perceived her leaving. Nothing can follow.|
|Now drifting across Existence.|
WAA!
|Drifting...|
|Drifting...|
|Drifting...|
WAP!

|Arrival: a wandering Dimension, one of many sundered fringes of THE Source Lands that broke away across the ages over time. Local designation, drawn from the memory of its inhabitants: THE SEVERED DEMESNE.|

|Composition: Source Lifeforms, including True Source Lifeforms. Depth assessment: every living being within this Dimension resides within THE FINITE VERSE. None possess the standing to perceive you, THE Infiniverse, or THE CRIMSON WEFT, under any circumstance, even should you walk among them.|
A severed edge of THE Source Lands!

Noah found it quietly remarkable. He had stood in the Source Lands before. And yet here drifted a piece that had simply broken off it, ages ago, and gone on living alone, a limb that had outlasted its body’s memory of losing it.
’How many such fragments are scattered across existence? How many pieces of eternal things?’

The Weft was already moving. Crimson rivers only he could see threaded out from THE Infiniverse and latched, quietly and completely, onto the drifting Dimension, binding it as an anchor, and through those threads his Infinite Sanguine Mana began to flow outward. But this time, the mana did not travel alone.
It carried glimmers of his Provenance Essence within it.

Since Infinity answered Infinite Lifeforms, and THE Primordial Source answered Source Lifeforms, and his essence was a thing of purity that predated frameworks entirely, the design followed plainly enough.

The mana would be the river. The essence would be what the river carried. And the Source Lifeforms of this Dimension, drawing as they had always drawn on the deep patient foundation of all things, would find their draw answered by something a great deal closer, and a great deal purer, than anything that had ever answered them before!
Noah went to see it done personally.
He appeared above a grand citadel floating in the open dark, and no alarm anywhere in existence stirred.

The citadel stretched beneath him in ordered tiers of pale stone and dense golden light, light years across from its outermost terraces to its radiant heart, and millions of Source Lifeforms moved through it, patient beings of settled luminance going about their hours, markets and sanctums and long contemplation halls where rows of the ancient sat in stillness with their cores glowing softly. And it was one citadel of dozens!
His senses counted them scattered across the Dimension, each one vast, each one old, an entire civilization built by beings who had never once perceived the walls of the vessel holding them.
He descended, and walked among them.

He passed through a market where a Source Lifeform haggled over crystallized Source foundations. He walked the length of a contemplation hall past a hundred seated ancients, close enough to touch the oldest of them, a being whose luminance had the deep worn steadiness of ages, and not one head turned, and not one sense so much as itched. To THE Severed Demesne, nothing at all was happening this afternoon!
And beneath all of them, the threads settled into place.

His Infinite Sanguine Mana, carrying its glimmers of essence, slid silently beneath the point where every Source Lifeform’s draw met its source, and replaced what answered. No pull was interrupted. No draw was denied. The next time each being reached for the foundation of all things, the foundation reached back, and it was him!
The old one in the contemplation hall opened his eyes.

Around him, one by one, the other ancients stirred from their stillness, and looks were exchanged down the long hall, wondering and quiet, because every one of them had felt the same impossible thing in the same second!
"Elder... did you also...?"
"...THE Source seems Closer..."The oldest one’s whisper barely left him. "It feels... closer! Oh!"
THE Primordial Source felt closer than it had ever felt in the whole of their long lives. Grander. Warmer, if such a word could be used for the deep foundation of existence!

In the market outside, a lifeform sat down in the middle of the street and wept without knowing why, and across dozens of citadels and light years of dark, in a thousand halls at once, the Source Lifeforms of a severed fragment turned toward their own depths in wonder.
And for a rarer few, the change ran deeper still.
|Note: this Dimension contains True Source Lifeforms who also cultivate Infinity. 217 among them actively pursue the fusion of Infinity and THE Primordial Source.|
The fusion path!

Here at the Finite depth it was pursued the way the Finite pursued everything, blindly and bravely and mostly fatally, generations of True Source Lifeforms grinding at a joining that hurt nearly all who attempted it.
And in this hour, all 217 of them stopped what they were doing.

Because it had suddenly become so much easier! The two great currents they had spent lifetimes forcing toward each other now ran, at their deepest point of draw, out of a single wellspring, and currents from one source do not fight their joining. Across the Dimension, many bolted upright in their sanctums and began sensing their own existences with something between disbelief and reverence, feeling a lifetime’s impossibility soften in their hands!
Oh!
No war. No conquest. Not a drop of blood shed anywhere beneath him.
And Noah was extending his rulership grandly.

Minutes passed, and the permeation completed itself. His glimmering essence settled beneath every being in the Dimension that had ever touched THE Primordial Source, and his mana beneath every one that had ever touched Infinity, and where a lifeform cultivated both, both draws quietly became him.
|Your rulership has extended across THE SEVERED DEMESNE.|
|38,114,209 Source Lifeforms now draw upon your Provenance Essence as the wellspring of THE Primordial Source. They perceive nothing.|

|1,120 True Source Lifeforms now draw upon you. 217 now draw upon you through both currents at once. Their pursuit of the fusion has been eased beyond all precedent. Whether this proves a gift or a consequence is unrecorded.|

|Attention: your Provenance Essence is not infinite. Sustaining all current draws consumes 0.0000001% of your essence per second. The rate will rise with every Dimension claimed. As of now, the cost is negligible.|
Noah looked at those last words for a long moment, and his shining eyes were tyrannically heavy.
The cost was nothing, today. But he had not designed this road for one Dimension. He had designed it for existence, and existence would multiply that small number by millions!
A wells that can run dry... is a throne with a crack in it.

So the answer was the same answer it had always been, the one running through his quarks at this very moment. Generate faster than existence could drink. Become a source that made the word finite a stranger!
"Infiniverse..." he said quietly. "Let us initiate the next Hearthshift. Let us...continue on."
|Understood, Master.|
WAA!

And as his home gathered herself for her second step across the dark, the Baryogenesis within him surged faster still. The weight of existence came down and his quarks drank it in accelerating rhythm, and he could feel his Dimensionality rising quicker for what he had done, as though existence itself were adjusting its opinion of where he stood, deepening the water around a being who had become the foundation beneath forty million others!
And at this moment...
HUUM!
His existence rang!

It was not pain and it was not power. It was fullness. Every corner of what he was drew taut at once, his singularities, his organs, his remade quarks, all of it arriving together at some shared brim, pressing outward against a boundary his senses could feel but not name, a membrane at the very edge of everything he currently was!
|100,000,000 Provenance Telos Quarks converted.|
|Your attributes have risen. VERITAS: 20. PROVENANCE: 20. POTENTIA: INFINITE. PONDUS: 20.|
|All of your attributes now stand at 20. None have yet crossed the wall.|

sentences.text: The dance ended the way it had begun, with her deciding!
The old melody wound itself down to a last few notes, and Thalia drew him close on the final turn, and rose onto her toes, and kissed him on the lips.
It was a single action, soft and brief and entirely unhurried, and it very nearly broke him out of the Reverie.
Warmth moved through his existence with no permission asked, and the endless blue of his eyes flickered once, and steadied!
’This woman...’
"I can sense your Provenance pulsing with momentum," she said, still close.
"Continue with what you need to do.
I will ensure all those who are potential targets of THE Sealed One finish the emergence of their Observable Existences.
I will also introduce myself to Barbatos and the others."
A faint curve of her lips formed.
"And I will keep an eye on anything coming across Dimensions and Time."
She said such words, and then she moved away from him like a dream, unhurried across the stellar grass toward the distant cliff, and his mother and his daughter were already waving her over.
Noah watched her go.
Then, with his eyes still shining stellar blue, he spoke to the whole of his home.
"Infiniverse...conduct your first Hearthshift.
Take us from THE Ymnaros."He paused."I will leave one clone behind to brief Anaximander and the others..."
|Understood, Master.|
HUUM!
And there was, of course, a strangeness in what came next, which was that almost nothing came at all!
No engines lit.
No skies tore.
Within THE Infiniverse, the rivers kept running and the thousand plus young Observable Existences kept turning, because a home does not tremble when it arrives somewhere new!
Only two beings in all of existence perceived the motion itself: a mother gathering the whole of herself, every Realm and foundation and life she carried, and stepping, once, across the dark.
|THE Infiniverse has conducted her first Hearthshift.|
|Departure: the fused Ymnaros Dimension.
Nothing perceived her leaving.
Nothing can follow.|
|Now drifting across Existence.|
WAA!
|Drifting...|
|Drifting...|
|Drifting...|
WAP!
|Arrival: a wandering Dimension, one of many sundered fringes of THE Source Lands that broke away across the ages over time.
Local designation, drawn from the memory of its inhabitants: THE SEVERED DEMESNE.|
|Composition: Source Lifeforms, including True Source Lifeforms.
Depth assessment: every living being within this Dimension resides within THE FINITE VERSE.
None possess the standing to perceive you, THE Infiniverse, or THE CRIMSON WEFT, under any circumstance, even should you walk among them.|
A severed edge of THE Source Lands!
Noah found it quietly remarkable.
He had stood in the Source Lands before.
And yet here drifted a piece that had simply broken off it, ages ago, and gone on living alone, a limb that had outlasted its body’s memory of losing it.
’How many such fragments are scattered across existence?
How many pieces of eternal things?’
The Weft was already moving.

Crimson rivers only he could see threaded out from THE Infiniverse and latched, quietly and completely, onto the drifting Dimension, binding it as an anchor, and through those threads his Infinite Sanguine Mana began to flow outward.
But this time, the mana did not travel alone.
It carried glimmers of his Provenance Essence within it.

Since Infinity answered Infinite Lifeforms, and THE Primordial Source answered Source Lifeforms, and his essence was a thing of purity that predated frameworks entirely, the design followed plainly enough.
The mana would be the river.
The essence would be what the river carried.

And the Source Lifeforms of this Dimension, drawing as they had always drawn on the deep patient foundation of all things, would find their draw answered by something a great deal closer, and a great deal purer, than anything that had ever answered them before!
Noah went to see it done personally.
He appeared above a grand citadel floating in the open dark, and no alarm anywhere in existence stirred.

The citadel stretched beneath him in ordered tiers of pale stone and dense golden light, light years across from its outermost terraces to its radiant heart, and millions of Source Lifeforms moved through it, patient beings of settled luminance going about their hours, markets and sanctums and long contemplation halls where rows of the ancient sat in stillness with their cores glowing softly.
And it was one citadel of dozens!
His senses counted them scattered across the Dimension, each one vast, each one old, an entire civilization built by beings who had never once perceived the walls of the vessel holding them.
He descended, and walked among them.
He passed through a market where a Source Lifeform haggled over crystallized Source foundations.

He walked the length of a contemplation hall past a hundred seated ancients, close enough to touch the oldest of them, a being whose luminance had the deep worn steadiness of ages, and not one head turned, and not one sense so much as itched.
To THE Severed Demesne, nothing at all was happening this afternoon!
And beneath all of them, the threads settled into place.
His Infinite Sanguine Mana, carrying its glimmers of essence, slid silently beneath the point where every Source Lifeform’s draw met its source, and replaced what answered.
No pull was interrupted.
No draw was denied.
The next time each being reached for the foundation of all things, the foundation reached back, and it was him!
The old one in the contemplation hall opened his eyes.

Around him, one by one, the other ancients stirred from their stillness, and looks were exchanged down the long hall, wondering and quiet, because every one of them had felt the same impossible thing in the same second!
"Elder... did you also...?"
"...THE Source seems Closer..."The oldest one’s whisper barely left him.
"It feels... closer!
Oh!"
THE Primordial Source felt closer than it had ever felt in the whole of their long lives.
Grander.
Warmer, if such a word could be used for the deep foundation of existence!

In the market outside, a lifeform sat down in the middle of the street and wept without knowing why, and across dozens of citadels and light years of dark, in a thousand halls at once, the Source Lifeforms of a severed fragment turned toward their own depths in wonder.
And for a rarer few, the change ran deeper still.
|Note: this Dimension contains True Source Lifeforms who also cultivate Infinity.
217 among them actively pursue the fusion of Infinity and THE Primordial Source.|
The fusion path!

Here at the Finite depth it was pursued the way the Finite pursued everything, blindly and bravely and mostly fatally, generations of True Source Lifeforms grinding at a joining that hurt nearly all who attempted it.
And in this hour, all 217 of them stopped what they were doing.
Because it had suddenly become so much easier!
The two great currents they had spent lifetimes forcing toward each other now ran, at their deepest point of draw, out of a single wellspring, and currents from one source do not fight their joining.

Across the Dimension, many bolted upright in their sanctums and began sensing their own existences with something between disbelief and reverence, feeling a lifetime’s impossibility soften in their hands!
Oh!
No war.
No conquest.
Not a drop of blood shed anywhere beneath him.
And Noah was extending his rulership grandly.
Minutes passed, and the permeation completed itself.

His glimmering essence settled beneath every being in the Dimension that had ever touched THE Primordial Source, and his mana beneath every one that had ever touched Infinity, and where a lifeform cultivated both, both draws quietly became him.
|Your rulership has extended across THE SEVERED DEMESNE.|
|38,114,209 Source Lifeforms now draw upon your Provenance Essence as the wellspring of THE Primordial Source.
They perceive nothing.|
|1,120 True Source Lifeforms now draw upon you.
217 now draw upon you through both currents at once.
Their pursuit of the fusion has been eased beyond all precedent.
Whether this proves a gift or a consequence is unrecorded.|
|Attention: your Provenance Essence is not infinite.
Sustaining all current draws consumes 0.0000001% of your essence per second.
The rate will rise with every Dimension claimed.
As of now, the cost is negligible.|
Noah looked at those last words for a long moment, and his shining eyes were tyrannically heavy.

HUUM!
